advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Sefa mazuva emakadhi ne @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt kana @listEnteredAt. Muenzaniso: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' kana @endAt = none. Isa zita remunda wawakagadzira rinotanga ne @ muzviratidzo zvekutaura.
advanced-filter-description: zvepamusoro sefa allows ku write a string containing following operators: == != <= >= && || ( ) A space iri used as a separator between the Operators. unogona sefa for zvose Custom ndima na typing their names uye values. For Example: Field1 == Value1. Note: If ndima kana values contains spaces, you need ku encapsulate them into single quotes. For Example: 'ndima 1' == 'ukoshi 1'. For single control characters (' \/) ku iva skipped, unogona use \. For example: Field1 == I\'m. Also unogona combine multiple conditions. For Example: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Normally zvose operators vari interpreted kubva left ku right. unogona chinja the order na placing brackets. For Example: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Also unogona tsvaga mashoko ndima using regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Inoenderana kana kadhi richigadzirwa, kana musoro kana tsanangudzo yacho ichishandurwa, uye mazwi matsva aine izvi (asina musiyano wemavara makuru nemadiki).
imported-member-no-account: zvapinzwa nhengo — kwete matching akaundi yet
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Paste a Kanboard tumira kunze JSON: an object ne "columns" (kana tasks carrying column_name) uye a "tasks" array (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns become rondedzero uye tasks become makadhi.
import-board-instruction-deck: Paste a NextCloud Deck bhodhi JSON (a bhodhi ne "stacks", each stack carrying its "cards"). Stacks become rondedzero uye makadhi become makadhi.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Paste an OpenProject work-packages collection JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses become rondedzero uye work packages become makadhi.
import-board-instruction-issues: Paste a __sourceName__ issues JSON array (__endpoint__). Issues become makadhi grouped into vhura / Closed rondedzero.
import-board-instruction-asana: Paste an Asana tasks tumira kunze JSON ({ "data": [...] } kubva the Asana tumira kunze kana GET /tasks). Tasks vari grouped into sections (memberships); zvapedzwa tasks go ku Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Paste a ZenKit rondedzero tumira kunze JSON ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages become rondedzero uye items become makadhi.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Namira runyorwa rwemabasa emarkdown (tsika inoshandiswa nemidziyo yemarkdown-kanban seObsidian Kanban): misoro ye"## Zita rerunyorwa", ine zvinhu "- [ ]"/"- [x]" pasi payo. Misoro inova runyorwa uye zvinhu zvinova makadhi.
import-board-instruction-leo: Namira rondedzero ine zvikamu zveLeo (faira re.leo). Zvikamu zvepamusoro zvinova rondedzero, zvikamu zviri pasi pazvo zvinova makadhi ane zviri muchikamu setsananguro, uye zvikamu zvakadzika zvinova rondedzero dzekutarisa. Zvikamu zvakamakiwa zvinopinzwa sezvakapera.
import-board-instruction-opml: Isa rondedzero yeOPML, sezvinoibudisa Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq nezvimwe zvirongwa zvemarondedzero. Zvinhu zvepamusoro-soro zvinova marondedzero, vana vazvo vanova makadhi ane chinyorwa setsanangudzo, uye zvinhu zvakadzika zvinova marondedzero ekuongorora. Zvinhu zvakapedzwa zvinopinzwa sezvakaitwa.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Isa faira reOrg mode, sezvarinonyorwa neEmacs, Orgzly kana Beorg. Misoro yepamusoro-soro inova marondedzero uye misoro yechipiri inova makadhi. TODO ne DONE, kukosha, matagi, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ne CLOSED zvinochengetwa, uye mabhokisi ekuongorora nemisoro yakadzika zvinova marondedzero ekuongorora.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Namira faira retodo.txt: basa rimwe pamutsetse, sezvinonyorwa neapp yetodo.txt nemaapp anoenderana nayo. Mabasa apera ("x") anoenda kuDone, +project na@context zvinova zvinyorwa, (A) inova chinyorwa chekutanga kukosha, uye due: na t: zvinova zuva rekupedzisira nezuva rekutanga zvichitevedzana.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Namira zvabuda mu-task export: rondedzero ye-JSON kana basa rimwe pamutsara mumwe nomumwe. Mabasa apera anoenda ku-Done, project ne-priority zvinova mareberu, annotations inova mhinduro, uye depends inova kutsamira pamabasa anovhara.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Vhura faira re-.boardarchive kubva mudura rakadzvanywa wonamira zviri mu-board.jsonl yebhodhi, nemutsara weshanduro kana pasina iwo. Chimiro chekuisa mumapoka pakuonekwa kwebhodhi chinova rondedzero, zvimwe zvimiro zvekusarudza zvinova mareberu, zvikamu zvemashoko nemabhokisi ekumaka zvinova tsananguro nerondedzero yekuongorora, uye mhinduro dzinochengetwa. Mifananidzo nemafaira akabatanidzwa hazvipinzwi.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-azuredevops: MuAzure DevOps, vhura Boards, wozoti Queries, mhanya mubvunzo unoratidza makoramu aunoda, wosarudza Export to CSV; wozosarudza faira iyoyo ye.csv. Board Column (kana State) inova marondedzero uye Board Lane migwagwa; zvinhu zvebasa zvinova makadhi nerudzi rwazvo nema-tags semareberu, Assigned To, mazuva, tsananguro nomubereki, uye mamwe makoramu anova minda yakagadzirwa.
import-board-instruction-mslists: MuMicrosoft Lists, vhura rondedzero, sarudza Export, wozoti Export to CSV, wosarudza faira iyoyo ye.csv. Koramu yeStatus (kana Progress) inova marondedzero uye chinhu chimwe nechimwe kadhi, nemusoro wacho, tsananguro, vanhu, mazuva nema-tags; mamwe makoramu anova minda yakagadzirwa.
import-board-instruction-msproject: MuMicrosoft Project, sarudza File, wozoti Save As, nerudzi XML Format (*.xml), wosarudza faira iyoyo. Mabasa epfupiso anova migwagwa uye mabasa anova makadhi muNot started, In progress kana Completed, nemazuva awo, zvinyorwa, zviwanikwa, mabasa madiki nemabasa anotangira.
import-board-instruction-outlook: MuOutlook, kweva mameseji kuenda kufoda pakombiyuta yako, kana uachengete neFile, wozoti Save As, seOutlook Message Format (*.msg). Sarudza faira imwe ye.msg, kana .zip yemafaira e.msg ne.eml. Hurukuro imwe neimwe inova kadhi muBoard View / Email, nemhinduro dzayo semhinduro uye zvakabatanidzwa semafaira.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: MuMeisterTask, dzvanya zita repurojekiti, sarudza Export project wobva wabudisa CSV, wozoiisa pano. Zvikamu zvinova marondedzero uye mabasa anova makadhi, ane zvinyorwa zvawo, zuva rekupedzisira, wapiwa basa nematagi; mabasa akapedzwa anochengeta zuva rawakapedzwa. CSV yakanyorerwa kupinza kweMeisterTask pachayo inoshandawo.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: MuObsidian, vhura faira rebhodhi reKanban seMarkdown (kana vhura faira re.md mumugadziri wemavara), wozoisa zvese zviri mariri. Migwagwa inova marondedzero ane miganhu yemakadhi, makadhi anochengeta matagi, mazuva, kukosha, minda nerondedzero yekuongorora, uye Archive inova makadhi ari mudura.
import-board-instruction-linear: MuLinear, budisa nyaya seCSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, kana kubudisa kwechiratidziro), wozoisa CSV. Mamiriro anova marondedzero, zvikwata zvinova migwagwa, uye nyaya dzinova makadhi ane wapiwa basa, mareberu, mazuva, nyaya huru, kukosha, fungidziro, purojekiti nedenderedzwa.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: MuTickTick, vhura Settings, Account, Backup & Import wogadzira backup, wozoisa faira reCSV. Rondedzero yega yega yeTickTick inova mugwagwa uye makoramu ayo anova marondedzero; mabasa anochengeta matagi, mazuva, rondedzero yekuongorora, kukosha nemabasa madiki.
import-board-instruction-clickup: MuClickUp, budisa mabasa seCSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, kana kubudisa kwechiratidziro cheList kana Table nemakoramu ese), wozoisa CSV. Mamiriro anova marondedzero, marondedzero eClickUp anova migwagwa, uye mabasa anova makadhi ane mabasa madiki, vapiwa basa, matagi, mazuva, kukosha nenguva.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: MuNullboard, vhura bhodhi, sarudza Export this board... pamenyu, vhura faira re.nbx mumugadziri wemavara woisa zviri mukati maro. Marondedzero anova marondedzero uye zvinyorwa zvinova makadhi: mutsara wekutanga wechinyorwa ndiwo musoro wekadhi uye zvakasara itsanangudzo yaro. Chinyorwa chisina kugadziriswa chinowana reberu raw. Faira rine mabhodhi akati wandei rinopinza bhodhi raro rekutanga.
import-board-instruction-kanri: MuKanri, vhura Import & Export usarudze Export individual board (kana Export all data), wozoisa faira re.json. Makoramu anova marondedzero uye makadhi anova makadhi, ane tsanangudzo, zuva rekupedzisira, matagi nemavara awo; mabasa ekadhi anova rondedzero yekuongorora. Pakubudisa data rese, bhodhi rekutanga ndiro rinopinzwa.
import-board-instruction-planka: Nyora kero yePlanka yako (semuenzaniso https://planka.example.com), zita rekushandisa nepasiwedhi zvePlanka, wobva wadzvanya «Ratidza zvinogona kupinzwa». Zvinoshandiswa chete kutora bhodhi uye hazvichengetwi. Sarudza bhodhi wodzvanya «Tora»: WeKan inoriverenga kubva kuAPI yePlanka pamwe chete nemarondedzero aro, makadhi, tsananguro, mazuva ekupedzisira, mareberu, nhengo, marondedzero emabasa nemafungiro, wobva waenderera mberi nekupinza sezvazvinoitwa. Makadhi ari mudura rePlanka anopinzwa akachengetwa; zvakanamirwa nemakadhi ari mumarara hazvipinzwi.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: MuMicrosoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), pinda, bvumira mvumo yeTasks.Read uye kopa token kubva pa tab yeAccess token. Inamatidze pano wodzvanya «Ratidza zvinogona kupinzwa»; token inoshandiswa chete pakutora uku uye haichengetwi. Sarudza marondedzero ose kana rimwe wodzvanya «Tora». Rondedzero yega yega yeTo Do inova rondedzero uye basa rega rega rinova kadhi, pamwe nezvinyorwa, mazuva ekupedzisira nekutanga, matanho serondedzero yekuongorora, mapoka semareberu, kukosha kwakanyanya nemamiriro semareberu; mabasa apera anochengetwa. Zviyeuchidzo nekudzokorora hazvipinzwi.
import-board-instruction-onenote: MuMicrosoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), pinda, bvuma mvumo yeNotes.Read wokopa token kubva patab yeAccess token. Iise pano wobaya «Ratidza zvinogona kupinzwa»; token inoshandiswa pakutora uku chete uye haichengetwe. Sarudza bhuku remanotsi wobaya «Tora». Zvikamu zvinova marondedzero uye mapeji anova makadhi, nemanyorerwo awo, mabhokisi ezvekuita serondedzero yekuongorora uye mapeji madiki semabasa madiki.
import-board-instruction-teams: Isa token yekupinda yeMicrosoft Graph ine Chat.Read (kubva kuGraph Explorer, akaundi yebasa kana yechikoro) wobaya «Ratidza zvinogona kupinzwa», wozosarudza chat kana chiteshi wobaya «Tora»; token haichengetwe. Kana sarudza faira: .tar yekuendesa kwako kwega kubva kuteams.live.com/dataexport, kana .json yemameseji echat. Chat imwe neimwe inova kadhi muBoard View / Chat, uye mameseji ayo mhinduro.
import-board-instruction-sandstorm: MuSandstorm, vhura grain ye__app__, sarudza "Download backup" pabhawa repamusoro regrain, uye sarudza faira iro re .zip. Zviri mugrain zvinova bhodhi, zvinhu zvayo zvinova makadhi pamwe nezvinochengetwa neapp pamusoro pazvo. Sarudza app inova yegrain: grain yeimwe app inorambwa, uye inotaura kuti iapp ipi.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: MuKanbanFlow, vhura menyu yebhodhi, sarudza Settings → API & Webhooks uye kopa token yeAPI yebhodhi. Namatidza token pano, dzvanya «Ratidza zvinogona kupinzwa», sarudza bhodhi wodzvanya «Tora»; token inoshandiswa chete pakutora ikoko uye haichengetwi. Makoramu anova marondedzero uye migwagwa inoramba iri migwagwa; mabasa anochengeta tsananguro, ruvara, mareberu, zuva rekupedzisira, mabasa madiki serondedzero yekuongorora, nguva yakashandiswa, fungidziro, vanhu nemafungiro.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Nyora ID yeakaundi yako yeBasecamp (nhamba iri mushure mebasecamp.com/ mukero) uye token yekupinda (kubva kuapp yeOAuth 2 yakanyoreswa palaunchpad.37signals.com, kana iyo kubatanidza kuripo kwatova nayo), dzvanya «Ratidza zvinogona kupinzwa», sarudza purojekiti wodzvanya «Tora». Token inoshandiswa chete pakutora ikoko uye haichengetwi. Tafura yega yega yemakadhi inova mugwagwa une makoramu ayo semarondedzero, uye marondedzero ezvinofanira kuitwa anova mugwagwa «To-dos»; makadhi nezvinofanira kuitwa zvinochengeta mavara, mazuva, vakapihwa basa nemafungiro, matanho ekadhi anova rondedzero yekuongorora, uye zvapera zvinochengetwa.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Tora token yekupinda kubva kuOAuth 2.0 Playground: pasi peTasks API v1 sarudza tasks.readonly, dzvanya Authorize APIs, wozoti Exchange authorization code for tokens, wokopa token yekupinda. Inamatidze pano wodzvanya «Ratidza zvinogona kupinzwa», sarudza marondedzero ose emabasa kana rimwe, wozoti «Tora». Token inoshandiswa chete pakutora uku uye haichengetwi. Marondedzero emabasa anova marondedzero uye mabasa anova makadhi, pamwe nezvinyorwa, zvinongedzo nezuva rekupedzisira; mabasa madiki anova rondedzero yekuongorora uye mabasa apera anopinzwa akachengetwa.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API yeGoogle Keep ndeyeakaundi dzeGoogle Workspace chete. Tora token yekupinda yeOAuth 2.0 ine chikamu https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (muOAuth 2.0 Playground kana maneja weWorkspace yako achibvumira, kana kubva kuakaundi yesevhisi ine kutumwa kwedomeini yose), inamatidze, dzvanya «Ratidza zvinogona kupinzwa» wozoti «Tora». Token inoshandiswa chete pakutora uku uye haichengetwi. Zvinyorwa zvemavara zvinova makadhi murondedzero «Notes», uye zvinyorwa zverondedzero yekuongorora zvinova makadhi murondedzero «Lists» nezvinhu zvazvo serondedzero yekuongorora. Zvinyorwa zviri mumarara, zvakanamirwa nekugovana hazvipinzwi.
api-import-desc: Itore kubva kusevhisi neakaundi yako. Zvaunonyora pano zvinoshandiswa chete pakutora uku uye hazvichengetwi.
api-import-fetched: Zvatorwa. Ongorora nhengo dziri pasi wopinza.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: MuPivotal Tracker, vhura tebhu yeMORE yepurojekiti usarudze Export CSV (kana sarudza nyaya wosarudza Bulk Actions, CSV), wozoisa CSV. Mamiriro ega ega enyaya anova rondedzero uye nyaya dzinova makadhi, ane rudzi nemareberu, varidzi, akakumbira, mazuva, mhinduro, mabasa nezvipingamupinyi; Estimate inova Story points uye madenderedzwa anova nguva pfupi dzebasa.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: MuTasks.org, vhura Settings, Backups usarudze Export tasks, wozoisa zviri mufaira re.json iroro. Marondedzero anova marondedzero uye mabasa anova makadhi, ane zvinyorwa, matagi, mazuva, mhinduro nemabasa madiki; mabasa akapedzwa anochengeta zuva rawakapedzwa, uye kukosha kunova munda wakagadzirwa.
import-board-instruction-monday: Mumonday.com, vhura menyu yebhodhi, sarudza More actions neExport board to Excel (nezvigadziriso nezvinhu zvidiki kana uchida), wozosarudza faira re.xlsx iroro. Koramu yeStatus inova marondedzero uye mapoka anova migwagwa; vanhu, mazuva, nguva nematagi zvinoramba zviri munzvimbo dzazvo, mamwe makoramu anova minda yakagadzirwa uye zvigadziriso zvinova mhinduro.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: MuSuper Productivity, vhura Settings, wozoita Sync & Backup, sarudza Export Data woisa zviri mufaira re sp-backup .json. Purojekiti yega yega inova mugwagwa uye mabasa anova makadhi muTo Do, In Progress, Backlog kana Done, ane zvinyorwa, matagi, zuva rekupedzisira, nguva yakashandiswa nemabasa madiki; mabasa ari mudura anova makadhi ari mudura.
import-board-instruction-taiga: MuTaiga, vhura Admin > Project > Export wotora dump yepurojekiti (tanga wavhura faira re.json.gz), wozoisa JSON yayo. Mamiriro enyaya dzevashandisi anova marondedzero, nyaya dzevashandisi dzinova makadhi ane mabasa awo semabasa madiki, maepiki nenyaya zvinowana migwagwa yazvo, uye nguva pfupi dzebasa, matagi, mhinduro nezvimiro zvakagadzirwa zvinouyawo. Zvakabatanidzwa hazvipinzwi.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: MuVikunja, vhura Settings, sarudza Data Export wotora faira re.zip rarinokutumira, wozosarudza faira iroro, kana isa data.json iri mukati maro. Mabhaketi eKanban anova marondedzero uye mabasa anova makadhi, ane mareberu, vapiwa basa, mazuva, tsanangudzo, marondedzero emabasa semarondedzero ekuongorora nemhinduro; kukosha, chikamu chakaitwa uye kuitwa zvinova minda yakagadzirwa. Zvakabatanidzwa hazvipinzwi.
import-board-instruction-quire: MuQuire, vhura menyu yepurojekiti usarudze Export CSV, wozoisa CSV. Mamiriro anova marondedzero uye mabasa anova makadhi, ane mabasa madiki semakadhi evana, vapiwa basa, matagi semareberu, mazuva ekutanga, ekupedzisira nekupedzwa, tsanangudzo nekukosha semunda wakagadzirwa. Mhinduro nezvakabatanidzwa hazvisi muCSV yeQuire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: MuWrike, budisa purojekiti kana folda kuExcel, kana zadza tembureti yekupinza Excel yeWrike, wozosarudza faira re.xlsx iroro. Mitsara yemafolda nemapurojekiti inova migwagwa, Status inova marondedzero uye mabasa anova makadhi, ane Key, basa guru, vapiwa basa, mazuva ekutanga nekupedzisira, kuvimbana netsanangudzo; Priority, Duration nemamwe makoramu anova minda yakagadzirwa.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: MuTeamwork.com, zadza tembureti yeExcel yekupinza mabasa (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) woichengetedza se.xlsx, wozosarudza faira iroro. Marondedzero emabasa anova marondedzero uye mabasa anova makadhi; basa rinotanga ne -, # kana > rinova basa diki rebasa riri pamusoro paro (--, ## kana >> danho rimwe pasi). Vapiwa basa, mazuva nematagi zvinoramba zviri munzvimbo dzazvo; Priority, Estimated time neComplete zvinova minda yakagadzirwa.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: MuBusinessmap (yaimbova Kanbanize), vhura Advanced Search, sarudza Configure results kuti usarudze makoramu, tora faira reExcel, wozosarudza faira re.xlsx iroro. Makoramu anoverengwa nemazita awo echiRungu (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): kana akaundi yako ichishandisa mumwe mutauro, tanga washandura mutsara wemisoro kuchiRungu. Column inova marondedzero uye Lane migwagwa; varidzi, matagi, ruvara, mazuva, mhinduro nezvinongedzo zvikuru zvinoramba zviri munzvimbo dzazvo, uye Priority, Size, Type nemamwe makoramu anova minda yakagadzirwa.
import-board-instruction-redmine: MuRedmine, vhura Issues yepurojekiti, sarudza Also available in: CSV pasi perondedzero, sarudza makoramu (All columns, neDescription) wobudisa, wozoisa CSV. Redmine inopa makoramu mazita mumutauro wako, saka isa mutauro wako kuchiRungu muMy account usati wabudisa. Mamiriro ega ega anova rondedzero uye nyaya dzinova makadhi, ane tracker sereberu, wapiwa basa, munyori, mazuva, basa guru nenyaya dzine hukama; kukosha, chikamu, shanduro inotarisirwa, nguva inofungidzirwa, % Done neminda yakagadzirwa zvinova minda yakagadzirwa.
import-board-instruction-notion: MuNotion, vhura dhatabhesi sepeji rizere, sarudza ••• neExport, sarudza Markdown & CSV, wosarudza faira re.zip rinotorwa, kana CSV imwe yedhatabhesi iri mariri, kana isa CSV iyoyo. Koramu inonzi Status inova marondedzero (kana isipo, koramu yekutanga inoita sesarudzo ndiyo inoshandiswa, uye mushumo wekupinza unotaura kuti ndeipi); mitsara inova makadhi ane musoro, matagi semareberu, vanhu senhengo, mazuva, nemavara epeji setsanangudzo; mamwe makoramu anova minda yakagadzirwa. Hukama, mifananidzo nezvakabatanidzwa hazvipinzwi.
import-board-instruction-plane: MuPlane, vhura Workspace Settings, sarudza Exports, budisa mapurojekiti seJSON, CSV kana Excel wotora faira re.zip, wozosarudza faira iroro, kana faira rimwe riri mukati maro, kana isa JSON kana CSV. Mamiriro anova marondedzero, mapurojekiti anova migwagwa, uye nyaya dzinova makadhi ane chiziviso, nyaya huru, vapiwa basa, mareberu, mazuva, zvinongedzo nemhinduro; kukosha, fungidziro, denderedzwa nechikamu zvinova minda yakagadzirwa. Kubudisa kwePlane hakuna tsanangudzo kana zvakabatanidzwa, saka hazvipinzwi.
import-board-instruction-fizzy: MuFizzy, buritsa akaundi mu"Account settings", kana makadhi ako ne"Download my data", uye sarudza faira re .zip raunotumirwa neFizzy, kana faira re .json rekadhi rimwe. Mabhodhi anova migwagwa uye makoramu anova marondedzero, ne"Maybe?", "Not now" ne"Done" sezviri muFizzy; makadhi anochengeta tsananguro yawo, mareberu, vakapiwa basa, matanho serondedzero yekuongorora, mhinduro nemafaira.
import-board-instruction-mail: Sarudza faira re .mbox, sezvarinochengetwa neThunderbird, Apple Mail, mutt kana Gmail kuburikidza neGoogle Takeout, kana meseji imwe chete ye .eml, kana isa mavara ayo. Hurukuro imwe neimwe inova kadhi rimwe mumunyorwe weInbox, nemutumiri, vagamuchiri nemusoro wayo, kuti iratidzwe mumaonero eEmail; mhinduro dzinova mhinduro dzayo. Mareberu eGmail anova mareberu. Zvakabatanidzwa hazvipinzwe.
import-board-instruction-ical: Sarudza faira rekarenda re .ics, sezvarinoburitswa neGoogle Calendar, Apple Calendar kana Reminders, Thunderbird, Nextcloud kana Outlook, kana isa mavara aro. Mabasa anoenda kuTo Do, In Progress, Done kana Cancelled zvichienderana nemamiriro awo, uye zviitiko kuEvents, nemazuva awo ekutanga nekupedzisira, kuti zviratidzwe mumaonero eCalendar neGantt. Zvikamu nezvinokosha zvinova mareberu. Zvinhu zvinodzokororwa zvinopinzwa kamwe chete.
import-board-instruction-googletakeout: Pa takeout.google.com, sarudza Tasks, Keep, Mail, Calendar neGoogle Chat, gadzira kuburitsa uye dhawunirodha faira re .zip, wozorisarudza pano. Chigadzirwa chimwe nechimwe chinova mugwagwa: tsamba dzemaonero eEmail, marondedzero emabasa nemanotsi nemarondedzero awo ekuongorora, zviitiko zvekarenda nemabasa ane mazuva, nenzvimbo dzekutaurirana dzine meseji dzinova mhinduro dzemaonero eChat. Zvimwe zvigadzirwa nezvakabatanidzwa hazvipinzwe.
import-board-instruction-slack: MuSlack, vhura zvirongwa zvenzvimbo yebasa, sarudza Import/Export Data, buritsa nzvimbo yebasa uye dhawunirodha faira re .zip, wozorisarudza pano. Chiteshi chimwe nechimwe chinova kadhi muChannels, Groups kana Direct messages, uye meseji dzacho nemhinduro dzetambo dzinova mhinduro dzekadhi, nemunyori wadzo, kuti maonero eChat aratidze chiteshi. Mafaira haapinzwe.
import-board-instruction-mattermost: Buritsa nemmctl export create, dhawunirodha kuburitsa uye sarudza faira racho re .jsonl, kana isa mavara aro. Chiteshi chimwe nechimwe nemeseji yakananga zvinova kadhi, uye zvinyorwa nemhinduro zvacho zvinova mhinduro dzekadhi, kuti maonero eChat aratidze chiteshi. Zvikwata zvinova migwagwa. Mafaira haapinzwe.
import-board-instruction-telegram: MuTelegram Desktop, vhura Settings, Advanced, Export Telegram data, sarudza chimiro cheJSON uye buritsa, wozosarudza faira re result.json, kana isa mavara aro. Hurukuro imwe neimwe inova kadhi muDirect messages, Groups kana Channels, uye meseji dzayo dzinova mhinduro dzekadhi, kuti maonero eChat aratidze hurukuro. Mifananidzo nemafaira hazvipinzwe.
import-board-instruction-whatsapp: MuWhatsApp, vhura hurukuro, sarudza Export chat isina midhiya, uye sarudza faira re .txt pano, kana isa mavara aro. Hurukuro inova kadhi rine meseji dzinova mhinduro dzaro, nemutumiri nenguva, kuti maonero eChat airatidze. Midhiya nemeseji dzesystem hazvipinzwe.
import-board-instruction-discord: Buritsa chiteshi cheDiscord neDiscordChatExporter muchimiro cheJSON uye sarudza faira re .json, kana isa mavara aro. Chiteshi chinova kadhi muchikamu chacho, uye meseji dzacho dzinova mhinduro dzekadhi, kuti maonero eChat aratidze chiteshi. Server inova mugwagwa. Zvakabatanidzwa hazvipinzwe.
import-board-instruction-rocketchat: MuRocket.Chat, buritsa data rako seJSON mu"My Data" uye sarudza faira re .zip raunotumirwa, kana faira re .json rakabudiswa rekamuri rimwe. Kamuri yega yega inova kadhi uye meseji dzayo dzinova mhinduro dzekadhi, kuti maonero eChat aratidze kamuri. Faira re .zip rinobudiswa neWeKan rechipinza CSV cheRocket.Chat rinoverengwawo.
import-board-instruction-evernote: MuEvernote, buritsa manotsi kana bhuku remanotsi sefaira re .enex uye urisarudze pano, kana isa mavara aro. Notsi imwe neimwe inova kadhi nemavara ayo, mabhokisi ayo ezvekuita serondedzero yekuongorora, mateki ayo semareberu nechiyeuchidzo chayo sezuva rekupedzisira; manotsi ane chiyeuchidzo chapera anoenda kuDone. Mifananidzo nemafaira akabatanidzwa hazvipinzwe.
import-board-instruction-trello: mu yako Trello bhodhi, go ku 'menyu', then 'zvimwe', 'Print uye tumira kunze', 'tumira kunze JSON', uye kopa the resulting mashoko.
import-board-instruction-csv: Paste mu yako Comma Separated Values(CSV)/ Tab Separated Values (TSV) .
import-board-instruction-jira: Paste the JSON kubva the Jira Cloud REST API issue tsvaga (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), kana an equivalent { "issues": [...] } object. Jira statuses become rondedzero uye issues become makadhi. Optionally include an "automationRules" array ku pinza rules.
import-board-instruction-excel: sarudza a WeKan-style .xlsx spreadsheet (the zvimwe chete columns as the Excel tumira kunze: musoro, tsananguro, mamiriro/rondedzero, nhengo, zviratidzo, dates, custom ndima). The yekutanga row iri the header.
import-board-instruction-wekan: mu yako bhodhi, go ku 'menyu', then 'tumira kunze bhodhi', uye kopa the mashoko mu the downloaded faira.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: If you get errors when importing bhodhi, sometimes importing still works, uye bhodhi iri pa mabhodhi ose peji.

Kana mafaira asarudzwa pano, Pinza inopinza iwo pachinzvimbo chemunda uri pamusoro.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Searches anogona include operators ku refine the tsvaga.  Operators vari specified na writing the operator zita uye ukoshi separated na a colon.  For example, an operator specification ye `list:Blocked` would limit the tsvaga ku makadhi that vari contained mu a rondedzero named *Blocked*.  If the ukoshi contains spaces kana special characters it anofanira iva enclosed mu quotation marks (e.g. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - makadhi mu mabhodhi matching the specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - makadhi mu rondedzero matching the specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - makadhi mu swimlanes matching the specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - makadhi that have a chiratidzo matching *<color>* kana *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - makadhi where *<username>* iri the card's creator
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - makadhi belonging ku a bhodhi assigned ku sangano *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - makadhi belonging ku a bhodhi assigned ku chikwata *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - makadhi which vari due up ku *<n>* mazuva kubva now.  `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ rondedzero zvose makadhi past their zuva rekupedzisira.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - makadhi which were zvagadzirwa *<n>* mazuva ago kana zvishoma
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - makadhi which were modified *<n>* mazuva ago kana zvishoma
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - where *<status>* iri one ye the following:
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - where *<field>* iri one ye `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` kana `__predicate_member__`.  Placing a `-` mu front ye *<field>* searches for the absence ye a ukoshi mu that ndima (e.g. `has:-due` searches for makadhi pasina a zuva rekupedzisira).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - where *<sort-name>* iri one ye `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` kana `__predicate_modified__`.  For a descending ronga, place a `-` mu front ye the ronga zita.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - where *<n>* iri a positive integer expressing the number ye makadhi ku iva displayed per peji.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Similar operators vari *kana*ed together.  makadhi that match chero ye the conditions will iva returned.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` would return makadhi contained mu chero rondedzero named *Blocked* kana *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Differing operators vari *uye*ed together.  chete makadhi that match zvose ye the differing operators vari returned.  `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` returns chete makadhi mu the rondedzero *Available* ne a *red* chiratidzo.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: mazuva anogona iva specified as a positive kana negative integer kana using `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` kana `__predicate_year__` for the yazvino period.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: na yakajairwa zvakachengetwa makadhi vari kwete searched.

default-save-storage-description: sarudza the storage backend where newly uploaded attachments vari saved.
mongodb-compact-description: mushure moving mafaira out ye MongoDB GridFS, the database faira pa disk does kwete shrink automatically. Running Compact reclaims freed space na rewriting the collection data. chete run this mushure bulk faira moves vari pedzisa.
mongodb-compact-warning: yambiro: Compact iri a blocking operation that anogona take several maminitsi pa large databases. pa replica sets, zvose secondaries vari compacted yekutanga (automatically), then the primary. pa single-node replica sets used for oplog (common Meteor setup), chete the primary iri compacted.
mongodb-compact-running: Running compact, this anogona take several maminitsi...
password-pwned: Pasiwedhi iyi yakamboonekwa mukubirwa kwedata. Sarudza imwe.
password-too-short: Pasiwedhi inofanira kuva nemavara __min__ kana kupfuura.
password-length-report-desc: Maakaundi akapinda nepasiwedhi ipfupi pane kureba kwakaderera. Bhurawuza chete ndiyo inoziva kureba kwepasiwedhi, saka inoshuma pasiwedhi pfupi mushure mekupinda; pasiwedhi nekureba kwayo hazvimbobvi mairi. Zvagadziriswa inguva yakachinjwa pasiwedhi yeakaundi - akaundi inopinda zvakare nepasiwedhi pfupi inoratidzwa zvakare seipfupi zvikuru.
password-min-length-description: Kupinda nepasiwedhi pfupi kwakanyorwa pazasi. Kupinda hakumborambwa nekuda kwazvo.
password-min-length-enforce-description: Pasiwedhi itsva ipfupi inorambwa, uye akaundi inopinda nepasiwedhi ipfupi inofanira kuichinja chisati chaitwa chimwe chinhu. Kuichinja kunobudisa zvikamu zvose zveakaundi. Mapasiwedhi eLDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS neSandstorm ndeevapi vawo, uye haaongororwi.
password-length-from-environment: Kukosha kwakaiswa munharaunda yesevha kuri kushanda; kuchengeta pano kunokutsiva.
password-change-required-text: Saiti iyi zvino inoda mapasiwedhi ane mavara __min__ kana kupfuura, uye yako ipfupi. Sarudza refu kuti uenderere. Ipapo zvikamu zvose zveakaundi yako zvinobudiswa, uye unopinda zvakare nepasiwedhi itsva.
password-same-as-username: Pasiwedhi haifanire kuva zita rekushandisa kana kero yetsamba yemagetsi.
if-you-already-have-an-account: If you already have an akaundi
invalid-file: If filename iri invalid, rodha kana tumidza patsva iri cancelled.

drag-board-to-workspace: Drag bhodhi ku assign ku __workspaces__ (drop pa nzvimbo yebasa mu sidebar)

accounts-lockout-settings-updated: Brute force protection marongero have yave zvagadziridzwa
admin-audit-log-info: Zvakaitwa nevatariri vesaiti: shanduko dzevashandisi, kupinda, chengetedzo nekopi yekuchengetedza, zvitsva kutanga. Mapasiwedhi nezvakavanzika hazvimbonyorwa. Zvinochengetwa kwegore.
accounts-lockout-locked-users-info: vashandisi currently locked out due ku too many failed login attempts
accounts-lockout-no-locked-users: There vari currently kwete locked vashandisi

accounts-lockout-all-users-unlocked: zvose locked vashandisi have yave unlocked

avatars-path-description: Path where avatar mafaira vari stored

filesystem-enabled-description: Use local filesystem for faira storage
s3-minio-storage-description: S3-compatible object storage: AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces uye others.
s3-force-path-style-description: Required na MinIO uye most non-AWS S3-compatible servers.
s3-sse-description: S3 inovanza nekodhi chakabatanidzwa chimwe nechimwe, avatar nekopi yekuchengetedza zvinonyorwa neWeKan, uye inozvivhura zvichiverengwa neWeKan.
s3-sse-kms-key-id: KMS key ID yeSSE-KMS (isina chinhu = kiyi yakajairwa yeakaundi)
azure-connection-string-description: Optional: use a full connection string instead ye akaundi zita uye key.
database-migration-description: Migrate text-based data (everything except attachments uye avatars, which stay pa the filesystem) between MongoDB uye FerretDB v1 (SQLite). The zvimwe database anofanira iva running uye reachable (yakajairwa ports: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; override ne WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). mushure it finishes, point MONGO_URL pa the zvimwe database uye restart WeKan (pa Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb kana =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Migrate mashoko data ku FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migration-confirm: kopa zvose text-based collections ku __db__? Attachments uye avatars pa the filesystem vari kwete affected. The target database anofanira iva running.
sandstorm-migration-description: When WeKan runs inside a Sandstorm grain, its old MongoDB 3 database iri migrated ku FerretDB v1 (SQLite) pa yekutanga launch, uye attachments uye avatars vari zvafambiswa kubva the database ku the grain's mafaira/attachments uye mafaira/avatars directories. This shows whether that migration succeeded uye how much disk space the old raw MongoDB database mafaira still use inside the grain, uye lets you dzima those raw mafaira ku free space.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: mushure a successful migration the data lives mu FerretDB uye pa the filesystem, so the old raw MongoDB 3 database mafaira anogona iva zvadzimwa ku free grain disk space. This haagoni iva undone.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: dzima the raw MongoDB 3 database mafaira ku free disk space? The data has already yave migrated ku FerretDB uye the filesystem. This haagoni iva undone.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Raw MongoDB database mafaira zvadzimwa, freed
features-desc: Zvinogoneka zvekusarudza zvinopiwa neWeKan iyi. Chinhu chisina kumakwa chinovanzwa pachiratidziro chemunhu wese. Data racho rinochengetwa uye mvumo hadzichinji.
feature-views-overview-desc: Nhamba, kuisa mumapoka zvichienderana nemunhu akapiwa basa, hurongwa hwenzira, dashibhodhi nebhodhi guru.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Rondedzero yemabasa echigadzirwa, nguva pfupi dzebasa, mushumo wenguva yebasa nekumhanya.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Basa rasara nerakapera, kuyerera kunounganidzwa, nguva yekutenderera neyekusvitsa, huwandu hwebasa rinopera, zera rebasa, zvipingamupinyi, Monte Carlo nezvimwe zviyero zvekuyerera.
feature-approval-required: Chengeta zvinogoneka zvinowedzerwa nekuvandudzwa kweWeKan zvakadzimwa kusvikira mutariri azvibatidza
feature-preview-admins: Vatariri vanoona zvakadzimwa kuti vatange vazviedza
feature-profiles-desc: Purofairi inovanza zvinogoneka zvakasarudzwa kubva kuvashandisi, zvikwata nemasangano yakapihwa. Mushandisi anoudzwa kuti ane purofairi ipi. Asina purofairi haabatwe, hapana data rinobviswa uye hapana mvumo inochinjwa.
feature-profile-notice: Purofairi yako yezvinogoneka __name__ inovanza zvinogoneka __count__. Bvunza mutariri kana uchida chimwe chazvo.
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Zvachengetwa. Mazita evashandisi aya haana kuwanikwa:
card-field-visibility-desc: Minda yeMarongero eBhodhi / Kadhi inogona kuratidzwa nemabhodhi. Munda usina kumakwa unovigwa pakadhi rega rega, kadhi diki nepaMarongero eBhodhi / Kadhi ebhodhi rega rega. Hapana data rekadhi kana marongero ebhodhi anoshanduka, uye kuumaka zvakare kunoratidza bhodhi rega rega sezvarakanga rakarongwa. Kurongeka kweminda ndekwebhodhi rega rega.
cards-loading-description: WeKan loads bhodhi makadhi automatically: a big bhodhi (over the size threshold) loads chete the makadhi currently visible (infinite scroll) plus a live count, so it stays fast uye uses zvishoma memory uye bandwidth, while smaller mabhodhi load every kadhi for the simplest, fully featured experience. There iri nothing ku configure. Operators anogona still force a mode ne the CARDS_LOADING (zvose/lazy/auto) uye CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD environment variables.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Lazy kadhi zviri kutakura iri experimental: kadhi counters uye WIP limits vari accurate, but the Calendar/Table/Gantt views uye multi-select reflect chete the makadhi loaded so far. Reload vhura mabhodhi mushure changing this.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: When yakabatidzwa, zvose links (both markdown links like [chiratidzo](url) uye raw HTML <a href> tags) vari always shown as plain, non-clickable mashoko mu every rich mashoko ndima (bhodhi uye kadhi titles, descriptions, zvirevo, checklists, etc.). This prevents misleading clickable links. yakajairwa iri off, so links stay clickable.
always-show-code-as-text: Always ratidza zvose code as plain mashoko
always-show-code-as-text-description: When yakabatidzwa, rich mashoko iri never rendered as markdown kana HTML: the entire source iri always shown as plain mashoko mu every rich mashoko ndima (bhodhi uye kadhi titles, descriptions, zvirevo, checklists, etc.). This reveals hidden content — HTML zvirevo (<!-- -->), the target ye markdown links, JavaScript uye chero zvimwe code — so zvose code iri always visible, kwete clickable, uye kwete running. yakajairwa iri off, so markdown iri rendered normally.
disable-all-import-description: When yakabatidzwa, zvose pinza features vari turned off: importing a bhodhi kubva WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea uye Forgejo, as well as cloning a bhodhi. The pinza menyu sarudzo vari hidden uye the sevha rejects chero pinza request. yakajairwa iri off.
import-max-megabytes-description: Faira hombe kupfuura ine peji rekupinza rinogamuchira, mumamegabytes. Pasina chinhu zvinoreva kuti hapana muganhu: faira inogona kukura sezvinobvumirwa nenzvimbo isina chinhu padhisiki kuti kupinza kupere. Kurodha kwese kunonyorwa padhisiki yesevha chikamu nechikamu, uye kupinza kungazadza dhisiki kunorambwa.
import-disk-full: Hapana nzvimbo yakakwana padhisiki yesevha yekupinza uku.
disable-all-export-description: When yakabatidzwa, zvose tumira kunze features vari turned off: exporting a bhodhi as WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, kana ku NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, uye single-chinamatidzwa tumira kunze. The tumira kunze menyu sarudzo vari hidden uye the sevha rejects chero tumira kunze request. yakajairwa iri off.
disable-import-avatars-description: When yakabatidzwa, avatars (mushandisi profile pictures) vari never zvapinzwa. This covers WeKan JSON pinza, Trello pinza, uye avatar sync kubva external identity providers pa login (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Names uye zvimwe data vari still zvapinzwa; chete avatars vari skipped. yakajairwa iri off.
disable-export-avatars-description: When yakabatidzwa, avatars (mushandisi profile pictures) vari never included when exporting a bhodhi (WeKan JSON uye CSV tumira kunze). Usernames uye zvimwe data vari still exported; chete avatars vari omitted. yakajairwa iri off.
anonymize-import-users-description: When yakabatidzwa, importing a WeKan JSON bhodhi replaces every zvapinzwa user's zita remushandisi, full zita uye initials ne counter placeholders (user1, user2, ...), drops their avatar, uye rewrites @zita remushandisi mentions (uye the requested-by / assigned-by ndima) inside zvapinzwa kadhi uye chirevo content. kwete real mushandisi identity kubva the source bhodhi iri stored. The word "mushandisi" follows the mutauro ye the person importing. yakajairwa iri off.
anonymize-export-users-description: When yakabatidzwa, exporting a bhodhi replaces every exported user's zita remushandisi, full zita uye initials ne counter placeholders (user1, user2, ...), drops their avatar, uye rewrites @zita remushandisi mentions (uye the requested-by / assigned-by ndima) inside kadhi uye chirevo content. The exported faira carries kwete real mushandisi identity. The word "mushandisi" follows the mutauro ye the person exporting. yakajairwa iri off.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: When yakabatidzwa, exporting a bhodhi replaces every exported user's zita remushandisi, full zita uye initials ne counter placeholders (user1, user2, ...), drops their avatar, uye rewrites @zita remushandisi mentions (uye the requested-by / assigned-by ndima) inside kadhi uye chirevo content. The exported faira carries kwete real mushandisi identity. The word "mushandisi" follows the mutauro ye the person exporting. yakajairwa iri off.
disable-activities-description: When yakabatidzwa, activity-feed entries vari never recorded uye never shown anywhere (bhodhi sidebar uye kadhi chiitiko tab). kwete nhoroondo ye who did what iri kept. yakajairwa iri off.
disable-notifications-description: When yakabatidzwa, WeKan never sends watch zviziviso (in-app, email kana zvimwe services) for chero chiitiko. Activities anogona still iva recorded (unless also yakadzimwa above); chete the zviziviso vari suppressed. yakajairwa iri off.
disable-watch-description: When yakabatidzwa, the watch feature iri turned off — vashandisi haagoni subscribe ku mabhodhi, rondedzero kana makadhi ku receive zviziviso, uye chero attempt ku chinja a watch level iri rejected. yakajairwa iri off.
backup-description: Gadzira kopi yekuchengetedza yemafaira akabatanidzwa, mifananidzo yevashandisi uye/kana mashoko (miunganidzwa yese yemashoko akanyorwa isiri mafaira akabatanidzwa kana mifananidzo yevashandisi). Faira re-.zip rinotumirwa zvakananga kunzvimbo yekuchengetera yakasarudzwa, pasina faira renguva pfupi, se-backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, riine YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars uye /data. Nzvimbo dzekuchengetera mugore (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) dzinoshandisa mashoko ekupinda akaiswa mumatabhu adzo ekuchengetera.
backup-scope-description: The whole instance, kana one sangano. An sangano's backup contains its mabhodhi uye everything pa them, including the attachments ye those mabhodhi — but kwete mushandisi accounts uye kwete instance marongero, because those vari shared na every sangano. Restoring an sangano's backup chete ever writes ku mabhodhi that sangano owns.
theme-override-all-tenants: Override that applies ku zvose tenants
continuous-backup-description: Inotumira shanduko yese mudura remashoko, mumafaira akabatanidzwa, mumifananidzo yevashandisi nemuzvinyorwa zvezviitiko kuforodha mumasekonzi mashoma, kuti zvikwanise kudzorerwa kumamiriro enguva ipi zvayo. Inoshanda pamwe nekopi yekuchengetedza yakarongerwa nguva, iyo inogadzira matura akazara.
continuous-backup-enabled: Mhanyisa kopi yekuchengetedza inoenderera paseva iyi
continuous-backup-target: Forodha yekuenda (nzira yakazara pane rimwe dhisiki, panzvimbo inogovaniswa panetiweki kana panzvimbo yakabatanidzwa ne-rclone)
wekan-data-no-database: Hapana dura remashoko reWeKan rinoverengeka rawanikwa.
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Mapeji e-SQLite (mapeji akachinja panguva imwe neimwe)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Hapana injini yedura remashoko inogona kushanda paseva iyi
continuous-backup-base-every: Gadzira kopi itsva yekutanga nguva nenguva (maawa)
continuous-backup-key-file: Faira rekiyi yekuvanza nekodhi (nzira yakazara kunze kweforodha yekuenda; mavara 64 enhamba dzepahwaro hwe16 kana mutsara wepachivande une mavara anokwana 16 kana kupfuura). Chengeta kopi: pasina iyo, kopi yekuchengetedza haigoni kudzorerwa.
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Faira redura remashoko re-SQLite (rinogadzirwa padivi pekopi yekuchengetedza, harimbonyori pamusoro pefaira riri kushandiswa)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Shandisa dura remashoko re-SQLite rakavakwazve pakutangazve kunotevera (dura rekare rinenge ratsiviwa richachengetwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Dzorera chizvarwa chakasarudzwa kumamiriro enguva yakasarudzwa? Kopi yekuchengetedza inoenderera ichambomira panguva yekudzoreredza.
backup-restore-select-first: sarudza a backup kubva the rondedzero yekutanga.
backup-restore-confirm: Dzorera kopi yekuchengetedza yakasarudzwa? Mafaira akabatanidzwa nemifananidzo yevashandisi zvichanyorwa muhurongwa hwemafaira, uye mashoko achanyorwa mudura remashoko maererano nemaitiro akasarudzwa.
gcs-key-filename-description: Optional: path ku a service akaundi JSON key faira pa the sevha.
gcs-credentials-description: Optional: paste the service akaundi JSON key. Leave blank ku use the key faira kana yakajairwa credentials.
gcs-permissions-note: Give WeKan's service akaundi read/write access ku the bucket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → yako bucket → mvumo → Grant access. mu "itsva principals", paste the service akaundi email — the "client_email" ukoshi kubva yako JSON key — then sarudza the role "Storage Object mukuru" uye chengeta.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Leave blank ku keep the yazvino ukoshi.
azure-account-name-description: The zita ye yako Azure Storage akaundi.
azure-container-description: The blob container ku store mafaira mu.
gcs-bucket-description: The zita ye the Cloud Storage bucket ku store mafaira mu.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: leave blank (uses the region endpoint). S3-compatible: the Endpoint URL kubva yako MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces console.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → yako bucket → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → yako bucket zita (kana gadzira bucket → Bucket zita).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → vashandisi → yako mushandisi → chengetedzo credentials → Access keys → gadzira access key → sarudza use case 'application running outside AWS' → gadzira access key. Shown as 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: zvimwe chete screen as the Access key ID; 'Secret access key' iri shown chete once when the key iri zvagadzirwa — kopa it then (kana dhaunirodha .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → yako akaundi → zita shown pa the top (also under chengetedzo + networking → Access keys → Storage akaundi zita).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → yako akaundi → chengetedzo + networking → Access keys → key1 → ratidza → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → yako akaundi → chengetedzo + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → ratidza.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → yako akaundi → Data storage → Containers → yako container (kana + Container ku gadzira one).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → project selector pa the top → yako project's ID (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → yako bucket zita (kana gadzira ku make one).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Path pa the WeKan sevha ku the downloaded service akaundi JSON key faira (zvagadzirwa below). Use this kana paste the JSON into the ndima below.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & mukuru → Service accounts → yako service akaundi → Keys → wedzera key → gadzira itsva key → JSON → gadzira (downloads the faira). Paste its contents here, kana chengeta the faira uye set its path above.
cloud-settings-desc: Ne WeKan mu Weddy, Cloud Panel inoshandira madomeni mazhinji e WeKan kubva pasevha imwe, rimwe nerimwe rine data raro. Pa domeni re Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin anotonga madomeni ne CloudFlare.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel ndeye SuperAdmin chete, pa domeni re Cloud Panel.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ne kiyi ye CloudFlare API, domeni ine zone iri muakaundi yako ye CloudFlare inowana rekodhi ye DNS inopfuura ne proxy uye chitupa che CloudFlare Origin. Mamwe madomeni anowana chitupa che Let's Encrypt. Kiyi inochengetwa pasevha uye haichazombofa yakaratidzwa.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Hapana kiyi ye CloudFlare API yakachengetwa: domeni yega yega inowana chitupa che Let's Encrypt.
attachment-move-storage-azure: fambisa chinamatidzwa ku Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: fambisa chinamatidzwa ku Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Use MongoDB GridFS for faira storage
migration-stop-confirm: une chokwadi here you want ku stop zvose migrations?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: ku have attachments uye avatars visible, fambisa them kubva CollectionFS ku chero zvimwe Storage.
s3-access-key-description: AWS S3 access key for kusimbisa
s3-bucket-description: S3 bucket zita for storing mafaira
s3-enabled-description: Use AWS S3 kana MinIO for faira storage
s3-endpoint-description: S3 endpoint URL (e.g., s3.amazonaws.com kana minio.example.com)
s3-secret-key-description: AWS S3 secret key for kusimbisa
writable-path-description: Base directory path for faira storage
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Performs comprehensive checks uye fixes for bhodhi data integrity, including rondedzero ordering, kadhi positions, uye mukoto structure.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Safely deletes empty duplicate rondedzero. chete removes rondedzero that have kwete makadhi uye have another rondedzero ne the zvimwe chete musoro that contains makadhi.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Finds uye restores makadhi uye rondedzero ne missing swimlaneId kana listId. Creates a 'Lost makadhi' mukoto ku make zvose lost items visible zvakare.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Restores zvose zvakachengetwa swimlanes, rondedzero, uye makadhi. Automatically fixes chero missing swimlaneId kana listId ku make items visible.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Detects uye repairs missing kana corrupted rondedzero mu the bhodhi structure.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Updates avatar URLs for bhodhi nhengo ku use the correct storage backend uye fixes broken avatar references.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Updates zvose faira chinamatidzwa URLs pa bhodhi iri ku use the correct storage backend uye fixes broken faira references.
migrations-admin-only: chete bhodhi administrators anogona run migrations
migrations-description: Run data integrity checks uye repairs for bhodhi iri. Each migration anogona iva executed individually.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: This will perform a comprehensive migration ku check uye fix bhodhi data integrity. This anogona take a few moments. Continue?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: This will yekutanga convert chero shared rondedzero ku per-mukoto rondedzero, then dzima empty rondedzero that have a duplicate rondedzero ne the zvimwe chete musoro containing makadhi. chete truly redundant empty rondedzero will iva zvabviswa. Continue?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: This will gadzira a 'Lost makadhi' mukoto uye dzorera zvose makadhi uye rondedzero ne missing swimlaneId kana listId. This chete affects non-archived items. Continue?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: This will dzorera zvose zvakachengetwa swimlanes, rondedzero, uye makadhi, making them visible zvakare. chero items ne missing IDs will iva automatically fixed. This haagoni iva easily undone. Continue?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: This will detect uye repair missing kana corrupted rondedzero mu the bhodhi structure. Continue?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: This will gadziridza avatar URLs for bhodhi nhengo ku use the correct storage backend. Continue?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: This will gadziridza zvose faira chinamatidzwa URLs pa bhodhi iri ku use the correct storage backend. Continue?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: kwete lost swimlanes, rondedzero, kana makadhi ku dzorera
migration-progress-note: ndapota mira while we migrate yako bhodhi ku the latest structure...
conversion-info-text: This conversion iri performed once per bhodhi uye improves performance. unogona continue using the bhodhi normally.
converting-board-description: Converting bhodhi structure for improved functionality. This anogona take a few moments.
migration-batch-size-description: Number ye attachments ku process mu each batch (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Misa kutamisa kwechinguva kana kushandiswa kweCPU kwapfuura chikamu ichi muzana (10-90)
migration-info-text: Database migrations vari performed once uye improve sisitimu performance. The process continues mu the kumashure even if you vhara yako browser.
migration-warning-text: Please do kwete vhara yako browser during migration. The process will continue mu the kumashure but anogona take longer ku pedzisa.

list-sync-description: Chengetedza rungano urwu ruchivandudzwa kubva kune chinocherechedza chekunze. Basa remuseri rinotarisa mazuva ega ega mumaminetsi gumi nemashanu; shandisa "Sync manje" kutarisa ikozvino.
drag-to-reorder: Dhonza kuti uchinje kurongeka. Mabhatani emiseve yokumusoro neyokuzasi anofambisa nzvimbo imwe.
map-view-empty: Bhodhi iri harisati rine mufananidzo wemepu. Mutarisiri webhodhi anogona kukwidza mumwe - purani yepasi pechivako, mepu yenzvimbo kana mufananidzo wakadhirowewa - uye makadhi anogona kuzoiswa pairi.
map-view-place-hint: Dhonza kadhi uchiisa pamepu, kana kurisarudza wobva wadzvanya parinofanira kuiswa.
flow-error: Hatina kukwanisa kurodha mushumo. Tarisa zvawaisa woedza zvakare.
flow-note-agingWip: Makadhi asati apera: mazuva kubva paakapinda muchikamu chazvino. Mabhawa matsvuku anopfuura nguva iyo 85% yenguva dzekugara dzakambonyorwa muchikamu ichocho dziri pasi payo (panofanira kuva nenguva dzisiri pasi peshanu). Kana nhoroondo yekupinda isipo, nguva yacho haizivikanwi.
flow-note-blockerAnalysis: Nhoroondo yekuvimba nemamwe mabasa inopa nguva dzekutanga nekuguma kwekuvharirwa pachikamu chimwe nechimwe. Mavambo ezvinobatanidza zvekare anogona kusazivikanwa. Makadhi akadzimwa anoda mifananidzo yenhoroondo yakachengetwa. Zvikonzero zvinoitika panguva imwe zvinoverengwa zvakasiyana.
flow-note-monteCarlo: Miedzo 2,000 inosarudza mazuva akazara ekarenda yeUTC, kusanganisira mazuva asina basa rakapera. Mazuva anofungidzirwa achishandisa muganhu wepamusoro; huwandu hunovimbiswa huchishandisa muganhu wepasi. Zvinofungidzira kuti mwero wekupedza mabasa uchafanana mune ramangwana; haisi vimbiso. Nguva yakareba kupfuura dzese: mazuva 3,650. Kana pasina mabasa apera, hapana fungidziro.
flow-note-processBehavior: XmR: Nguva yeMazano; Tanga → zvapedzwa. n ≥ 2. X: x̄ ± 3 × MR̄ / 1.128; MR: 0…3.267 × MR̄.
flow-note-sizeCycleTime: Fungidziro yazvino yepoker yekuronga kana munda mumwe wenhamba wawakagadzira, zvichienzaniswa nenguva yekupedza basa mumazuva. Fungidziro dzisipo nemazuva asina kururama hazvibatanidzwi. Kana zuva rekutanga risipo, panoshandiswa rekugadzira; kana zuva rekuguma risipo, panoshandiswa rekuchengetwa mudura.
time-adjustment-note: Shanduko kumaawa akanyorwa, dzakarongwa nemunhu ari kugadzirisa huwandu hwese. Idzi hadzisi nguva dzebasa dzemunhu mumwe nemumwe. Nhamba dziri pasi pezero kugadzirisa. Nguva yekare isina kunyorwa haigoni kupihwa kumunhu.

blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_TOOLTIP: Inodzorera nhamba yenzvimbo panotanga/panopedzisira kuoneka mavara ekutanga mukati memavara echipiri. Inodzorera %1 kana mavara asina kuwanikwa.
blockly-TEXT_ISEMPTY_TOOLTIP: Inodzorera chokwadi kana mavara akapiwa asina chinhu.
blockly-TEXT_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Gadzira mavara nekubatanidza chero nhamba yezvinhu.
blockly-TEXT_LENGTH_TOOLTIP: Inodzorera nhamba yemabhii (kusanganisira nzvimbo dzisina mavara) mumavara akapiwa.
blockly-TEXT_PRINT_TOOLTIP: Budisa mavara, nhamba kana kumwe kukosha kwakatarwa.
blockly-TEXT_REPLACE_TOOLTIP: Tsiva pose panowanikwa mavara mukati memamwe mavara.
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_BOTH: bvisa nzvimbo dzisina mavara kumativi ose e
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_LEFT: bvisa nzvimbo dzisina mavara kuruboshwe kwe
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_RIGHT: bvisa nzvimbo dzisina mavara kurudyi kwe
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_TOOLTIP: Dzorera kopi yemavara yabviswa nzvimbo dzisina mavara kune rimwe kana kumativi ose.
blockly-VARIABLES_SET_TOOLTIP: Inoisa chinotsiviwa nemashoko ichi kuti chienzane nezvinopinzwa.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS: Chinotsiviwa nemashoko chine zita rekuti '%1' chatovapo.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_ANOT: Chinotsiviwa nemashoko chine zita rekuti '%1' chatovapo cherumwe rudzi: '%2'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_A_PA: Chinotsiviwa nemashoko chine zita rekuti '%1' chatovapo sechinopinzwa mubasa rekodhi '%2'.
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Tsvaga munzvimbo yekushandira. Dzvanya Enter kuenda kune chinotevera chinoenderana, Shift+Enter kune chakapfuura chinoenderana. Dzvanya Escape kuvhara kutsvaga uye kutarisa chinoenderana chazvino.
r-blocks-help: Batanidza chinokonzera chimwe nechiito chimwe. Dhonza mabhuroko kubva mubhokisi rezvishandiso. Shandisa chigadziriso chefomu pazvisarudzo zvepamusoro.
r-blocks-unavailable: Mashoko emutemo haawanikwi. Shandisa chigadziriso chefomu kuongorora mutemo uyu.
r-blocks-invalid: Batanidza chinokonzera chimwe chete nechiito chimwe chete. Bvisa mabhuroko asina kubatana kana akawandisa usati wachengeta.
r-blocks-conflict: Mutemo uyu wachinja pawanga uchigadzirisa. Rodhazve mutemo wakachengetwa usati wachengeta.
r-blocks-permission: Mvumo yemutarisiri webhodhi inodiwa kugadzirisa mitemo.
scrum-policy-doneLists: Kadhi riri murondedzero iri muboka reZvapedzwa
scrum-edit-sprint: Gadzira kana gadzirisa nguva pfupi yebasa yakarongwa
scrum-releases-select-help: Kadhi rinogona kuva muzvaburitswa zvakati wandei. Bata Ctrl (Cmd paMac) kuti usarudze zvinopfuura chimwe; bvisa zvese kuti ubvise kadhi pachaburitswa chese.
scrum-select-sprint: Sarudza nguva pfupi yebasa kuti uone mushumo wayo.
scrum-backlog-help: Ronga mabasa nenhanho yawo murondedzero yeakamirira kuitwa. Isa makadhi munguva pfupi yebasa yakarongwa kana iri kushanda.
scrum-no-closed-sprints: Hapana chinyorwa chakachengetwa chenguva pfupi yebasa yakavharwa.
scrum-report-help: Mishumo inochengeta fungidziro dziri muzvinyorwa zvakachengetwa zvenguva pfupi dzebasa. Fungidziro dzisingazivikanwi dzinoverengwa padzo dzoga; hadzisi fungidziro dzezero. Enzanisa mwero webasa rinopedzwa chete kana zviyero zvefungidziro nemitemo zvichifanana.
scrum-confirm-close: Vhara nguva pfupi yebasa iyi uye chengeta zvabuda mairi? Makadhi asina kupera achaendeswa kunzvimbo yakasarudzwa.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Kanzura nguva pfupi yebasa iyi? Makadhi ayo acharamba ari mairi kusvikira aiswa kumwe.
scrum-partial-report: Mushumo usina kuzara: unongosanganisira makadhi awakapiwa pari zvino chete.
scrum-partial-snapshot: Nguva pfupi yebasa iyi ine chikamu chete chechinyorwa chepakutanga chakachengetwa.
scrum-resume-close: Enderera nekuvhara nguva pfupi yebasa kwakambomiswa
scrum-rollover-progress: Kufambisa makadhi enguva pfupi yebasa mberi: __done__ pa __total__
scrum-history-job-running: Kudzosera shanduko huru kumashure kana kuiitazve: __done__ pamitsara yenhoroondo __total__
scrum-history-job-failed: Kudzosera shanduko huru kumashure kana kuiitazve kwamira. Dzvanya dzosera kumashure kana itazve zvakare kuti uenderere mberi:
scrum-daily-observations-help: Bhawa rimwe nerimwe rinoratidza zvakatanga kunyorwa pazuva reUTC, panguva yakaratidzwa. Mazuva asina zvinyorwa haasanganisirwi. Zvakaonekwa izvi hazvinyori shanduko dzose kana kuratidza huwandu hwekupera kwezuva. Fungidziro dzisingazivikanwi hadzisi zero. Shandisa chiito chekuburitsa chechikamu chino pazvakaonekwa zuva nezuva; chiito chekuburitsa chiri pabhawa rezvishandiso chinoburitsa zvabuda munguva pfupi yebasa.
scrum-daily-truncated: Zvakaonekwa 366 zvichangobva kunyorwa chete ndizvo zvinoratidzwa.
scrum-daily-empty: Hapana zvakaonekwa zuva nezuva zvakanyorwa zvenguva pfupi yebasa iyi.
scrum-scope-history: Huwandu hwebasa nebasa rasara, shanduko imwe neimwe
scrum-scope-history-help: Zvakavakwazve kubva munhoroondo yebhodhi kubva pakatanga nguva pfupi yebasa: mutsara mumwe pashanduko imwe neimwe yemakadhi, fungidziro kana basa rapera zvenguva iyi.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Nhoroondo haigadzirizve mufananidzo wemamiriro enguva pfupi yebasa iyi pachayo: dzimwe shanduko dzakaitwa dzisina kunyorwa munhoroondo, saka zvikoshi izvi hazvina kukwana.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Shanduko dzekutanga chete ndidzo dzakagona kuverengwa; kuvakwazve hakuna kukwana.
scrum-scope-history-empty: Hapana shanduko kubva pakatanga nguva pfupi yebasa.
scrum-scope-cause-scrum: Kuva muchikamu chenguva pfupi yebasa kwachinja
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Zvakatanga kunyorwa pazuva rimwe nerimwe reUTC; mazuva asina zvinyorwa haasanganisirwi. Zvakaonekwa hazvinyori shanduko dzose kana huwandu hwekupera kwezuva. Fungidziro dzisingazivikanwi hadzisi zero.
scrum-import-pending: Kupinza kweScrum hakuna kupera. Kugadzirisa Scrum nekuburitsa mishumo hazviwanikwi.
scrum-import-recovery-hint: Kupinza kwakavhiringidzwa nekutangazve kunogona kupedziswa pano kana kwamira. Kana chirongwa chayo chisina kuchengetwa chose, kupinza kunogona kungokanzurwa chete; izvi hazvichinji chinhu pabhodhi.
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Sarudza kubudisa kwebhodhi reWeKan kana faira rekutamisa reScrum. Nguva pfupi dzebasa nezvaburitswa zvatova pabhodhi rino zvinobatanidzwa, hazvimbopetwi. Makadhi anoenderaniswa neID, kana nenhamba yekadhi nemusoro; makadhi asingaenderani anonyorwa uye anosiyiwa asina kushandurwa. Tanga waona kuti chii chichashanduka.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Nguva pfupi dzebasa: __created__ itsva, __matched__ dzatova pabhodhi rino, __skipped__ hadzina kupinzwa
scrum-import-preview-releases: Zvaburitswa: __created__ zvitsva, __matched__ zvatova pabhodhi rino, __skipped__ hazvina kupinzwa
scrum-import-preview-cards: Makadhi: __updated__ achavandudzwa, __unchanged__ asina kushandurwa, __unmatched__ asina kuenderana
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Hapana chekushandura: bhodhi rino ratova nehurongwa uhu.
scrum-import-into-board-done: Hurongwa hweScrum hwapinzwa uye hwanyorwa muNhoroondo.
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Kadhi rinoenderana nemakadhi anopfuura rimwe pabhodhi rino: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Kadhi nderimwe bhodhi uye rakasiyiwa risina kushandurwa: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: Nguva pfupi yebasa kana chaburitswa chinoenderana nezvinopfuura chimwe pabhodhi rino: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: Nguva pfupi yebasa, chaburitswa kana chiitiko hazvina kugona kupinzwa: __reference__
scrum-import-sprint-finished: Kadhi harina kuendeswa munguva pfupi yebasa yapera: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Sarudza kukosha pakusawirirana kumwe nekumwe. Kuyananisa kunoedzwazve mushure mesarudzo imwe neimwe. Hapana chinotumirwa kuhurongwa hwekwakabva.
sync-conflict-refresh: Mhanyisa kuyananisa zvakare kuti uongorore kukosha kwazvino.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Makadhi awakapiwa aongororwa. Hapana kusawirirana kwenzvimbo kwasara. Kuyananisa rondedzero yose hakuna kuitwa.
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Bvisa kubatana kwekuyananisa kwekopi iyi chete. Zviri mairi zvinoramba zviri muWeKan.
sync-conflict-archive: Kuisa mudura kwavharirwa nemakadhi madiki ari kushanda
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Chinhu chekwakabva hachisisipo, asi makadhi madiki ari kushanda anodzivisa kuisa mudura. Chengeta kadhi iri muno nekubvisa kubatana kwaro kwekuyananisa. Makadhi madiki haachinjwi.
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Siya kadhi rekare risina kuchinjwa uye gadzira kadhi idzva rekuyananisa murondedzero ino. Kuedzazve kunoshandisazve kadhi rinotsiva.
sync-preview-saved: Zvakavakirwa pazvirongwa zvakachengetwa. Kuyananisa zvino kunotorazve nekuongorora kwakabva.
sync-preview-unavailable: Chengeta kwakabva kwekuyananisa usati wakumbira kufanoona.
sync-preview-blocked: Gadzirisa kusawirirana kuri pasi apa usati waongorora hurongwa hweshanduko.
sync-preview-scope: Nhamba dzinoreva nzvimbo dzekwakabva dzakaiswa muchimiro chakafanana. Mamwe mashoko anogona kusiiwa nechiongorori chekwakabva.
sync-source-scope: Nzira dzinounganidza kuoneka kwenzvimbo pazvinhu zvekwakabva. Zvinhu zvisina kubatanidzwa zvinotaurwa sezvakazara; kukosha kwazvo hakuratidzwi.
sync-source-converted: Zvakashandurwa kuva mavara kana chimwe chimiro
sync-source-truncated: Mushumo unogumira panzira 100 nemazita enzvimbo akapfupiswa.
sync-source-omitted: Kumwe kuoneka kuri kunze kwenzira dzakaratidzwa
sync-report-partial: Kuyananisa kwakundikana kana kusina kupera kunogona kunge kwachinja mamwe makadhi. Mishumo iyi haitangisezve kana kudzosera zvakaitwa pakuyananisa.
sync-report-unfinished: Zviri kuitwa kana zvakambomiswa; zvabuda hazvina kunyorwa
sync-report-failed: Zvakundikana; dzimwe shanduko dzinogona kunge dzaitwa
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Zvapedzwa paine nzvimbo dzakasiiwa kana kushandurwa
sync-report-unavailable: Mishumo yekuyananisa inoda mvumo yekunyora murondedzero yose uye sevha inowanika.
sync-recovery-description: Mishumo yekuyananisa yakachengetwa yemazuva 30 apfuura. Tsvaga neID yebhodhi kana yerondedzero. Kuyananisa kusina kupera kunogona kunge kuchiri kushanda kana kwakambomiswa. Rodhazve kuti utarise zvakare; mishumo iyi haigoni kutangisazve kana kudzosera shanduko.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Hazvigoni kuverenga mashoko ekuongorora kuyananisa. Tarisa mvumo yemutarisiri nekuwanika kwesevha.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Sarudza nzvimbo yenhamba ine ID yenzvimbo yeJira nechiyero chefungidziro, sezvakagadzirwa nekupinza kweJira kwakabatanidzwa. Shanduko dzemuno dzinoongororwa sekusawirirana. Kukosha kusipo kwekwakabva kunosiiwa; null yakaiswa pachena inobvisa kukosha kwakabatanidzwa.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Uremu kana fungidziro yenguva yeGitLab inonyorwa mumunda wenhamba waunosarudza. Shanduko dzemuno dzinoongororwa semakakatanwa; nyaya isina uremu inobvisa chikoshi chakabatanidzwa.
email-recovery-description: Mutsara mumwe pamugamuchiri. Tsvaga neID yemushandisi. Zviri mumashoko nenzvimbo dzetsamba dzemagetsi dzevagamuchiri hazviratidzwi. Kumbomisa kunobata mashoko aripo neachauya; kuenderera kunoedzazve mashoko akamirira iye zvino. Kukanzura kunobvisa mashoko akaiswa mumutsara kusvika panguva yechikumbiro. Kana kutumira kuchiri kuitwa, edzazve munguva pfupi. Mashoko ari kutotumirwa haagoni kudzoserwa, uye kutumira kusina chokwadi kunogona kudzokororwa. Kukundikana kwechigarire nekusvika pamuganhu wekuedzazve zvinoramba zviripo kuti zviongororwe. Kuedzazve mashoko akundikana kunotanga denderedzwa idzva rekuedza uye kunoremekedza kumbomiswa kuripo.
email-recovery-empty: Hapana mashoko akamirira kana vagamuchiri vakambomiswa.
email-recovery-unavailable: Hazvigoni kuverenga mutsara wetsamba dzemagetsi. Tarisa mvumo yemutarisiri nekuwanika kwesevha.
email-recovery-busy: Kutumira kana chimwe chiito pamutsara chiri kuitwa. Rodhazve woedzazve munguva pfupi.
email-recovery-failed: Chiito hachina kukwanisa kusimbiswa. Rodhazve mutsara woedzazve chiito ichocho kana zvichidiwa.
email-recovery-superseded: Chiito chitsva chemushandisi anotarisira chatsiva chikumbiro ichi. Mamiriro emutsara azvino ndiwo ari kuratidzwa.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Kanzura mashoko ose akamirira kutumirwa kumugamuchiri uyu pari zvino? Zviri maari zvichabviswa uye hazvigoni kudzorerwa. Mashoko matsva agadzirwa mushure mechikumbiro ichi anochengetwa.
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Mugamuchiri haawanikwi kana akaundi yakadzimwa kushanda
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Kutumirwa hakuna kukwanisa kusimbiswa; ongorora usati waedzazve
sync-time-estimate-hint: Fungidziro dzenguva dzinoshandisa nzvimbo dzenhamba dzenguva yepakutanga/yasara dzakagadzirwa nekupinza kweJira. Nzvimbo imwe chete inoenderana inofanira kuvapo pabhodhi iri. Shanduko dzemuno dzinoongororwa sekusawirirana; kukosha kusipo kwekwakabva kunosiiwa uye null yakaiswa pachena inobvisa kukosha.
sync-planning-hint: Nguva pfupi yebasa nezvaburitswa zvinoenderaniswa chete kana Scrum yabatidzwa pabhodhi rino. Nguva pfupi yebasa kana chaburitswa chisipo chinogadzirwa pabhodhi rino, nemazuva anopiwa nekwazvinobva; chiripo chinotanga chaenderaniswa neID yekwachinobva, wozoita nezita. Shanduko yehurongwa yepano inoramba iripo kusvika kwazvinobva kwashandura hurongwa hwenyaya iyoyo, uye kuenderanisa kwekutanga hakumbobvisi hurongwa.
activity-recovery-description: Zviziviso zvisina kupera zvinoedzwazve otomatiki. Ongorora zviitiko zvisipo kana zvakachinja usati waedzazve. Kuedzazve hakumbogadziri chiitiko patsva.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Hazvina kukwanisa kutora zviziviso zvezviitiko zvakamirira.
activity-recovery-busy: Mumwe mushandi ari kubata chiziviso ichi. Rodhazve woedzazve.
activity-recovery-denied: Mvumo yemugamuchiri kana zvaakasarudza pazviziviso hazvichabvumiri kutumira.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Chiitiko chepakutanga hachipo kana chachinja. Hapana chakagadzirwazve.
activity-recovery-failed: Hazvina kukwanisa kupedzisa kutumirwa kwechiziviso. Basa rakamirira rakachengetwa.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Chiziviso ichi chachinja kubva pachakatorwa. Ongorora mamiriro matsva usati waedzazve.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Hazvina kukwanisa kusimbisa chirongwa chekutumira. Rodhazve uongorore mamiriro acho azvino.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Kanzura zvachose kutumira kwasara kwechiitiko ichi? Hazvigoni kuendererwa mberi. Tsamba dzemagetsi dzatova mumutsara nezviziviso zvakatotumirwa hazvidzoserwi.
rule-email-recovery-description: Ongorora kuedza kutumira tsamba dzemagetsi dzemitemo kwakanyorwa. Kuedza kusina kusimbiswa kunogona kunge kuchiri kutumira kana kwakambomiswa. Mushumo uyu hauedzizve kana kukanzura kutumira.
rule-email-recovery-empty: Hapana kuedza kutumira tsamba dzemagetsi dzemitemo kunoenderana nekutsvaga uku.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Hazvina kukwanisa kutora kuedza kutumira tsamba dzemagetsi dzemitemo. Rodhazve kuti uedzezve.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan haizotumiri zvakare yoga email isina kusimbiswa. Kutumirazve kunoenda kune vanogamuchira vasina kusimbiswa chete. Maka kuti yatumirwa kana uchiziva kuti yasvika, kana kuti ibvise.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Kutumira kwekutanga kungave kuchiri kuenderera mberi. Unogona kusarudza mushure me __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Tumira email iyi zvakare kune vanogamuchira vasina kusimbiswa? Munhu wese ane sevha yeemail yakaigamuchira isina kuudza WeKan achaigamuchira kaviri.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Maka email iyi kuti yatumirwa kune vese? Ita izvi chete kana uchiziva kuti yasvika.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Bvisa email iyi? Haizotumirwi kune vanogamuchira vasina kusimbiswa.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Kutumira kwekutanga kungave kuchiri kuenderera mberi. Edza zvakare gare gare.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Kutumirazve kwakambotanga kungave kuchiri kuenderera mberi. Edza zvakare gare gare.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Munhu wese anogamuchira akatosimbiswa. Maka kuti yatumirwa panzvimbo pekuitumirazve.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Sevha yeemail haina kupindura. Email yakatumirwazve ingangove yasvika kana kuti haina kusvika; inoratidzwa kuti ichiri kuenderera mberi.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Mumwe mutarisiri ari kuita sarudzo pamusoro peemail iyi. Edza zvakare munguva pfupi.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Email yakachengetwa haichaenderani nekuedza uku, saka sarudzo pamusoro payo haigoni kuitwa pano.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Rekodhi rakachengetwa rekuedza uku harina kururama, saka sarudzo pamusoro paro haigoni kuitwa pano.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Hatina kukwanisa kuita sarudzo pamusoro peemail iyi. Rodhazve peji woedza zvakare.
rule-email-legacy-description: Maemail emitemo aya akagadzirwa neshanduro yekare yeWeKan isina kunyora kwakabva zviri mukati mawo, saka WeKan haizomatumiri yoga. Mushure mekuona kuti munyori wemutemo achiri nekodzero yekuwana kadhi, batanidzazve email kuti igadzirwe kubva pamamiriro ekadhi azvino, kana kuti irase.
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Gadzira email iyi zvakare kubva pamamiriro ekadhi azvino? Zviri mukati mayo zvinogona kusiyana nezvakagadzirwa kare.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Hatina kukwanisa kurodha maemail emitemo akamirira kuongororwa. Rodhazve peji kuti uedze zvakare.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Munyori wemutemo haasisina kodzero yekuwana kadhi iri, kana kuti mutemo wachinja, saka email haigoni kubatanidzwazve. Unogona kuirasa.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Chiitiko chakakonzera email iyi chachinja, saka haigoni kubatanidzwazve. Unogona kuirasa.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Kadhi rakabva email iyi harichawanikwi, saka haigoni kubatanidzwazve. Unogona kuirasa.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Rekodhi rekushanda kwemutemo wakagadzira email iyi harichachengetwi, saka haigoni kubatanidzwazve. Unogona kuirasa.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Email iyi yakatotumirwa, yakaedzwa kutumirwa kana kuti yakaraswa.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Hatina kukwanisa kupedza chiito ichi. Rodhazve peji woedza zvakare.
stuck-sync-operation-description: Rimwe nerimwe remabasa aya akachengetwa ekuenderanisa rondedzero rakamira pakati uye harichagone kupedzwa, nekuti rondedzero yaro yakabviswa, yakagadzirwa patsva kana kurongwa zvimwe, kana kuti mushandisi akaritanga akarasikirwa nemvumo yekunyora. Kana rimwe richimirira, rondedzero iyoyo haigone kuenderaniswa. Rirase kuti rondedzero igone kuenderaniswa zvakare: shanduko dzakatoshandiswa dzinoramba dziripo, shanduko dzakachengetwa dzakasara hadzimbonyorwi, uye kuenderanisa kunotevera kunofananidza rondedzero nekwainobva zvakare.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Rondedzero yakabviswa, yakagadzirwa patsva kana marongero ayo ekuenderanisa akachinja
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Mushandisi akaritanga haachina mvumo yekunyora parondedzero yese
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Rakachengetwa neshanduro yekare yeWeKan pasina zvakaritanga
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Rinogona kudzokororwa izvozvi uye richapera roga, saka harigone kuraswa.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Rasa basa iri rakachengetwa rekuenderanisa rondedzero? Shanduko dzaratoshandisa dzinoramba dziripo; dzakasara hadzimbonyorwi. Rondedzero inobva yagona kuenderaniswa zvakare.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Hapana mabasa ekuenderanisa marondedzero akamirira kuongororwa.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Ekare-kare makumi mashanu (50) chete ndiwo anoratidzwa. Rasa mamwe wozorodza kuti uone mamwe.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Mabasa ekuenderanisa marondedzero haana kugona kurodha. Zorodza kuti uedze zvakare.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Basa iri harina kuwanikwa rakamira, saka harigone kuraswa.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Basa iri rinogona kudzokororwa izvozvi uye richapera roga, saka harina kuraswa.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Rondedzero iyi iri kuenderaniswa izvozvi. Edza zvakare munguva pfupi.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Hatina kukwanisa kupedza chiito ichi. Rodhazve peji woedza zvakare.
interrupted-import-description: Kupinzwa kwebhodhi kwega kwega uku kwakamira pakati - sevha yakatangazve, kana kupinza kwakakundikana - uye kwakasiya bhodhi risina kukwana. Kupinza hakugone kuenderera mberi, nekuti faira rakwakabva harichengetwi. Chengeta bhodhi sezvariri, kana rirase wopinza faira zvakare. Kurasa kunobvisa bhodhi rakagadzirwa nekupinza uku nezvese zviri pariri, kusanganisira chero chakawedzerwa kubvira ipapo.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Kuri kuraswa; rasa zvakare kuti upedze
interrupted-import-scrum: Danho rayo reScrum rine nzvimbo yaro yekuchengetedza (__state__, __next__ pamatanho __total__). Kana ukachengeta bhodhi, ripedze kana kurirasa kubva pakudzoreredza kupinza kweScrum kwebhodhi.
interrupted-import-counts: migwagwa __swimlanes__, marondedzero __lists__, makadhi __cards__, marondedzero ekuongorora __checklists__, mhinduro __comments__, zvakabatanidzwa __attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Chengeta bhodhi iri risina kukwana sezvariri? Hapana chinobviswa, uye kupinza hakuchanyorwa pano.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Rasa kupinza uku? Bhodhi rakwakagadzira nezvese zviri pariri zvinobviswa zvachose.
interrupted-import-empty: Hapana kupinzwa kwemabhodhi kwakavhiringidzwa kwakamirira kuongororwa.
interrupted-import-truncated: Ekare-kare makumi mashanu (50) chete ndiwo anoratidzwa. Chengeta kana rasa mamwe wozorodza kuti uone mamwe.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Kupinzwa kwemabhodhi kwakavhiringidzwa hakuna kugona kurodha. Zorodza kuti uedze zvakare.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Bhodhi rine id iyi harina kugadzirwa nekupinza uku, saka harina kubatwa.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Danho rayo reScrum richiri kunyorwa kana kudzoreredzwa. Edza zvakare mushure memaminitsi mashoma.
interrupted-import-failed: Hatina kukwanisa kupedza chiito ichi. Rodhazve peji woedza zvakare.
saml-login-not-started: Kupinda uku kweSAML hakuna kutangwa mutabhu ino yebhurawuza. Ndapota pinda zvakare.
history-request-pending-undo: Kudzosera kwako kwekupedzisira hakusati kwasimbiswa nesevha.
history-request-pending-redo: Kuitazve kwako kwekupedzisira hakusati kwasimbiswa nesevha.
history-request-hint: Kuedzazve kunodzokorora chikumbiro chimwe chete, saka hakugoni kudzosa shanduko yechipiri.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Kudzosera, kuitazve kana kudzoreredza shanduko dzeScrum kwakamira panokonana. Kugadzirisa kweScrum pabhodhi rino kwakavharwa kusvika izvi zvagadziriswa.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Shanduko __applied__ pa__total__ dzakanyorwa, __pending__ hadzina, uye __conflicted__ dzakashandurwa nemumwe munhu kubvira ipapo.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Kudzosera kunodzorera rekodhi yega yega yakashandurwa sezvayanga yakaita kare; kunopiwa chete kana pasina mumwe akashandura marekodhi iwayo kubvira ipapo. Kuchengeta bhodhi sezvariri kunobvisa basa rakamira uye hakushanduri rekodhi. Chero zvazvingava, zvinonyorwa muPeneri yevatariri, Problems, Recovery.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Chengeta rekodhi yega yega sezvairi izvozvi, kusanganisira shanduko dzakatonyorwa nebasa rakamira?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Mutariri webhodhi anogona kuridzosera kana kuchengeta bhodhi sezvariri.
login-setting-after-restart: Zvichatanga kushanda mushure mekunge WeKan yatangwazve
login-setting-env-only: Nharaunda yesevha chete ndiyo inoisa izvi. Zvinoratidzwa pano zvekuverenga chete.
email-to-card-description: Tsamba yemagetsi inotumirwa kukero yebhodhi rako inova kadhi pabhodhi iroro.
email-to-card-webhook: URL yewebhook inopinda yemupi wetsamba (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark kana MIME relay isina kugadziriswa)
email-to-card-secret-saved: Yachengetedzwa - siya isina chinhu kuti irambe iripo
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Bhodhi rinoenda tsamba dzinotumirwa kugrain iyi
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Hapana - tsamba chete dzine chiratidzo chebhodhi mumusoro wenyaya
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Isa izvi mumusoro wenyaya kuti usvike pabhodhi iri sewe pachako:
email-to-card-your-address: Kero yako yetsamba yemagetsi yebhodhi iri
email-to-card-address-private: Ichengete yakavanzika: chero ani anayo anogona kuwedzera makadhi sewe.
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Kugamuchira tsamba dzemagetsi hakuna kugadzirirwa muPeneri yevatariri.
