email-to-card-off-board-off: Mutariri webhodhi haana kubatidza tsamba dzemagetsi pabhodhi iri.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Wadzima makero emabhodhi ako muMarongero eNhengo.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain haisati yava nekero yayo yetsamba yemagetsi. Rodha peji zvakare.
inbound-account-invalid: Bhokisi retsamba reIMAP rinoda zita resevha rakakodzera.
feature-views-email-desc: Bhodhi sebhokisi retsamba: rondedzero yetsamba yemagetsi ndiyo Dzapinda, marondedzero mafoodha, mareberu mareberu, uye nhengo dzinonyora nekupindura tsamba kubva pakero yebhodhi.
email-view-not-receiving: Bhodhi iri harisati ragamuchira tsamba. Rivhure muZvirongwa zveziviso zvebhodhi → Tsamba yemagetsi kukadhi.
email-view-invalid-address: Imwe yemakero haisi kero yetsamba yemagetsi yakakodzera.
email-view-too-many-recipients: Vagamuchiri makumi maviri chete pashoko rimwe.
email-view-too-many: Tsamba dzakawandisa dzatumirwa muawa rapfuura. Edza zvakare gare gare.
feature-views-chat-desc: Bhodhi senzvimbo yehurukuro: nzvimbo dzebasa, mabhodhi, migwagwa, marondedzero nemakadhi semuti wemachanera, kadhi pakati uye mhinduro dzayo semashoko ehurukuro.
chat-view-pick-card: Sarudza kadhi kubva mumachanera kuti urione pano.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Makadhi mamwe chete mumapoka akati wandei emakoramu ane mazita - nekupedzwa, kukosha, danho kana chimwe chinhu - anofambiswa pakati pemakoramu nekudhonza.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menyu yebhodhi → Mitemo inokurudzira mitemo kubva pane zvinoitwa nevanhu nemaoko kakawanda.
feature-board-summary-desc: Menyu yebhodhi → Pfupiso inoratidza zvakaitwa nemunhu wese pabhodhi muzuva kana vhiki rekupedzisira, nezvanonoka.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menyu yebhodhi → Kubva pawakapedzisira kushanya inoratidza zvakachinjwa nevamwe pabhodhi.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Kutsvaga kwese kunonzwisisa mitsara yakaita se "makadhi angu anonoka".
column-sets-empty: Hapana mapoka emakoramu parizvino. Mukuru webhodhi anogona kugadzira rimwe: ripe zita, wozowedzera makoramu aro.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Bhodhi senge GitHub kana Gitea inoteedzera nyaya: makadhi senge nyaya, mareberu nematanho, mhinduro senge hurukuro, zvakabatanidzwa senge mafaira, uye nhoroondo yebhodhi ine kudzosera.
vcs-no-milestones: Hapana matanho parizvino. Rebheru rine nguva yekupedza idanho.
vcs-no-list: Bhodhi iri harina rondedzero kana nzira yenyaya.
card-qr-code-desc: Iiskena kuti uvhure kadhi iri pafoni kana tabhuleti.
card-qr-code-too-long: Link yekadhi iri yakarebesa kodhi yeQR.
vcs-no-wiki: Hapasati pava ne wiki. Kupinza sangano re GitHub kunounza wiki yedura rekodhi pano.
github-org-import-desc: Dura rega rega resangano kana remushandisi rinova bhodhi raro, rinovhurwa mu bhodhi View / Kutonga shanduro: nyaya dzaro nemhinduro, mareberu nemafaira azvo, zvakaburitswa naro, mafambiro ebasa e GitHub Actions seMitemo, ne wiki yaro.
github-org-import-token-hint: Inodiwa kumadura akavanzika uye muganho we API wakakwirira. Inoshandiswa chete panguva yekupinza uye haichengetwe.
github-org-import-actions: Mafambiro ebasa e GitHub Actions seMitemo
github-org-import-result: %s nyaya, %s zvakaburitswa, %s mitemo, %s mapeji e wiki
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Nyora zita resangano kana remushandisi, kana kero yaro ye GitHub.
optional-apis-desc: Ma-REST API akaita sema-API evamwe matracker, kuti maapp nemascript avo agone kushandisa WeKan iyi sebackend yavo: zvavanochengetedza zvinochengetwa muWeKan, pamabhodhi eWeKan. Imwe neimwe yakadzimwa kusvikira yasarudzwa pano. Hapana ine kodzero dzayo: mutengi anopinda neWeKan API token uye anogona kuona nekuchinja chete zvinogona kuonwa nekuchinjwa nemunhu iyeye muWeKan. Dzese dzinoda kuti WeKan REST API ive yakabatidzwa (WITH_API=true). Kero iri pazasi peimwe neimwe ndiyo inoshandiswa nemutengi sesevha yake.
optional-api-trello-desc: Maapp nemascript akanyorerwa REST API yeTrello (semuenzaniso Trellinator) anoshanda neWeKan: mabhodhi, marondedzero, makadhi, mareberu, nhengo, mhinduro nemarondedzero ekuongorora. Token yeTrello iWeKan API token. Kudzima kadhi kunoriendesa kudura muWeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Vatengi veREST API v2 yeJira vanoshanda neWeKan: purojekiti ibhodhi (kiyi yayo ndiyo kiyi yebhodhi), nyaya ikadhi (DEV-7), mamiriro irondedzero, uye shanduko inofambisa kadhi. Kutsvaga kunogamuchira JQL iri nyore: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text uye ORDER BY. Pinda neWeKan API token sepassword. Kudzima nyaya kunoiendesa kudura.
optional-api-github-desc: Vatengi veREST API yeGitHub yenyaya vanoshanda neWeKan: repository ibhodhi, nyaya ikadhi, nemareberu, matanho (mareberu ane zuva rekupedzisira), mhinduro, uye yakavhurika kana yakavharwa sekuKutonga shanduro. Token iWeKan API token.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Vatengi veREST API yeGitea neForgejo yenyaya vanoshanda neWeKan, nenzira imwechete seAPI inowirirana neGitHub: repository ibhodhi uye nyaya ikadhi. Token iWeKan API token.
bots-none: Hapana mabhoti parizvino. Bhoti ichimhanyisi pasevha yako - mumiriri weAI, basa reCI, script - iro bhodhi rino rinopa makadhi.
bot-option-not-found: Mhinduro iyoyo haisi imwe yeakapihwa nebhoti.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Mawebhook anobuda haabvumirwe kusvika kumakero ari pa network yeWeKan pachayo, kuti pasava nemunhu angakwanisa kunongedza webhook yebhodhi kubasa remukati. Nyora pano mahost ari pa network iyoyo anobvumirwa kusvikwa nemawebhook - Node-RED, server yekukurukura - imwe pamutsara, sezita kana kero, ine port kuti ibvumire port iyoyo chete. Pasina: hapana. Vatariri vesaiti chete ndivo vanogona kushandura runyorwa urwu.
account-webhook-desc: Kero imwe chete inoziviswa neWeKan kana mumwe munhu apinda kana akaunti itsva yagadzirwa. Hapana chinotumirwa kusvikira chiitiko chiri pazasi chasarudzwa. Inotakura chiitiko, zita remushandisi nenguva; sarudza mamwe minda chete kana anogamuchira achiida.
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Kanzura zviziviso zvese zvakamirira zvezviitiko zvakapfuura mazuva mangani?
vcs-synced-from: Zvakaenzaniswa kubva ku%s: zvivhure uye zvivhare ikoko.
vcs-synced-issue: Nyaya iyi yakaenzaniswa: ivhure uye uivhare mutracker yayo.
sync-write-back: Nyora shanduko udzosere kuGitLab: musoro, tsanangudzo, mhinduro, kuvhara nekuvhurazve
email-bounces-description: Zvinoitwa neWeKan nemaemail anodzoka: kero yakanyorwa zvisizvo, bhokisi retsamba rakazara, mhinduro yekusavapo, chichemo chespam. Rudzi rumwe nerumwe rune zviito zvarwo, zvinoitwa kana radzoka kakawanda kakadaro.
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Kero haipo: kukanganisa kwekunyora, akaundi yakadzimwa, domain isingazivikanwe.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Haina kusvika parizvino: bhokisi rakazara, server yakabatikana. Akawanda akatevedzana chete ndiwo anoreva chimwe chinhu.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Mhinduro dzekusavapo muhofisi, dzezororo kana dzesystem yematikiti. Email yakasvika.
email-bounces-ses-description: MuAmazon SES, tumira zviziviso zveBounce neComplaint, nemutemo wekugamuchira wekero inotumira WeKan, kunyaya yeSNS, uye nyoresa kero iyi kwairi kuburikidza neHTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: MaARN enyaya dzeSNS anogamuchirwa, rimwe pamutsara
email-bounces-clear-hint: Kanganwa kudzoka kwekero iyi uye utumire kwairi maemail zvakare
email-bounces-providers-description: Kana WeKan ichitumira kuburikidza neimwe yemasevhisi aya, ibatidze, ipa sevhisi kero iyi yewebhook yezviitiko zvayo zvemaemail akadzoka nezvichemo zvespam, wobva wanamira pano kiyi yainosaina nayo, kana pasiwedhi yawakaisa mukero se https://user:password@… kana ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Sevhisi yakabatidzwa inoda kiyi yayo yekusaina kana pasiwedhi.
activity-pub-enabled: Mabhodhi eruzhinji anoburitsa zviitiko zvemakadhi awo pafediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Yakadzimwa nekutanga. Kana yabatidzwa, bhodhi rega rega reruzhinji rinogona kuteverwa kubva kuMastodon nemamwe maseva efediverse se@board-<id> pakero yeWeKan iyi, uye zviitiko zvitsva zvemakadhi zvinosvika kuvateveri varo. Ndezvekuverenga chete: hapana chinotumirwa neseva yefediverse chinoshandura bhodhi, uye mabhodhi akavanzika haamboburitswe.
caldav-sync-desc: Isa mazuva ekupedzisira emakadhi ebhodhi rino mukarenda - Nextcloud Calendar kana chero karenda reCalDAV. Zuva rekupedzisira rinofambiswa mukarenda rinodzokera pakadhi. Shandisa pasiwedhi yeapp, kwete yako.
caldav-invalid-url: Kero yekarenda inofanira kuva kero ye http:// kana https://, isina zita remushandisi kana pasiwedhi mukati mayo.
caldav-not-linked: Tanga wachengeta kero yekarenda uye batidza kuenderanisa.
webdav-storage-description: Chengeta zvakabatanidzwa mufoodha paseva yeWebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud kana imwe chero ipi. Shandisa pasiwedhi yeapp yakagadzirirwa WeKan. Seva iri panetiweki yeWeKan pachayo inogona kushandiswa pano, nekuti mutariri wesaiti chete ndiye anoisa kero iyi.
sqrl-desc: Yakadzimwa pakutanga. Kana yakabatidzwa, peji rekupinda rinopa SQRL, uye nhengo dzinotanga dzawedzera chiziviso chadzo cheSQRL muMarongero enhengo. SQRL inoda kuti WeKan ive pakero ye https://.
sqrl-scan: Skena kodhi neapp yako yeSQRL, kana kuvhura purogiramu yako yeSQRL pachishandiso chino.
sqrl-expired: Kodhi iyi yeSQRL yapera nguva. Tanga zvakare.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL inoda kuti WeKan ive pakero ye https://.
sqrl-description: Pinda nechiziviso chako cheSQRL panzvimbo pepasiwedhi. Chiwedzere pano kamwe chete nepurogiramu yako yeSQRL; unogona kuchibvisa pano chero nguva.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Kupinda neSQRL kwakadzimwa paakaundi iyi kubva papurogiramu yako yeSQRL. Kubatidza zvakare ikoko nekodhi yako yekununura.
sqrl-only-on: Purogiramu yako yeSQRL yakiya akaundi iyi kuSQRL chete: dzimwe nzira dzose dzekupinda dzinorambwa.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Purogiramu yako yeSQRL yakiya akaundi iyi zvakasimba: kuseta patsva pasiwedhi nekushandura tsamba yemagetsi zvinorambwa.
sqrl-hardlock: Akaundi iyi yakakiyiwa kuSQRL: haigone kudzoserwa kana kushandurwa neimwe nzira.
windows-sso-failed: Kupinda neWindows kwakundikana. Akaundi yako yeWindows ingangodaro isingabvumidzwi pano.
enrollment-password-instructions: Simbisa pasiwedhi yako kuti utange kuseta. Danho iri harikupinizi muakaundi. Nzira yekusimbisa kuti ndiwe yakatobatidzwa haigoni kutsiviwa pano.
enrollment-setup-denied: Hatigoni kutanga kuseta. Ongorora mashoko ako ekupinda uye tarisa kana makodhi anoshandiswa kamwe chete akatobatidzwa.
enrollment-code-instructions: Shandisa makodhi anoenderana nenguva: SHA1, manhamba matanhatu uye chinguva chemasekonzi 30 pakati pemakodhi. Usapa mumwe munhu kiyi yakavanzika. Kuseta uku kunopera mushure memaminitsi mashanu.
enrollment-confirmed-instructions: Kodhi yekusimbisa yakatoshandiswa. Usati wapinda, mirira kuti app yekusimbisa kuti ndiwe iratidze kodhi itsva.
registration-first-admin: Akaundi yekutanga mudhomeini ino ichawana mvumo yemutariri wehurongwa hwese.
auth-too-many-attempts: Waedza kupinda kakawandisa. Edza zvakare pava paya.
registration-global-admin-disabled: Maakaundi evatariri vehurongwa hwese anogadzirwa muhurongwa muno. Kunyoresa kweveruzhinji kwakadzimwa.
expedite-limit: Kadhi rimwe chete rakavhurika rebhodhi ndiro rinogona kuva Kukurumidza panguva imwe.
list-policy-placeholder: Kadhi ringapinda riini murondedzero iri, uye ripera riini pano?
commitment-point-hint: Kubva parondedzero iri basa rinozvipirwa; marondedzero ari pamberi paro isarudzo.
person-wip-over: __user__ ane makadhi akavhurika __count__; muganho we-WIP pamunhu ndi __limit__.
feature-list-policies-desc: Mutemo werondedzero imwe neimwe - kadhi ringapinda riini uye ripera riini ipapo - pamusoro perondedzero. Inobatidzwa pabhodhi rimwe nerimwe muna Marongero ebhodhi / Rondedzero.
feature-commitment-point-desc: Rondedzero inozvipirwa basa kubva pairi, yakamakwa pamusoro payo. Inosarudzwa pabhodhi rimwe nerimwe muna Marongero ebhodhi / Rondedzero.
feature-person-wip-limit-desc: Makadhi akavhurika mangani anogona kubatwa nemunhu mumwe pabhodhi; kadhi rakavhurwa rinoyambira nezvemunhu wese apfuura. Unoiswa pabhodhi rimwe nerimwe muna Marongero ebhodhi / Rondedzero.
feature-standup-timer-desc: Musangano wezuva nezuva mumenyu yebhodhi: nhengo dzebhodhi nenhevedzano yakasanganiswa, mumwe nemumwe nenguva imwe chete. Unodzimwa pabhodhi rimwe nerimwe muZvirongwa zveScrum zvaro.
feature-retrospective-board-desc: Bhodhi rekutarisa kumashure mumenyu yebhodhi: bhodhi idzva rakavanzika rine marondedzero Tanga kuita, Rega kuita, Ramba uchiita uye Zvinofanira kuitwa. Rinodzimwa pabhodhi rimwe nerimwe muZvirongwa zveScrum zvaro.
show-split-lists: Bvumira marondedzero kupatsanurwa kuva Zviri kuitwa neZvapera
feature-split-lists-desc: Rondedzero rakapatsanurwa kuva Zviri kuitwa neZvapera: kadhi rakaiswa mucherechedzo wekuti rapera ipapo rinomirira, rakasviba, kudhonzwa kurondedzero inotevera, uye musoro werondedzero unoverenga zvese zviri zviviri. Zvinobvumirwa pabhodhi rimwe nerimwe muna Marongero ebhodhi / Rondedzero, wozobatidzwa mumenyu yerondedzero imwe neimwe.
workload-intro: Maawa akafungidzirwa nemapoinzi enyaya emakadhi akapihwa munhu wese, vhiki nevhiki, achienzaniswa nemaawa aanawo: nguva yake yebasa, kusavapo nemazuva ezororo eruzhinji. Dzvanya vhiki kuti uone makadhi ayo.
workload-truncated: Zvakawandisa kuratidza kamwe chete: mushumo unoratidza vanhu nemakadhi ekutanga chete. Sarudza mavhiki mashoma kana mabhodhi mashoma.
workload-allocations-intro: Nguva yakawanda sei yemunhu inoenda kubhodhi, kana zvinzvimbo zvipi zvinodiwa nebhodhi munhu asati asarudzwa.
workload-invalid-estimate: Fungidziro inofanira kuva pakati pe 0 ne 10000 maawa.
feature-workload-desc: Uremu hwebasa nekugona mumenyu yemushandisi: maawa akafungidzirwa nemapoinzi enyaya emakadhi emunhu wese, vhiki nevhiki, achienzaniswa nenguva yake yebasa, kusavapo nemazuva ezororo eruzhinji, pamwe nekugoverwa kumabhodhi nezvinzvimbo zvenguva pfupi.
billing-intro: Mabhodhi auri maneja wawo: bhajeti yawo, zvakadhura basa rawo uye zvarichadhura pamitengo yeawa yaunoisa, uye ma-invhoisi emaawa akashandiswa. Vatungamiri vebhodhi chete ndivo vanoona izvi.
billing-unrated: __hours__ h hazvina mutengo weawa uye hazvina kudhurwa. Isa mutengo webhodhi kana wevanhu ivavo.
billing-set-rate-first: Tanga waisa mutengo weawa webhodhi iri.
feature-billing-desc: Bhajeti nekubhadharisa mumenyu yemushandisi: bhajeti yebhodhi mumari kana mumaawa, mitengo yeawa, mutengo uye fungidziro yebasa raro, uye ma-invhoisi emaawa anobhadharisa akashandiswa. Vatungamiri vebhodhi chete ndivo vanozviona.
billing-include-undated: Isa nguva yakanyorwa mazuva asati achengetwa
billing-pay-by-scanning: Bhadhara nekuskena neapp yebhangi kana yekubhadhara
billing-undated-included: Inosanganisira maawa __hours__ akanyorwa mazuva asati achengetwa.
billing-field-promptpay-target: Nhamba yerunhare, ID yenyika kana ID yechikwama chepamhepo
billing-field-proxy: Nhamba yerunhare, UEN, ID yeFPS kana imeyili
billing-uncosted: __hours__ h hazvina mutengo weawa uye hazvisi mumutengo wekushanda.
billing-bill-time: Bhadharisa nguva neawa (yakadzimwa: mutengo wakatarwa, mari dzakatarwa nezvakashandiswa chete ndizvo zvinonyorerwa invhoisi)
billing-fees-intro: Danho kana mutengo wakatarwa unobhadharwa kamwe, kubva pazuva rawo; mari yemwedzi mwedzi wega wega kubva pazuva rayo kusvika pakupera kwayo.
billing-unapproved: __hours__ h dzakamirira kubvumirwa uye hadzisi painvhoisi iyi.
billing-quotes-intro: Mutengo unopihwa unoisa mutengo pabasa rasara - fungidziro yekadhi yega yega yakavhurika kubvisa nguva yashandiswa - nemari dzisati dzanyorerwa invhoisi.
billing-accept-sets-budget: Mutengo unopihwa wagamuchirwa unova bhajeti rebhodhi
workload-utilization-title: Maawa anobhadharisa akanyorwa achienzaniswa nenguva yebasa yemavhiki aya
cloud-panel-settings-intro: PaDomeni re Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin anochengeta madomeni evatengi, dhatabhesi dzavo, DNS yeCloudFlare nenzira dzeCaddy, uye mutengi wega wega anoona ma-invhoisi ake otaura naSuperAdmin. SuperAdmin ndiye maneja weWeKan aripo kare.
cloud-panel-cloudflare-target: Kero inonongedzwa nemadomeni (kero yeIP kana zita rehost)
cloud-panel-caddy-intro: Caddy inotumira Domeni re Cloud Panel nedomeni yega yega yakagovaniswa kuWeKan iyi, uye domeni yega yega ine dhatabhesi yayo kuhombodo yayo yeWeKan.
cloud-panel-customers: Vatengi vanopinda pano (mazita evashandisi kana kero dzeemail)
cloud-panel-import-files: Zvakabatanidzwa __count__: kopa zvakare mafaira kubva kuchitoro chemafaira cheWeKan yekare.
cloud-admin-not-allowed: Cloud Admin iri pane kero chete rinotumidzwa neCLOUD environment variable yeseva, kuvatariri vayo veCloud nekuvatengi vemadomain ainoronga.
cloud-allowed-addresses-desc: Kero dzeIPv4 neIPv6, nehuwandu hwekero senge 203.0.113.0/24, kunobva muratidziri weCloud kupinda. Imwe pamutsetse wega wega. Isina chinhu: kero upi noupi.
cloud-allowed-addresses-lockout: Kero yako __address__ haisi muruzivo urwu. Kuichengeta kunokukiya kunze, saka haina kuchengetwa.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-desc: Makero eIPv4 neIPv6 nemapoka emakero, rimwe pamutsara wega wega, panogona kushandiswa Peneri yevatariri ne admin REST API. Hapana: chero kero.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-env: Chinja chenzvimbo yeseva ADMIN_PANEL_ALLOWED_IP_ADDRESSES ndicho chinosarudza, kwete runyorwa urwu.
admin-panel-address-refused: Peneri yevatariri haigoni kushandiswa uchibva pakero yako __address__.
feature-views-website-desc: Bhodhi sewebhusaiti: makadhi erondedzero yayo Published, mugwagwa Pages semenyu uye mamwe makadhi semanyorerwo, matsva pekutanga, pamwe chete nezvakabatanidzwa zvawo. Bhodhi reveruzhinji rinogona kuvhurika mumaonero aya, kuitira kuti vashanyi vaone webhusaiti pakero yebhodhi.
feature-views-shop-desc: Zvigadzirwa zviri pamakadhi ebhodhi sechitoro chepaIndaneti: kadhi rine mutengo chigadzirwa, mareberu aro ndiwo mapoka, uye odha ikadhi riri murondedzero yeMaodha. Bhodhi reruzhinji rinogona kuvhurika mazviri, kuti vashanyi vatenge pakero yebhodhi.
shop-sale-lists: Marondedzero ari kutengeswa (hapana chakasarudzwa: marondedzero ese kunze kwerondedzero yeMaodha)
shop-category-labels: Mareberu anoratidzwa semapoka (hapana chakasarudzwa: mareberu ese)
shop-orders-private: Maodha anonyorwa pabhodhi rakavanzika, nekuti bhodhi reruzhinji rinoratidza kadhi rega rega kune wese.
shop-show-on-public-note: Bhodhi reruzhinji rinovhurika mumaonero rimwe chete. Kusarudza Chitoro pano kunotsiva __view__ kune vashanyi, uye kusarudza Webhusaiti kana mamwe maonero muMarongero ebhodhi / bhodhi View kunotsiva Chitoro.
shop-empty: Hapana zvigadzirwa parizvino. Kadhi rine mutengo murondedzero iri kutengeswa chigadzirwa.
shop-privacy-note: Zita rako neruzivo rwekukubata zvinonyorwa paodha kuti chitoro chikuunzire, uye hapana kumwe kunhu.
shop-price-changed: Mutengo wachinja. Tarisa huwandu hutsva uye odha zvakare.
shop-confirmation-email: Tumira mutengi chisimbiso cheodha netsamba yemagetsi
import-board-instruction-wordpress: MuWordPress, sarudza 'Tools', 'Export', 'All content' uye 'Download Export File', wosarudza faira iro re.xml pano, kana kunamatidza mavara aro. Squarespace, Wix nedzimwe saiti dzinoburitsa faira reWordPress dzinoshanda nenzira imwe chete. Peji yega yega nemanyorerwo ega ega zvinova kadhi murondedzero yemamiriro azvo, mapeji mumugwagwa Pages uye manyorerwo muPosts, pamwe nezvirimo, zvikamu nema tags semareberu, nemhinduro dzakabvumidzwa.
import-board-instruction-wordpressjson: Chengetedza manyorerwo nemapeji eWordPress REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts ne/wp-json/wp/v2/pages) sefaira rimwe re.json, worisarudza pano kana kurinamatidza. Peji yega yega nemanyorerwo ega ega zvinova kadhi murondedzero yemamiriro azvo.
import-board-instruction-ghost: MuGhost, sarudza 'Settings', 'Labs', 'Export your content', wosarudza faira re.json pano kana kurinamatidza. Peji yega yega nemanyorerwo ega ega zvinova kadhi murondedzero yemamiriro azvo, nema tags azvo semareberu.
import-board-instruction-blogger: MuBlogger, sarudza 'Settings', 'Back up content', wosarudza faira re.xml pano kana kunamatidza mavara aro. Manyorerwo ega ega nepeji yega yega zvinova kadhi, zvisati zvapera murondedzero Draft, pamwe nemareberu nemhinduro zvazvo.
import-board-instruction-markdownsite: Isa mu.zip zvinyorwa zvekwakabva saiti yeHugo, Jekyll, Eleventy, Astro kana imwe saiti isingachinji - mafaira eMarkdown ne front matter yawo, nemifananidzo yawo - wosarudza .zip pano. Faira rega rega reMarkdown rinova kadhi: manyorerwo anobva mumafoldha e posts kana ane zuva muzita refaira, mamwe mapeji, zvisati zvapera murondedzero Draft, uye mifananidzo yarinoshandisa sezvakabatanidzwa zvaro.
import-board-instruction-htmlsite: Isa mu.zip mafaira ewebhusaiti - mapeji ayo e.html nemifananidzo, sezvakachengetwa newget kana HTTrack, kana zvakaburitswa naMedium - wosarudza .zip pano. Peji yega yega inova kadhi nemavara ayo makuru, uye mifananidzo yainoshandisa sezvakabatanidzwa; ma script, menyu nemafomu zvinosiiwa.
import-board-instruction-substack: MuSubstack, sarudza 'Settings', 'Exports', 'Create new export', wosarudza .zip yawadhawunirodha pano. Manyorerwo ega ega anova kadhi nemavara awo, akaburitswa kana asati apera.
help-board-view-swimlanes-what-it-is-des: Migwagwa inopatsanura bhodhi kuita mitsetse yakatambarara, saka kadhi rimwe nerimwe riri murondedzero nemumugwagwa panguva imwe. Mugwagwa unogona kumiririra chikwata, munhu, mutengi kana rudzi rwebasa, nepo marondedzero achiramba achiratidza nhanho dzebasa.
help-board-view-swimlanes-how-it-works-d: Dzvanya + mumusoro wemugwagwa, kana sarudza Wedzera mugwagwa mumenyu yawo, nyora zita uye sarudza kana uchienda pamusoro kana pasi pemugwagwa wakasarudzwa. Kuisa mitsara yakawanda kunogona kugadzira mugwagwa mumwe pamutsara mumwe nemumwe. Dzvanya zita kuti urichinje, shandisa museve kuti uvhare kana uvhure mugwagwa, dhonza mubato wawo kuti uchinje kurongeka kwemigwagwa, uye dhonza mupendero wawo wepasi kuti uchinje kureba kwawo kunze kwekunge mukuru webhodhi akavharira kuchinja saizi.
help-board-view-lists-what-it-is-descrip: Marondedzero makoramu ane makadhi. Pabhodhi rekanban rondedzero imwe neimwe inhanho yebasa, uye kadhi rinobva pane rimwe rondedzero richienda kune rimwe sezvo basa richifambira mberi. MuMaonero eMigwagwa rondedzero inogona kuva yemugwagwa mumwe chete.
help-board-view-lists-how-it-works-descr: Dzvanya chiratidzo chekuwedzera rondedzero kumucheto wekurudyi wemusoro werondedzero, kana Wedzera mumenyu yerondedzero, nyora zita uye sarudza rondedzero yarichatevera; kuisa mitsara yakawanda kunogona kugadzira rondedzero imwe pamutsara mumwe nemumwe. Dzvanya musoro werondedzero kuti uuchinje, uye museve uri mumusoro wayo unoivhara kana kuivhura kwauri chete. Menyu yerondedzero ine zvakare kukopa, kufambisa nekuisa mudura, uye unogona kudhonza mubato uri pakati pemarondedzero kuti uchinje upamhi hwawo kana zvichibvumirwa.
help-board-view-table-what-it-is-descrip: Maonero etafura anoratidza makadhi ebhodhi patafura yakaita sespreadsheet, mutsara mumwe pakadhi rimwe nerimwe, pamwe nerondedzero yaro, mugwagwa, vanhu, mareberu nemazuva. Zvinobatsira kutarisa makadhi akawanda panguva imwe uye kuwedzera kana kufambisa makadhi usingaadhonzi pakati pemarondedzero.
help-board-view-table-how-it-works-descr: Dzvanya musoro wekoramu kuti uronge, uye uudzvanye zvakare kuti utendeudze kurongeka. Nyora mubhokisi rekutsvaga kuti uwane misoro yemakadhi, marondedzero, migwagwa nemareberu, uye shandisa Yapfuura neInotevera kuti ufambe nemitsara 25 panguva imwe. Bhatani rekuGadzirisa rinovhura kadhi pamusoro petafura. Kuputira misoro nekuBatanidza nemugwagwa zvinochinja maumbirwo uye zvinorangarirwa mubrowser rino. Makadhi akachengetwa haaratidzwe, uye Sefa yepadivi inoderedza mitsara.
help-board-view-cal-what-it-is-descripti: Maonero eKarenda anoisa makadhi ebhodhi pakarenda zvichienderana nemazuva awo: kadhi rine zuva rekutanga nerekupera rinoratidzwa sebhawa pakati pawo, uye mazuva aro ekugamuchirwa, ekupedza nekupera anoratidzwa ega. Zvinhu zverondedzero yekuongorora zvine mazuva zvinoonekwawo.
help-board-view-cal-how-it-works-descrip: Shandisa Nhasi, Yapfuura neInotevera kufamba-famba, uye chinja pakati pezuva, vhiki nemwedzi, chimwe nechimwe segirid kana serondedzero. Dhonza kadhi kuti uripe zuva idzva rekupedza, kana urikweve kuti uchinje zuva rekupera. Dzvanya zuva, kana dhonza pamusoro pemaawa mugirid yevhiki kana yezuva, kuti ugadzire kadhi idzva rinopera panguva iyoyo; rinoenda kumugwagwa wekutanga nerondedzero yekutanga yebhodhi.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-what-it-is: Maitiro ekarenda anoratidza kadhi rimwe nerimwe pazuva raro rekupedzisira, pamwe nemareberu aro nemusoro waro wakazara, mugirid yemwedzi kana yevhiki. Pfupiso yekungoverenga chete yezvinofanira kupera uye rini, yakafanana nekarenda yeTrello.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-how-it-wor: Shandisa Nhasi, Yapfuura neInotevera kufamba nemwedzi kana nevhiki, uye vhiki kana Mwedzi kuchinja girid; sarudzo yacho inorangarirwa mubrowser rino. Dzvanya kadhi kuti urivhure. Makadhi akachengetwa haaratidzwe uye Sefa yepadivi inoshanda. Kuti uchinje mazuva nekudhonza, shandisa Maonero eKarenda pachinzvimbo.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-what-it-i: Karenda yemabhodhi akawanda inoratidza makadhi ane mazuva emabhodhi ese auri nhengo yawo mukarenda imwe chete, saka unogona kuona zvese zvinofanira kupera vhiki rino pasinei nebhodhi razviri. Chinhu chimwe nechimwe chinotanga nemusoro webhodhi racho mumabhuraketi.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-how-it-wo: Ivhure kubva mumenyu yeMaonero ebhodhi chero ripi zvaro uye mirira kusvikira makadhi emabhodhi ako ese aiswa. Shandisa Nhasi, Yapfuura neInotevera nemaonero ezuva, vhiki nemwedzi, chimwe nechimwe zvakare serondedzero. Mazuva ekugamuchirwa, ekupedza nekupera anowana zvinhu zvawo zvega. Dzvanya chinhu kuti uvhure kadhi iroro pabhodhi raro. Mazuva haagone kudhonzwa pano.
help-board-view-time-what-it-is-descript: Maonero eNguva anounganidza kutevera nguva kwebhodhi panzvimbo imwe: kuti nguva yakawanda sei yashandiswa, nani uye pamakadhi api, uye kuti nguva yakawanda sei yasara kusvikira makadhi apera. Nguva inonyorwa pamakadhi pachawo; maonero aya anongoishuma chete.
help-board-view-time-how-it-works-descri: Verenga pfupiso yenguva yakashandiswa iri pamusoro, wozotevera kupatsanurwa newapiwa basa uye nekadhi, makadhi apfuura nguva akamakwa. Pasi payo shanduko yega yega yemaawa akanyorwa pakadhi inonyorwa nemunhu akaiita. Dzvanya Buritsa kuti uchengete mushumo sePDF kana Excel. Nhengo dzinogona kuona chete makadhi avakapiwa dzinowana pfupiso yemakadhi adzo, nepo zvimwe zvikamu zvichisara zvisina chinhu.
help-board-view-timeline-what-it-is-desc: Maonero eMutsara wenguva anoratidza bhodhi sezvaraive panguva yakapfuura, achishandisa nhoroondo yebhodhi. Anokubatsira kuona zvakachinja uye kudzosera kadhi sezvaraive.
help-board-view-timeline-how-it-works-de: Dzvanya nzvimbo pamutsara kuti uone kadhi rimwe nerimwe sezvaraive panguva iyoyo, rakarongwa nerondedzero yaraive mairi, nemusoro waro, tsananguro, mareberu, nhengo nezuva rekupedzisira. Dzvanya Ikozvino kuti udzokere kunguva yazvino. Pakadhi, Dzorera kumamiriro aya inodzorera zvinhu izvozvo mushure mekunge wasimbisa. Hapana chinodzimwa: kudzorera kunonyorwa senhoroondo itsva, uye bhatani rinoratidzwa chete kuvanhu vanogona kuchinja kadhi iroro.
help-board-view-stats-what-it-is-descrip: Nhamba dzekuongorora dzinoratidza mamiriro ebhodhi nekukurumidza: kuti makadhi aro anotakurwa sei uye kuti rine migwagwa mingani, marondedzero, makadhi, makadhi akachengetwa, mareberu, nhengo neminda yakagadzirwa.
help-board-view-stats-how-it-works-descr: Vhura Nhamba dzekuongorora kubva muboka rePfupiso remenyu yeMaonero ebhodhi uye verenga tafura yemamiriro ebhodhi. Kutakura kwemakadhi kunoratidza kana bhodhi iri richitakura makadhi anoonekwa chete kana makadhi ese, uye kana izvozvo zvakasarudzwa zvega nekuda kwebhodhi hombe. Nhamba dzinoverengwa pasevha, saka dzakarurama kunyange pabhodhi hombe. Chero kukosha kunogona kusarudzwa nekukopwa, uye kuvhura maonero aya hakuchinje chinhu.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-what-i: Batanidza neWakagoverwa inoronga kadhi rimwe nerimwe pasi pemunhu wariri kupiwa, pachinzvimbo chepasi perondedzero yaro, saka unogona kuona kuti ndiani ane chii usingavhure rondedzero imwe neimwe. Zvakanakira musangano wechikwata.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-how-it: Ivhure kubva mumenyu yeMaonero ebhodhi. Wapiwa basa wese anowana chikamu chine makadhi ake, zuva rekupedzisira kana rakaiswa uye wachi kana kadhi rapfuura nguva; makadhi asina wapiwa basa ari pasi peHapana wapiwa basa. Dzvanya musoro wekadhi kuti urivhure. Kubatanidza uku kunoshandisa munda weWapiwa basa wekadhi, kwete Nhengo dzaro. Vanhu vane basa rinovabvumira kuona chete makadhi avakapiwa havawani data pano.
help-board-view-gantt-what-it-is-descrip: Maonero eGantt anodhirowa makadhi ebhodhi pakarenda kuti uone zvinotanga, zvinofanira kupera nezvinopindirana. Gantt itafura ine mutsara mumwe pakadhi rimwe nerimwe nechiratidzo pazuva raro rimwe nerimwe, nepo Frappe Gantt neDHTMLX Gantt zvichidhirowa kadhi rimwe nerimwe sebhawa kubva pakutanga kusvika pakupera.
help-board-view-gantt-how-it-works-descr: Sarudza Gantt, Frappe Gantt kana DHTMLX Gantt muboka reKarenda nenguva remenyu yeMaonero ebhodhi; makadhi anoda zuva rimwe chete rekugamuchirwa, kutanga, kupedza kana kupera. MuGantt vhiki rimwe nerimwe rine mazuva rinowana tafura yaro; dzvanya zita rekadhi kuti urivhure kana chiratidzo chezuva kuti urigadzirise. MuFrappe Gantt neDHTMLX Gantt nhengo dzine mvumo yekunyora dzinogona kudhonza bhawa kuti dzichinje nguva yekadhi.
help-board-view-product-backlog-what-it-: Rondedzero yemabasa echigadzirwa akamirira kuitwa irondedzero yakarongwa yebasa risati raiswa nechikwata cheScrum munguva pfupi yebasa. Inoratidza makadhi ebhodhi asina sprint yazvino, akarongwa neNhanho murondedzero yemabasa akamirira kuitwa, isingaabvise mumarondedzero awo.
help-board-view-product-backlog-how-it-w: Tsvaga kadhi mutafura uye, muchitokisi charo cheZviito, isa Sprint yaro, Nhanho murondedzero, Chaburitswa, Rudzi rwechinhu chebasa neZvinodiwa kuti basa rigamuchirwe, wobva wadzvanya Chengetedza. Nhanho diki dzinotanga. Bata Ctrl, kana Cmd paMac, kuti uise kadhi muzvaburitswa zvakawanda. Dzvanya musoro wekadhi kuti urivhure, uye Ratidza zvimwe kuti uise makadhi 100 anotevera. Kugadzirisa kunotevera mvumo dzinowanzoitika dzemakadhi.
help-board-view-sprints-what-it-is-descr: Nguva pfupi yebasa (sprint) inguva pfupi yakatarwa iyo chikwata cheScrum chinopedza basa rakasarudzwa kuzadzisa chinangwa. Maonero eNguva pfupi dzebasa ndipo panorongwa, panotangwa, panovharwa kana panokanzurwa ma-sprint ebhodhi, pamwe nezvaburitswa zvaro nezviitiko zveScrum.
help-board-view-sprints-how-it-works-des: Mukuru webhodhi anotanga avhura Zvirongwa zveScrum, obatidza kuronga kweScrum uye osarudza kunobva fungidziro, chiyero, mutemo wekupedza nemazuva ebasa. Wobva wagadzira sprint yakarongwa ine zita, chinangwa, kutanga nekupera, woipa makadhi kubva muRondedzero yemabasa echigadzirwa, wodzvanya Tanga nguva pfupi yebasa. Kuti upedze, sarudza kunoenda basa risina kupera wodzvanya Vhara nguva pfupi yebasa, kana ipa chikonzero wodzvanya Kanzura nguva pfupi yebasa. Vakuru vebhodhi chete ndivo vanotonga ma-sprint.
help-board-view-sprint-report-what-it-is: Mushumo wesprint unotaura zvakaitika musprint imwe yakavharwa: zvakavimbiswa, zvakapedzwa, zvakawedzerwa, zvakabviswa nezvakasara zvisina kupera. Mwero webasa rinopedzwa unonyora mibairo iyoyo pasprint yega yega yakavharwa, kuti sprint inotevera irongwe zvichibva pane zvakaitwa nechikwata chaizvo.
help-board-view-sprint-report-how-it-wor: MuMushumo wenguva pfupi yebasa, sarudza sprint wosarudza Makadhi kana Fungidziro pamusoro pemabhawa, wozoverenga hukuru hwebasa hwezuva nezuva nebasa rasara uye nhoroondo yeshanduko imwe neimwe iri pasi. MuMwero webasa, verenga mutsara mumwe pasprint yega yega yakavharwa. Mibairo inobva pamifananidzo yakatorwa sprint yega yega payakatanga uye payakavharwa, saka shanduko dzefungidziro dzinotevera hadzinyore patsva. Buritsa inochengeta mibairo sePDF kana Excel, uye Rodha zvakare inoisa mushumo patsva.
help-board-view-burndown-what-it-is-desc: Machati eScrum aya anoratidza kufambira mberi nekufamba kwenguva. Burndown inoratidza basa rasara zuva nezuva uye Burnup rakapedzwa, Mwero webasa rinopedzwa unoratidza zvakapedzwa nesprint imwe neimwe yakavharwa, Burndown chati yechaburitswa inotevera basa rasara muchaburitswa, uye Kufambira mberi kwemabasa makuru kunoratidza kuti makadhi evabereki asvika papi.
help-board-view-burndown-how-it-works-de: Sarudza chati pasi peScrum mumenyu yeMaonero ebhodhi. Imwe neimwe inodhirowa kubva pamakadhi nema-sprint ebhodhi pacharo uye inoratidza nhamba mutafura iri pasi pechati. Mwero webasa unoda sprint imwe chete yakavharwa, uye unokubvumira kusarudza Makadhi kana Fungidziro. Dzvanya Buritsa kumusoro kuti uchengete nhamba idzodzo sePDF kana Excel. Chati isati yava nechekudhirowa inoti Hapana zvawanikwa.
help-board-view-roadmap-what-it-is-descr: Rwendo runobatanidza makadhi mumitsara zvichienderana nekukosha kwemunda wakagadzirwa, sechaburitswa kana epic, uye runodhirowa makadhi emutsara wega wega pamutsara wenguva. Zvinobatsira parwendo rwezvaburitswa kana rwemisoro kana kubatanidzwa ikoko kuchitochengetwa mumunda wakagadzirwa.
help-board-view-roadmap-how-it-works-des: Bhodhi rinoda munda wakagadzirwa mumwe chete wemashoko kana werondedzero inoburuka. Sarudza munda muBatanidza kumusoro; kukosha kumwe nekumwe kunowana chati diki yeGantt yemakadhi akwo, uye makadhi asina kukosha anobatanidzwa pasi peHapana kukosha. Makadhi anoiswa zvichienderana nemazuva awo, saka apa mazuva ekutanga nekupedza kuti uaone pamutsara wenguva.
help-board-view-dashboard-what-it-is-des: Machati ePfupiso aya anopindura kuti bhodhi rakabatikana sei uye basa raro rakagovaniswa sei: Dashboard (chati) neKurova kwemoyo zvinopfupisa bhodhi, Uremu hwebasa hunoratidza kuti ndiani ane chii, Kugoverwa kuti makadhi akapatsanurwa sei, Mepu yekuvimbana kuti makadhi anovharirana kana kuvimbana sei, uye Mepu yekupisa yezviitiko kuti vanhu vanoshanda rini pabhodhi.
help-board-view-dashboard-how-it-works-d: Sarudza chati muboka rePfupiso remenyu yeMaonero ebhodhi. Peji imwe neimwe inodhirowa chati kubva pamakadhi nenhoroondo yebhodhi uye inoratidza tafura yenhamba dziri shure kwayo. Dzvanya Buritsa kumusoro kuti uchengete data rimwe chete sePDF kana Excel. Kana pasati pava nechekudhirowa, chati inoti Hapana zvawanikwa.
help-board-view-bigboard-what-it-is-desc: Bigboard inoturika mabhodhi ese auri nhengo yawo papeji imwe inogona kutenderedzwa, rimwe nerimwe nemarondedzero aro nemakadhi, saka unogona kushanda pamabhodhi ako ese panguva imwe.
help-board-view-bigboard-how-it-works-de: Vhura Bigboard kubva mumenyu yeMaonero ebhodhi uye mirira makadhi emabhodhi ese achiiswa. Chikamu chimwe nechimwe chebhodhi chinoshanda sebhodhi rakajairika: dhonza makadhi pakati pemarondedzero, vhura makadhi uye gadzirisa marondedzero. Unogonawo kudhonza kadhi murondedzero yerimwe bhodhi riri papeji, izvo zvinorifambisira kubhodhi iroro. Marondedzero anogona kudhonzwa chete mukati mebhodhi rawo. Dzvanya musoro webhodhi kuti urivhure riri roga.
help-board-view-flow-what-it-is-descript: Machati eKuyerera kweKanban anoratidza kuti basa rinofamba sei nemubhodhi: kuyerera kwakaunganidzwa, kudzora nenguva yekuripedza, nguva yekusvika, kushanda kwekuyerera, zvinobudiswa, WIP, basa rakwegura, zvipingamupinyi, fungidziro dzekuti basa richapera rini, maitiro ehurongwa uye kana fungidziro huru dzichitora nguva yakareba. Zvinokubatsira kuwana panounganidzwa basa uye nguva yarinotora chaizvo.
help-board-view-flow-how-it-works-descri: Sarudza chati muboka reKuyerera kweKanban remenyu yeMaonero ebhodhi. Verenga chinyorwa chiri pasi pemusoro, chinotaura kuti chinoyera sei, wozoverenga chati netafura iri pasi payo. Mamwe mapeji anotora marongero, akadai semakadhi nezuva rechinangwa paMonte Carlo — Histogram yezvinobudiswa kana munda wehukuru paUkuru hwebasa zvichienzaniswa nenguva yekuripedza, anoshandiswa neShandisa. Buritsa kumusoro inochengeta matafura sePDF kana Excel.
help-board-view-reports-what-it-is-descr: Mishumo iyi inoratidza kuti basa rinoyerera sei nemubhodhi vhiki nevhiki: makadhi akagadzirwa nakapedzwa, kuyerera kwakachena, kuti makadhi anogara nguva yakareba sei murondedzero imwe neimwe, zera repakati remakadhi akavhurika, zvinobudiswa pavhiki uye kuti mazuva ekupedzisira anochengetwa kangani.
help-board-view-reports-how-it-works-des: Sarudza mushumo muboka reKuyerera kweKanban remenyu yeMaonero ebhodhi: Zvakagadzirwa uye zvakagadziriswa, Kuyerera kwakachena, Nguva murondedzero, Zera repakati, Chati yezvinobudiswa nekufamba kwenguva kana Kuchengetwa kwemazuva ekupedzisira. Mumwe nemumwe unoratidza chati uye, pasi payo, tafura yenhamba yakadhirowewa kubva madziri. Dzvanya Buritsa kumusoro kuti uchengete tafura iyoyo sePDF kana Excel.
help-board-view-map-what-it-is-descripti: Maonero emepu anoratidza makadhi ebhodhi semamaki pamufananidzo unoiswa nemukuru webhodhi, sechirongwa chepasi pechivakwa kana mepu yenzvimbo. Zvakanakira basa rinoitika munzvimbo, semakamuri, michina kana mapurazi.
help-board-view-map-how-it-works-descrip: Mukuru webhodhi anodzvanya Kwidza mufananidzo wemepu osarudza faira rePNG, JPEG, GIF kana WebP, uye anogona kuribvisa gare gare asingarasi nzvimbo dzemakadhi. Vanhu vanogona kuchinja bhodhi vanoona makadhi asati ava pamepu; dhonza rimwe pamufananidzo, kana urisarudze wodzvanya pariri kufanira kuva, uye dhonza maki kuti uifambise. Maki inotora ruvara rwereberu rekutanga rekadhi, uye kuidzvanya kunovhura kadhi.
help-board-view-email-what-it-is-descrip: Maonero etsamba yemagetsi anoratidza bhodhi sebhokisi retsamba: makadhi ndiwo mameseji, marondedzero ndiwo mafolda uye mareberu ndiwo mareberu. Unogona kunyora nekupindura tsamba kubva pakero yebhodhi pacharo, saka mhinduro dzinodzokera kubhodhi semakadhi nemhinduro.
help-board-view-email-how-it-works-descr: Dzvanya Dzapinda, Dzakatumirwa, Tsamba dzese, rondedzero kana reberu kuti usarudze zvinoratidzwa, nyora mubhokisi rekutsvaga kuti uderedze mitsara, uye dzvanya mutsara kuti uvhure kadhi, iro mhinduro dzaro dziri hurukuro. Nyora inonyora tsamba itsva uye museve wekupindura unopindura imwe, ichitumirwa kubva pakero yebhodhi. Bhodhi rinofanira kutanga ragamuchira tsamba, zvinobatidzwa muMarongero ezviziviso ebhodhi pasi peTsamba yemagetsi kukadhi.
help-board-view-chat-what-it-is-descript: Maonero ehurukuro anoratidza bhodhi senzvimbo yehurukuro: kadhi rimwe nerimwe rine hurukuro ichanera uye mhinduro dzaro ndiwo mameseji. Muti wemachanera unosanganisira mabhodhi ese aunogona kuona, nenhamba yemameseji ausati waverenga.
help-board-view-chat-how-it-works-descri: Vhura nzvimbo yebasa nebhodhi muMachanera wodzvanya kadhi; rinovhurika muchikamu chepakati uye mameseji aro muchikamu chehurukuro. Nyora meseji wodzvanya Enter kana Tumira; Shift+Enter inotanga mutsara mutsva. Kuti utange hurukuro pakadhi risina mameseji, dzvanya Ratidza makadhi ese ebhodhi iroro wosarudza kadhi. Zvikamu zvinotendeudzwa pamitauro inonyorwa kubva kurudyi kuenda kuruboshwe.
help-board-view-version-control-what-it-: Maonero ekutonga shanduro anoratidza bhodhi setracker yematambudziko eimba yekodhi: makadhi ndiwo matambudziko, mareberu ndiwo mareberu, mareberu ane zuva rekupedzisira ndiwo matanho makuru, mhinduro ndiyo hurukuro uye zvakabatanidzwa ndiwo mafaira. Anopinzawo nekutsinhana matambudziko kubva kuGitHub, GitLab, Gitea neForgejo.
help-board-view-version-control-how-it-w: Tarisa matambudziko akavhurika nakavharwa, sefa nereberu kana nhanho huru, uye vhura dambudziko kuti uverenge uye uwedzere kuhurukuro yaro. Kadhi rinoverengwa serakavharwa kana rakachengetwa kana riri murondedzero yakaita seZvakavharwa kana Zvapera. Matambudziko matsva anova makadhi murondedzero yakavhurika yebhodhi, uye Vhara kana Vhura zvakare zvinofambisa kadhi pakati pemarondedzero akavhurika nakavharwa. Zvese idata rekadhi rakajairika, saka shanduko dzinochengetwa munhoroondo yebhodhi.
help-board-view-column-sets-what-it-is-d: Mapoka emakoramu anokubvumira kuronga makadhi mamwe chete nedzimwe nzira, sekukosha, nhanho huru kana ukuru, usingabvise kadhi murondedzero yaro. Boka rimwe nerimwe rine makoramu aro ane mavara.
help-board-view-column-sets-how-it-works: Mukuru webhodhi anonyora zita muBoka idzva remakoramu odzvanya Wedzera, wobva awedzera makoramu ane zita neruvara. Sarudza boka kumusoro; kadhi rimwe nerimwe riri mune rimwe remakoramu aro kana muHazvina kuiswa. Dhonza kadhi kune imwe koramu kuti uchinje nzvimbo yaro muboka iri chete; rondedzero yaro, mugwagwa, mareberu nenhengo zvinoramba zvakadaro. Kadhi rimwe nerimwe rinoratidzawo mareberu madiki ekoramu yaro mune mamwe mapoka.
help-board-view-website-what-it-is-descr: Maonero ewebhusaiti anoratidza bhodhi sewebhusaiti yakavakwa kubva pamakadhi aro nezvakabatanidzwa, semuenzaniso saiti yakapinzwa kubva kuWordPress, Ghost, Blogger kana saiti isingachinji. Bhodhi reruzhinji rinogona kuvhurika mumaonero aya, saka vashanyi vanoona saiti pakero yebhodhi.
help-board-view-website-how-it-works-des: Makadhi ari murondedzero inonzi Published ari pasaiti, kana makadhi emarondedzero ese kana pasina rondedzero yakadaro; makadhi akachengetwa haambooratidzwi. Makadhi ari mumugwagwa unonzi Pages anoumba menyu, mabasa madiki ari mapeji madiki, uye mamwe makadhi zvinyorwa papeji yekutanga, zvitsva kutanga. Tsananguro yekadhi ndiwo mashoko epeji uye zvakabatanidzwa zvaro ndiyo mifananidzo nemafaira aro. Kuti uashandise semaonero ebhodhi reruzhinji, aasarudze muMarongero ebhodhi / Maonero ebhodhi.
help-board-view-shop-what-it-is-descript: Maonero echitoro anoratidza zvigadzirwa zviri pamakadhi ebhodhi sechitoro chepaindaneti, chine mifananidzo, mitengo, mapoka, peji rechigadzirwa, tswanda nenzvimbo yekubhadhara. Kadhi riri murondedzero iri kutengeswa rinova chigadzirwa kana munda waro wemutengo uine nhamba, uye mareberu aro anova mapoka.
help-board-view-shop-how-it-works-descri: Mukuru webhodhi anogadzira chitoro muMarongero ebhodhi / Chitoro: minda yemutengo, kodhi yechigadzirwa nehuwandu huripo, rondedzero yakavanzika yemaodha, mari, VAT, nzira dzekubhadhara, marondedzero ari kutengeswa nemareberu anoratidzwa semapoka, wobva amaka Chitoro chakavhurwa. Vatengi vanosefa neboka, vanowedzera zvigadzirwa mutswanda vobhadhara. Odha imwe neimwe inova kadhi idzva muRondedzero yemaodha, uye mutengi anowana tsamba yekusimbisa.
help-sidebar-filter-what-it-is-descripti: Sefa inoratidza chete makadhi anoenderana nezvaunosarudza, semareberu, nhengo, vakapiwa basa, mazuva, kukosha kweminda yakagadzirwa, mashoko ekadhi kana kuti makadhi agara nguva yakareba sei murondedzero. Haichinje kadhi kana mvumo yemunhu, uye musanganiswa wemasefa unogona kuchengetwa nezita woshandiswa zvakare.
help-sidebar-filter-how-it-works-descrip: Sarudza mareberu, vanhu, mazuva kana zvimwe zvinodiwa padivi, uye bhodhi rinoratidza chete makadhi anoenderana. Pasi peMareberu, OR inowirirana nechero reberu rakasarudzwa uye AND inoda ese; kudzvanya reberu rakasarudzwa zvakare kunoribvisa. Mashoko ekadhi anoshanda paunenge uchinyora. Kuvhara chikamu kunoramba kwakabatidza sefa kusvikira waibvisa. Kutsvaga kwepasi rose, kuri pano zvakare, kunowana makadhi mumabhodhi ako ese.
help-sidebar-search-what-it-is-descripti: Tsvaga inowana makadhi nemarondedzero ebhodhi rino ane mashoko aunonyora, uye inoratidza kadhi rimwe nerimwe rawanikwa pabhodhi pacharo. PaMabhodhi ese bhatani rimwe chete rinoderedza rondedzero yemabhodhi ako nemusoro.
help-sidebar-search-how-it-works-descrip: Nyora mumunda wodzvanya Enter. Divi rinonyora marondedzero nemakadhi anoenderana, uye kadhi rekutanga rinovhurika pabhodhi nechiverengi pasi pemunda. Dzvanya Enter zvakare kukadhi rinotevera kana Shift+Enter kune rapfuura; miseve inoita zvimwe chete uye inodzokera kumavambo. Dzvanya kadhi kana rondedzero mumhedzisiro kuti uriratidze pabhodhi, uye dzvanya Tsvaga zvakare kuti uvhare divi.
help-sidebar-multiselection-what-it-is-d: Kusarudza zvakawanda kunokubvumira kumaka makadhi akawanda wobva waita chinhu chimwe kwaari ese panguva imwe: kuisa reberu kana nhengo, kuchinja ruvara, kufambisa, kukopa kana kuisa mudura. PaMabhodhi ese kunosarudza mabhodhi pachinzvimbo.
help-sidebar-multiselection-how-it-works: Batidza Kusarudza zvakawanda mumusoro webhodhi, wobva wamaka mabhokisi ekumaka emakadhi, kana shandisa Sefa kune zvakasarudzwa mudivi reSefa kuti usarudze kadhi rega rega rinoratidzwa nesefa. Sarudza chiito padivi, seIsa chiratidzo pane zvakasarudzwa, Fambisa zvakasarudzwa kana Fambisa zvakasarudzwa kudura. Dzvanya Dzima kusarudza zvakawanda, X iri parutivi pebhatani remusoro, kana wapedza. Unoda mvumo yekuchinja bhodhi.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-what-it-is-de: Minda yakagadzirwa iminda yebhodhi pacharo yekuwedzera pamakadhi, seshanduro, bhajeti, mutengi, bhokisi rekumaka kana sarudzo kubva murondedzero. Munda unotsanangurwa kamwe chete kubhodhi, uye kadhi rimwe nerimwe rinogona kuva nekukosha kwaro pamunda iwoyo.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-how-it-works-: Dzvanya + kuti ugadzire munda, upe zita nerudzi (mashoko, nhamba, zuva, rondedzero inoburuka, rondedzero inoburuka yekusarudza zvakawanda, bhokisi rekumaka, mari kana muenzaniso wemashoko) uye sarudza paunoratidzwa: pakadhi, pakadhi diki, pamakadhi matsva kana pamakadhi ese. Rudzi harugone kuchinjwa gare gare. Minda yenhamba neyemari inogona kuratidza huwandu hwayo pamusoro perondedzero imwe neimwe. Kukosha kwemakadhi kunozadzwa pakadhi rakavhurwa.
help-sidebar-archives-what-it-is-descrip: Dura rine makadhi, marondedzero nemigwagwa zvakaiswa muDura. Kuchengeta mudura kunovanza chinhu usingachirasi, saka chinogona kudzorerwa gare gare, nepo kudzima kuchichibvisa zvachose.
help-sidebar-archives-how-it-works-descr: Sarudza tebhu yeMakadhi, Marondedzero kana Migwagwa wodzvanya Dzorera parutivi pechinhu, kana dzorera zvose. Kadhi ringasakwanisa kudzorerwa kana rondedzero yaro yakachengetwa kana yazara maererano nemuganho wayo weWIP, uye Dura rinodaro. Vakuru vebhodhi vanoonawo Dzima nedzima zvose, zvisingagone kudzoserwa. Mabhodhi akachengetwa anodzorerwa kubva papeji yeDura yeMabhodhi ese pachinzvimbo.
help-sidebar-original-positions-what-it-: Nzvimbo dzepakutanga dzinoratidza pakaiswa mugwagwa wega wega, rondedzero nekadhi pazvakagadzirwa, uye kuti ndezvipi zvakafambiswa kubva ipapo. Zvinobatsira mushure mekurongazve kukuru, kana kuona musoro wakagadzirwa nawo kadhi.
help-sidebar-original-positions-how-it-w: Verenga mapoka matatu, Migwagwa, Marondedzero neMakadhi. Chinhu chimwe nechimwe chinoratidza zita racho razvino, Zvafambiswa kana chisisiri pachakaiswa, nzvimbo yachakagadzirwa, musoro wacho wepakutanga kana wakachinja, uye kuti chakagadzirwa rini. Dzvanya Rodha zvakare kuti uverengezve nhoroondo yebhodhi. Zvinhu zvakagadzirwa nzvimbo dzisati dzanyorwa hazvina mutsara.
help-sidebar-summary-what-it-is-descript: Pfupiso mushumo wemusangano wezuva nezuva wezvakaitika pabhodhi, munhu nemunhu, wakatorwa kubva pazvinyorwa zvebhodhi pacharo. Unopindura kuti mumwe nemumwe wedu akaitei muzuva kana muvhiki rapfuura, uye zvapfuura nguva.
help-sidebar-summary-how-it-works-descri: Sarudza Zuva rekupedzisira kana Vhiki rekupedzisira. Nhengo yega yega yakaita chimwe chinhu kana ine makadhi apfuura nguva inowana mapoka emakadhi Zvapera, Zvafambiswa, akawedzera neAkapa pfungwa, pamwe nemakadhi ayo Zvapfuura nguva yekupedza, uye kadhi rimwe nerimwe rinovhurika kubva pachinongedzo charo. Dzvanya Kopa sezvinyorwa kuti ukope pfupiso yese, yakagadzirira kuiswa muhurukuro kana mutsamba.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-what-it-is: Kubva pawakapedzisira kushanya kunonyora zvakachinjwa nevamwe vanhu pabhodhi rino kubva pawakapedzisira kurivhura: makadhi matsva, kufambiswa, mhinduro, shanduko dzezuva rekupedzisira nenhengo dzakawedzerwa. Chinhu chiri mumenyu chinoratidza nhamba yeshanduko.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-how-it-wor: Kuvhura bhodhi kunonyora kushanya kwako. Vhura maonero aya kuti uone shanduko dzakarongwa nekadhi, itsva kutanga, wodzvanya mutsara kuti uvhure kadhi iroro. Shanduko dzako hadzinyorwe. Mutariri anogona kuvanza chinhu ichi muPeneri yevatariri / Marongero / Zvinogoneka.
help-board-visibility-what-it-is-descrip: Kuonekwa kunosarudza kuti ndiani anogona kuona bhodhi: vanhu vakawedzerwa chete (Zvakavanzika), mushandisi wese akapinda weWeKan iyi (Vashandisi vakapinda), kana chero munhu ane chinongedzo (Zveruzhinji). Kugadzirisa kunoramba kuri kwenhengo dzebhodhi kunze kwekunge mukuru webhodhi abvumira zvimwe.
help-board-visibility-how-it-works-descr: Mukuru webhodhi anodzvanya bhatani rekuonekwa mumusoro webhodhi osarudza Zvakavanzika, Vashandisi vakapinda kana Zveruzhinji; sarudzo yazvino ine mucherechedzo uye bhatani rinobva raratidza marongero matsva. Pabhodhi reVashandisi vakapinda kana reZveruzhinji, kana mutariri achibvumira, mukuru webhodhi anogonawo kumaka Vese vakapinda vanogona kugadzirisa. Kune vamwe vanhu bhatani rinongoratidza marongero.
help-board-watch-what-it-is-description: Tarisa inoseta kuti unonzwa zvakadii nezvebhodhi rino: Kutarisa kunokuzivisa nezveshanduko yega yega, Kutevera chete nezveshanduko dzemakadhi awakagadzira kana auri nhengo yawo, uye Zviziviso zvakanyaradzwa hapana. Marongero aya ndeako; dzimwe nhengo dzinosarudza adzo.
help-board-watch-how-it-works-descriptio: Dzvanya bhatani rekutarisa mumusoro webhodhi wosarudza Kutarisa, Kutevera kana Zviziviso zvakanyaradzwa; nhanho yako yazvino ine mucherechedzo uye bhatani rinoratidza nhanho itsva. Kana shanduko ikarambwa, meseji inotaura chikonzero uye hapana chinochinja. Bhatani rinovanzwa kana mutariri adzima kutarisa.
help-board-sort-cards-what-it-is-descrip: Ronga makadhi inochinja kurongeka kunoratidzwa makadhi mukati merondedzero imwe neimwe: nezuva rekupedzisira, musoro, nguva yakagadzirwa, mavhoti kana kurongeka kwemareberu ebhodhi. Inochinja chete zvaunoona, uye hapana kadhi rinofambiswa.
help-board-sort-cards-how-it-works-descr: Dzvanya Ronga makadhi mumusoro webhodhi wosarudza kurongeka; makadhi murondedzero imwe neimwe anokutevera uye bhatani rinoti kurongeka kuri kushanda. Dzvanya X iri parutivi payo kuti ubvise kurongeka wodzokera kurongeka kwakadhonzwa makadhi. Sarudzo inochengetwa mubrowser rako kunyange ukarodha zvakare. PaKurongeka kwemareberu, mukuru webhodhi anogona kuchinja kurongeka kwemareberu neEnda kumusoro neEnda pasi paanogadzirisa reberu.
help-board-settings-what-it-is-descripti: Marongero ebhodhi anounganidza zvese zvakasetwa pabhodhi rino rimwe chete: mitemo yaro, kuronga, ruvara nemufananidzo wekumashure, mazuva, maonero, migwagwa, marondedzero nemakadhi, kubudisa nekupinza, zviziviso, mawebhook nedura. Zvizhinji zvevakuru vebhodhi; basa rako nemarongero esaiti zvinosarudza kuti unoona zvipi.
help-board-settings-how-it-works-descrip: Vhura divi rekurudyi rebhodhi nemenyu yemitsetse mitatu wodzvanya Marongero ebhodhi. Sarudza chinhu uye hwindo racho kana peji racho rinovhurika. Zvinhu zvakarongwa mumapoka: mitemo kutanga, wozotevera chitarisiko chebhodhi, wozotevera kudhirowewa kwaro, wozotevera zvinopinda nezvinobuda, uye pakupedzisira dura.
help-board-settings-color-what-it-is-des: Chinja ruvara inoseta dingindira remavara ebhodhi rino, rinooneka nenhengo dzese pabhodhi rino. Inzira yekusiyanisa mabhodhi nekukurumidza. Vakuru vebhodhi chete ndivo vanogona kuruchinja.
help-board-settings-color-how-it-works-d: Dzvanya muenzaniso wedingindira; unoshandiswa pakarepo, pasina bhatani reKuchengetedza. Pamadingindira akapfava nekujeka unogonawo kusarudza mavara ako nemavhiri emavara wozvitarisa mumuenzaniso. Ruvara rwawakasarudza pachako muMarongero enhengo runoramba ruchitungamira pamusoro peruvara rwebhodhi kwauri.
help-board-settings-announcement-what-it: Chiziviso chebhodhi imeseji inonyorwa nemukuru webhodhi kuvanhu vese vari pabhodhi rino, inoratidzwa mubhawa pamusoro pemarondedzero ebhodhi. Ishandise pazvinyorwa zvinofanira kuonekwa nenhengo dzese, sezuva rekupedzisira kana shanduko munzira inoshandiswa bhodhi.
help-board-settings-announcement-how-it-: Nyora mashoko, kusvika pamavara 2000 emashoko akajeka, maka Ratidza munhu wese ari pabhodhi rino, wodzvanya Chengetedza. Nhengo dzinoona bhawa kusvikira dzarivhara neX yaro, izvo zvinorivanza kwavari chete. Kana chiziviso chikagadziriswa, chinoratidzwa zvakare kuvanhu vese.
help-board-settings-background-what-it-i: Mufananidzo wekumashure mufananidzo unoratidzwa kumashure kwemarondedzero ebhodhi, uyewo semufananidzo webhodhi papeji yeMabhodhi ese. Unogona kuva kero yemufananidzo painternet kana mufananidzo wakarodhwa wochengetwa muWeKan.
help-board-settings-background-how-it-wo: Nyora kero yemufananidzo muURL yemufananidzo wekumashure wodzvanya Chengetedza, kana shandisa Bvisa mufananidzo wekumashure kuti uubvise. Kuti uchengete mufananidzo, dzvanya Rodha mufananidzo wekumashure wosarudza faira; mifananidzo yakarodhwa inonyorwa pasi, apo kudzvanya mumwe kunouita mufananidzo wekumashure webhodhi, uye zviratidzo zvinoudhaunirodha kana kuudzima.
help-board-settings-date-what-it-is-desc: Zuva rinobvumira mukuru webhodhi kusarudza maumbirwo ezuva mamwe chete kuvanhu vese vari pabhodhi rino, pachinzvimbo chemaumbirwo akaiswa pasaiti yese. Hwindo rimwe chete rine chinja chako chenhamba yevhiki uye, kuvakuru vebhodhi, kutsinhana kwekarenda kunoisa mazuva ekupedzisira emakadhi mukarenda yeCalDAV seNextcloud.
help-board-settings-date-how-it-works-de: Maka Maumbirwo ezuva ebhodhi, sarudza maumbirwo wodzvanya Chengetedza; bvisa mucherechedzo kuti utevere zvakare marongero esaiti. Maumbirwo enhengo akabatidzwa muMarongero enhengo anoramba achikunda. Ratidza vhiki yegore inobatidza kana kudzima nhamba dzevhiki kwauri pakarepo. Pakutsinhana kwekarenda, isa kero yekarenda, zita remushandisi nepasiwedhi yeapp, maka bhokisi rekutsinhana uye Chengetedza.
help-board-settings-all-boards-what-it-i: Marongero emabhodhi ose anosarudza zvinoratidzwa nemufananidzo webhodhi rino papeji yeMabhodhi ese, senhamba yemakadhi erondedzero imwe neimwe nemifananidzo yenhengo. Anosetawo kukwegura kwemakadhi, kuchengetwa mudura kwega kwemakadhi asina kubatwa, uye kana upamhi hwemarondedzero huri hwemunhu kana hwakagovaniswa.
help-board-settings-all-boards-how-it-wo: Maka kana bvisa mucherechedzo pamutsara uye zvinochengetwa pakarepo. Kana kukwegura kwemakadhi kwabatidzwa, nyora nhamba nhatu dzemazuva mushure mawo makadhi anopera simba nenhanho. Pakuchengeta mudura kwega, nyora mazuva angagara kadhi pasina chiitiko risati raiswa mudura, kana usiye pasina chinhu kuti uzvidzime. Mafomu haambochengetwi mudura.
help-board-settings-board-view-what-it-i: Maonero ebhodhi inosarudza kuti ndeapi maonero, seMigwagwa, Marondedzero, Tafura, Karenda, Gantt kana machati, anopihwa mumenyu yeMaonero ebhodhi yebhodhi rino, uye kuti ndeapi bhodhi rinovhurika mairi. Zvinosetwa zvakasiyana kana bhodhi riri reruzhinji nekana rakavanzika.
help-board-settings-board-view-how-it-wo: Hwindo rine mutsara mumwe pamaonero mamwe nemamwe nemabhokisi mana ekumaka: maonero akajairwa nemaonero anoratidzwa pabhodhi reruzhinji, uye izvo zviviri zvakare pabhodhi rakavanzika. Maka bhokisi reRatidza remaonero kuti uapinze mumenyu nebhokisi rawo reyakajairwa kuti bhodhi rivhurike mairi.
help-board-settings-swimlane-what-it-is-: Mugwagwa une marongero emigwagwa ebhodhi rese: kana migwagwa ichigona kudhonzwa, kana kureba kwayo kuchigona kuchinjwa, kana migwagwa yese ichigovana mutsara mumwe wemisoro yemarondedzero, uye minda yeScrum inoratidzwa nemugwagwa. Mapoka emuganho weWIP, miganho yakagovaniswa yebasa riri kuitwa pamarondedzero akawanda, ariwo pano.
help-board-settings-swimlane-how-it-work: Maka mabhokisi aunoda; bhokisi reZvinogona kudhonzwa riri mutafura iri kumusoro. Mutsara mumwe chete wemisoro yerondedzero unogovaniswa unoratidza migwagwa yese nemarondedzero ese ebhodhi pasi pemutsara mumwe wemisoro unogara kumusoro, usingachinje marondedzero. Dzvanya Mapoka emuganho weWIP pasi kuti uwedzere kana kugadzirisa miganho yakagovaniswa.
help-board-settings-list-what-it-is-desc: Rondedzero ine marongero emarondedzero ebhodhi rese: kana marondedzero achigona kudhonzwa, kana upamhi hwawo huchigona kuchinjwa, kana marondedzero ese akaenzana upamhi, uye munda weScrum unoratidzwa nerondedzero. Inobatidzawo mitemo yeKuyerera kweKanban: mitemo yemarondedzero, marondedzero akapatsanurwa kuita Zviri kuitwa neZvapera, nzvimbo yekuzvipira nemuganho we-WIP pamunhu.
help-board-settings-list-how-it-works-de: Batidza zvichinjo zvaunoda; bhokisi reZvinogona kudhonzwa riri mutafura iri kumusoro. Kana kuchinja saizi kuchibvumirwa, dhonza mubato uri pakati pemarondedzero kuti uchinje upamhi. Mutsara wemutemo wekuyerera unoonekwa chete kana chinhu ichocho chabatidzwa pasaiti, uye kana chabatidzwa, ruzivo rwacho runosetwa kubva mumenyu yerondedzero imwe neimwe.
help-board-settings-shop-what-it-is-desc: Chitoro chinoshandura makadhi ebhodhi kuita chitoro chepaindaneti chinoratidzwa muMaonero echitoro. Mukuru webhodhi anosarudza kuti ndeipi minda yakagadzirwa iri mutengo, kodhi yechigadzirwa nehuwandu huripo, ndeapi marondedzero ari kutengeswa, ndeapi mareberu ari mapoka, kunonyorwa maodha uye nzira dzekubhadhara dzinopihwa.
help-board-settings-shop-how-it-works-de: Seta mitsara wodzvanya Chengetedza; zvese zvinochengetwa pamwe chete uye zvinoongororwa zvakare nesevha. Kadhi rine mutengo riri murondedzero iri kutengeswa rinova chigadzirwa. Maodha anonyorwa semakadhi muRondedzero yemaodha, iyo inofanira kuva pabhodhi rakavanzika, uye mutengi anogona kuwana tsamba yekusimbisa. Unogonawo kuita kuti Chitoro chive icho chinoonekwa nevashanyi vebhodhi reruzhinji.
help-board-settings-card-what-it-is-desc: Kadhi rinosarudza zvinoratidzwa nemakadhi madiki nemakadhi akavhurwa ebhodhi rino, uye nekurongeka kwazvo, chimwe nechimwe chakazvimirira. Rishandise kana bhodhi richivimba neminda mishoma, semuenzaniso kuisa tsananguro kana minda yakagadzirwa pekutanga, kana kuratidza zuva rekupedzisira pekutanga pamakadhi madiki.
help-board-settings-card-how-it-works-de: Hwindo rine zvikamu zviviri, ratidza pakadhi diki neratidza pa kadhi. Maka kana bvisa mucherechedzo pachikamu kana pamunda kuti uchiratidze kana uchivanze, uye dhonza mitsara kuti uchinje kurongeka kwayo. Zvimwe zvikamu zvine menyu yazvo ine mamwe marongero, seMabasa madiki nesarudzo dzekudhonza kadhi.
help-board-settings-import-export-what-i: Buritsa inonyora bhodhi rino, kana chikamu charo, mufaira: maumbirwo eWeKan pachayo, maspreadsheet, PDF, HTML, mafaira ekarenda nemaumbirwo ezvimwe zvishandiso zvakawanda. Pinza inowedzera zvirimo kubva pakubudiswa kweWeKan kubhodhi rino. Kubudisa bhodhi hakusi kopi yekuchengetedza yesaiti yese.
help-board-settings-import-export-how-it: MuBuritsa, tanga wasarudza zvekuisa, wobva wadzvanya maumbirwo uye faira rinodhaunirodha. MuPinza, sarudza faira rakabudiswa neWeKan riri mumaumbirwo ejson kana zip uye zvirimo zvaro zvinowedzerwa kubhodhi rino. Pinza inoda mvumo yekunyora pabhodhi, uye chero chimwe chazvo chinogona kudzimwa nemutariri wesaiti.
help-board-settings-notifications-what-i: Zviziviso zvinoseta zvakajairwa zvebhodhi rino zvezviziviso zvetsamba nezvemukati meapp, zviyeuchidzo zvezuva rekupedza, tsamba yemagetsi kukadhi, uye kuti zviziviso zvinosvitswa sei. Sarudzo yakajeka yenhengo pachayo inogona kukunda zvakajairwa zvebhodhi.
help-board-settings-notifications-how-it: PaTray yeziviso nepatsamba, sarudza yakajairwa kuti utevere marongero esaiti, kana Hongu kana Kwete kuti uchinje pabhodhi rino. Pasi peZviyeuchidzo zvezuva rekupedza, nyora mazuva ekuyeuchidza, akapatsanurwa nemakoma, apo 0 iri zuva rekupedza uye nhamba dziri pasi pezero mazuva ari mushure maro, wodzvanya Chengetedza. Zvikamu zvekusvitsa zviri pasi zvinoseta zvinotakurwa nechiziviso, kubatanidzwa nenguva.
help-board-settings-webhooks-what-it-is-: Mawebhook anobuda anotumira zviitiko zvebhodhi rino kune imwe sevhisi, sechishandiso chehurukuro kana kubatanidza kwako, sezvazvinoitika. Webhook imwe neimwe inotumira mashoko echiitiko pamwe nemazita nezvinongedzo zvebhodhi, rondedzero, mugwagwa, kadhi nevanhu vanobatanidzwa.
help-board-settings-webhooks-how-it-work: Nyora zita, kero yawakapihwa nesevhisi inogamuchira uye, kana ichida, token, sarudza rudzi wodzvanya Gadzira. Webhook yakachengetwa inoratidza dzimwe sarudzo: zviitiko zvainotumira, mameseji akananga kunhengo dzekadhi paMattermost, uye kuti mameseji ayo anobatanidzwa nekutumirwa rini. Igadzirise woChengetedza zvakare, kana shandisa Dzima webhook iyi kuti uimise.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-what-: Vabatsiri vaviri vemisangano yeScrum, vanowanikwa kunhengo yega yega yebhodhi. Musangano wezuva nezuva iwachi inopa nhengo yega yega nguva yakaenzana, uye Bhodhi rekutarisa kumashure rinogadzira bhodhi idzva rekutarisa kumashure kweTanga, Misa, Enderera.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-how-i: Musangano wezuva nezuva unonyora nhengo dzebhodhi nekurongeka kwakasanganiswa; Tanga inoverenga nguva yemunhu wekutanga ichidzika, inova tsvuku kana yapfuura, uye inotevera inopa mumwe kusvikira wekupedzisira. Wachi inoshanda mubrowser rako chete. Bhodhi rekutarisa kumashure rinogadzira nekuvhura bhodhi idzva rakavanzika rine marondedzero Tanga kuita, Rega kuita, Ramba uchiita neZvinofanira kuitwa.
help-board-settings-wip-limit-groups-wha: Boka remuganho weWIP muganho mumwe webasa riri kuitwa unogovaniswa nemarondedzero maviri kana kupfuura pamwe chete, pamusoro pemuganho werondedzero imwe neimwe. Zvinobatsira kana basa riri kuitwa richitambanuka pamarondedzero akawanda, seZviri kuitwa, Ongorora neKuedza, kana kana uchida kuganhurira mugwagwa wese.
help-board-settings-wip-limit-groups-how: Pasi peWedzera boka remuganho weWIP, maka marondedzero ekuverengwa pamwe chete, kana sarudza mugwagwa wodzvanya Shandisa pamutsetse wekuronga mabasa kuti umake marondedzero awo. Seta muganho wodzvanya Wedzera boka remuganho weWIP. Boka riripo rinogona kuchinjwa neShandisa, kubatidzwa kana kudzimwa neBatidza muganho weWIP, kana kubviswa neDzima.
help-board-settings-subtasks-what-it-is-: Mabasa madiki anopatsanura kadhi hombe kuita makadhi madiki anogona kupihwa vanhu, kurongerwa nguva nekufambiswa ega, nepo kadhi revabereki richiaronga nekuverenga mangani apera. Marongero aya anosarudza panogadzirwa mabasa madiki matsva uye kuti basa diki rinoratidza sei mubereki waro.
help-board-settings-subtasks-how-it-work: Sarudza kuti kadhi diki rebasa diki rinodaidza sei mubereki waro, kana makadhi ebhodhi aine chikamu cheMabasa madiki, uye bhodhi, rondedzero nemugwagwa zvinogadzirirwa mabasa madiki matsva. Sezvazvakajairwa anoenda kubhodhi rawo. Mabasa madiki pachawo anowedzerwa kubva muchikamu cheMabasa madiki chekadhi rakavhurwa.
help-rules-what-it-is-description: Mitemo inoita kuti bhodhi rizviitire: kana chimwe chinhu chaitika, chinokonzera, WeKan inoita chimwe chinhu, chiito. Semuenzaniso, kana kadhi rafambiswa kuZvapera, riratidze serapera. Mitemo inogadzirwa nevakuru vebhodhi, uye bhodhi rinogona kubvumira nhengo dzaro kuiverenga.
help-rules-how-it-works-description: Nyora musoro, sarudza chinokonzera uzadze minda yacho, wobva wasarudza chiito; mutemo unochengetwa uye unoshanda kubva ipapo kunze kwekunge wadzimwa. MuMaonero ekufamba kwebasa unogona kuvaka mitemo nekudhonza chinokonzera nechiito. Mitemo inogona kupihwa mazita matsva, kudzimwa, kubudiswa nekupinzwa, uye mutemo unogona kuva nezvinokonzera nezviito zvakawanda muruzivo rwawo.
help-member-settings-what-it-is-descript: Marongero enhengo imenyu yako pachako, inovhurwa kubva pazita rako remushandisi kana mufananidzo wako kumusoro kurudyi. Ine mapeji ako akadai seMakadhi angu, Makadhi anopera neZvakaiswa nyeredzi, pfupiso dzemabhodhi, nemarongero ako ese, kubva papurofairi nepasiwedhi kusvika pamutauro nemaumbirwo emavara.
help-member-settings-how-it-works-descri: Dzvanya zita rako remushandisi kana mufananidzo wako wosarudza chinhu; peji racho kana hwindo racho rinovhurika. Zvaunoona zvinoenderana nerudzi rweakaundi yako, basa rako nemarongero esaiti. Kana purofairi yezvinogoneka yemutariri wesaiti ichivanza zvimwe zvinhu kwauri, menyu inotaura kuti zvingani zvakavanzwa.
help-member-edit-profile-what-it-is-desc: Gadzirisa purofairi inochinja maonerwo aunoitwa nevamwe vanhu muWeKan: zita rako rizere nemavara ekutanga emazita, uye, kana saiti ichibvumira, zita rako remushandisi nekero yetsamba. Kana saiti ichibvumira, unogonawo kudzima kana kuvanza akaundi yako pano.
help-member-edit-profile-how-it-works-de: Chinja minda wodzvanya Chengetedza; hwindo rinovhara kana zvashanda uye rinoratidza kukanganisa kana zvisina kudaro. Zita remushandisi kana kero yetsamba yatoshandiswa neimwe akaundi zvinorambwa, uye kero yetsamba yakachinjwa inomakwa seisina kusimbiswa. Dzima inobvisa akaundi yako pasina kudzoserwa, nepo Vanza akaundi ichichengeta nhoroondo yako asi ichitsiva zita rako.
help-member-change-settings-what-it-is-d: chinja marongero ine sarudzo dzako pachako dzekugadzirisa nekuratidza, semibato yekudhonza, kumaka makadhi akachinja kubva pawakapedzisira kuavhura, mutsetse wekutarisisa, kuchengetedza zvekugadzirisa neEnter, kuvhura makadhi akawanda panguva imwe neruzha rwerondedzero yekuongorora. Dzinoshanda kwauri chete, pamabhodhi ese.
help-member-change-settings-how-it-works: Dzvanya chichinjo kuti uchibatidze kana uchidzime; mucherechedzo unoratidza kuti chakabatidzwa uye chinochengetwa pakarepo. PaRatidza nhamba yemakadhi kana rondedzero ine anopfuura, nyora nhamba wodzvanya Chengetedza. Maumbirwo ezuva, kutanga kwevhiki nezviziviso zvine zvinhu zvazvo muMarongero enhengo.
help-member-change-color-what-it-is-desc: chinja ruvara inoseta dingindira rako remavara reWeKan. Rinokunda dingindira resaiti kwese kwese uye neruvara rwebhodhi pamapeji ebhodhi, asi kwauri chete.
help-member-change-color-how-it-works-de: Dzvanya muenzaniso wedingindira; unoshandiswa pakarepo. Pamadingindira akapfava nekujeka unogona kusarudza mavara ako nemavhiri emavara wozviona mumuenzaniso. Sarudza dingindira rakajairwa kuti ubvise sarudzo yako uone zvakare mavara ebhodhi kana esaiti.
help-member-change-font-what-it-is-descr: Maumbirwo emavara anokubvumira kusarudza rudzi rwemavara, ukuru hwemashoko neruvara rwemashoko rwekuratidzwa kwese kweWeKan kwauri. Zvinobatsira kuverenga, semuenzaniso neukuru hwakakura kana ruvara runokodzera maziso ako.
help-member-change-font-how-it-works-des: Dzvanya yakajairwa kana rimwe remabhatani emavara; mavara akaiswa mubrowser rako chete ndiwo anopihwa. Sarudza ukuru uye sarudza ruvara rwemashoko pavhiri remavara, kana dzvanya bvisa kuti udzokere kuruvara rwedingindira. Shanduko dzinoshanda pakarepo uye dzinochengetwa mupurofairi yako, uye mutsara wemuenzaniso unoratidza mhedzisiro.
help-member-change-avatar-what-it-is-des: Avatar yako mufananidzo mudiki unoratidzwa pauri pamakadhi, mumarondedzero enhengo, mumhinduro nemumusoro. chinja Avatar inokubvumira kurodha mifananidzo, kusarudza unoshandiswa, kuidzima, kana kudzokera kumavara ako ekutanga.
help-member-change-avatar-how-it-works-d: Dzvanya Rodha avatar wosarudza mufananidzo; unowedzerwa kurondedzero, uye kudzvanya mutsara wawo kunouita avatar yako, wakamakwa. Dzvanya Mavara ekutanga emazita kuti uratidze mavara ako ekutanga pachinzvimbo. Chiratidzo chemarara chinodzima mufananidzo mushure mekunge wasimbisa. Hwindo rinoratidza miganho yeukuru nerudzi rwefaira kana saiti yaiseta.
help-member-change-password-what-it-is-d: Chinja pasiwedhi inotsiva pasiwedhi yaunopinda nayo muWeKan. Ndeyemaakaundi ane pasiwedhi yeWeKan; maakaundi anopinda kuburikidza neimwe sevhisi anochinja pasiwedhi yawo ikoko.
help-member-change-password-how-it-works: Isa pasiwedhi yako yazvino, wozoisa pasiwedhi itsva kaviri, wotumira. Saiti ingada kureba kwakaderera uye kuramba mapasiwedhi akanyanya kufanana nezita rako remushandisi kana tsamba, kana akawanikwa mudata rakabuda rinozivikanwa. Mushure meshanduko, zvikamu zvese zveakaundi yako zvinobudiswa, wopinda zvakare nepasiwedhi itsva.
help-member-passkeys-what-it-is-descript: Kiyi yekupinda inokubvumira kupinda nechigunwe, chiso, kukiya kwesikirini kana kiyi yekuchengetedza zvemudziyo uyu pachinzvimbo chepasiwedhi yako. Kiyi inogara pamudziyo wako uye WeKan inochengeta chikamu chayo cheruzhinji chete.
help-member-passkeys-how-it-works-descri: Nyora zita rakadai seFoni yangu wodzvanya Wedzera kiyi yekupinda pamudziyo uyu, wobva wasimbisa nekukiya kwesikirini kana browser ichikumbira. Makiyi ako anonyorwa nemazita awo nemazuva, uye chiratidzo chemarara chinobvisa imwe. Kana browser isingakwanise kugadzira makiyi, hwindo rinodaro.
help-member-sqrl-what-it-is-description: SQRL inokubvumira kupinda nekuverenga kodhi yeQR neapp yeSQRL, pasina pasiwedhi. Pano unowedzera chiziviso chako cheSQRL kuakaundi yako kamwe chete, kana kuchibvisa zvakare.
help-member-sqrl-how-it-works-descriptio: Dzvanya Wedzera chiziviso changu cheSQRL uye kodhi yeQR inoonekwa. Iverenge neapp yeSQRL, kana dzvanya Vhura purogiramu yeSQRL kupurogiramu iri pakombiyuta ino; hwindo rinokuudza kana chiziviso chawedzerwa, kana kana kodhi yapera nguva kana yakundikana. Bvisa chiziviso changu cheSQRL chinochibvisa paakaundi yako.
help-member-two-factor-what-it-is-descri: Kusimbiswa Kweminzvimbo Miviri kunoita kuti kupinda kukumbire kodhi yenhamba 6 kubva paapp yekusimbisa iri pafoni yako mushure mepasiwedhi yako, saka pasiwedhi yakabiwa yoga haina kukwana kupinda muakaundi yako.
help-member-two-factor-how-it-works-desc: Dzvanya Gonesa Kusimbiswa Kweminzvimbo Miviri, wobva waverenga kodhi yeQR neapp yekusimbisa kana kunyora kodhi iri pasi payo muapp. Isa kodhi yenhamba 6 inoratidzwa neapp wodzvanya Simbisa Ugonese. Kubva ipapo kupinda kunokumbira kodhi, uye hwindo rimwe chete rinogona kuzvidzima zvakare kunze kwekunge mutariri wako achizvida.
help-member-hidden-boards-what-it-is-des: Mabhodhi akavanzwa anonyora mabhodhi awakabuda maunogona kusvika kuburikidza nechikwata, sangano kana domeni yetsamba yako, saka WeKan yakaakuvanzira pachinzvimbo. Kubuda mubhodhi rakadaro hakuchinje kuva nhengo kwako kwechikwata kana sangano.
help-member-hidden-boards-how-it-works-d: Hwindo rinoratidza mutsara mumwe pabhodhi rimwe nerimwe rakavanzwa, kana kuti hapana. Dzvanya Dzorera parutivi pebhodhi kuti uridzorere kuMabhodhi ese. Izvi zvinoribvisa chete parondedzero yako yezvakavanzwa; kana uchigona kuvhura bhodhi kunoramba kuchisarudzwa nebhodhi pacharo.
help-member-change-language-what-it-is-d: chinja mutauro inosarudza mutauro wekuratidzwa kweWeKan kwauri. Sarudzo yako inochengetwa mupurofairi yako, saka inokutevera kubrowser rimwe nerimwe. Kusvikira wasarudza, WeKan inotevera mitauro yebrowser rako yozodzokera kuChirungu.
help-member-change-language-how-it-works: Mitauro inonyorwa nemazita ayo pachayo, nemureza, mutsara wedunhu pamitauro yematunhu nechinyorwa pamitauro inonyorwa kubva kurudyi kuenda kuruboshwe; uripo une mucherechedzo. Dzvanya mutauro uye kuratidzwa kunochinja pakarepo.
help-member-invite-people-what-it-is-des: Koka vanhu inotumira tsamba ine kodhi yekukoka kuvanhu vasati vava neakaundi, kuti vagone kunyoresa kunyange kuzvinyoresa kwakadzimwa. Inobvumira nhengo dzedomeni yetsamba yesangano kuunza vavanoshanda navo pasina mutariri.
help-member-invite-people-how-it-works-d: Nyora kero dzetsamba, imwe pamutsara kana dzakapatsanurwa nemakoma, maka mabhodhi avanofanira kupinda pavanonyoresa, wodzvanya koka. Hwindo rinotaura kana kukoka kwatumirwa. Unoda basa rebhodhi rinogona kukoka pabhodhi rimwe nerimwe rakamakwa, uye kero yatova neakaundi inomisa kutumira.
help-member-date-what-it-is-description: Zuva rinosarudza kuti mazuva anonyorwa sei kwauri, segore-mwedzi-zuva kana zuva-mwedzi-gore, nenguva kana pasina. Maumbirwo ako akabatidzwa anokunda ebhodhi neesaiti. Hwindo rimwe chete rinoseta zuva rekutanga revhiki nehurongwa hwekarenda.
help-member-date-how-it-works-descriptio: Kumusoro kwehwindo kunoratidza maumbirwo esaiti nebhodhi razvino, saka unogona kuona zvaungagara nhaka. Maka Marongero enhengo: Maumbirwo ezuva wosarudza maumbirwo, seta kutanga kwevhiki nehurongwa hwekarenda kana uchida, wodzvanya Chengetedza. Bvisa mucherechedzo pamaumbirwo ako wochengetedza kuti utevere bhodhi kana saiti zvakare.
help-bookmarks-what-it-is-description: Boka renyeredzi mumusoro imenyu yako yezvakachengetwa: inochengeta mabhodhi, mamwe mapeji eWeKan, uye kubva mumamenyu awo, migwagwa, marondedzero nemakadhi, kudzvanya kamwe chete. Nyeredzi dzako ndedzako woga.
help-bookmarks-how-it-works-description: Dzvanya nyeredzi kuti uise kana ubvise nyeredzi pabhodhi kana peji rauri; nhamba inoratidza kuti une mangani. Dzvanya museve kana nhamba kuti uvhure rondedzero wodzvanya mutsara kuti uende ikoko, kana Ona zvinhu zvese zvine nyeredzi kupeji rizere reZvakaiswa nyeredzi. MuMabhodhi ese / Zvakaiswa nyeredzi unogona kubvisa nyeredzi pamifananidzo nekuidhonza kuti uchinje kurongeka.
help-card-similar-cards-what-it-is-descr: Makadhi akafanana anonyora makadhi ebhodhi rino ane musoro netsananguro zvakanyanya kufanana nerino, saka kopi yechipiri yebasa rimwe chete inoonekwa basa risati raitwa kaviri. Rakanyanya kufanana rinomakwa seZvimwe yakadzokororwa.
help-card-similar-cards-how-it-works-des: Makadhi akafanana anosvika mashanu anoratidzwa pano, rimwe nerimwe nerondedzero riri mairi, uye musoro unoaverenga. Dzvanya rimwe kuti urivhure. Kuenzanisa kuenderanisa mashoko kwakajairika kunoitwa nesevha, pasina sevhisi yeAI. Chikamu ichi chinogona kuvanzwa muMarongero ebhodhi / Kadhi, mutsara weMakadhi akafanana, ratidza pa kadhi.
help-card-activities-what-it-is-descript: Zviitiko inhoroondo yekadhi pacharo: akarigadzira, akachinja musoro waro, akawedzera reberu, akarifambisa, akanyora mhinduro kana akanamira faira, uye rini. Zvinopindura kuti chii chakaitika kukadhi iri usingabvunzi munhu.
help-card-activities-how-it-works-descri: Zviitiko zvitsva zvinonyorwa zvakarongeka, nemisoro, mareberu, zvidimbu zvemhinduro nemazita emafaira zvichiratidzwa zvakarongwa sezvazviri pakadhi pacharo. Dzvanya musoro une chinongedzo kuti uende kukadhi iroro, rondedzero kana bhodhi. Mutariri wesaiti anogona kusarudza muPeneri yevatariri / Marongero / chengetedzo kuratidza mashoko akashongedzwa semashoko akajeka kana pasina zvinongedzo zvinodzvanywa.
help-card-labels-what-it-is-description: Mareberu zviratidzo zvine mavara zvebhodhi, zvinoshandiswa kubatanidza nekusefa makadhi nemusoro wenyaya, kukosha kana chero chinhu chinobvumirana nechikwata. Reberu rinogonawo kuva nezuva raro rekupedzisira, iro rinoriita nhanho huru yakareruka seSprint 1 kana v2.0 kumakadhi ese anaro.
help-card-labels-how-it-works-descriptio: Dzvanya reberu kana bhatani rekuwedzera kuti uvhure hwindo remareberu, wobva wadzvanya mareberu kuti uaise pakadhi kana kuabvisa; mucherechedzo unoratidza akasarudzwa. Penzura iri parutivi pereberu inogadzirisa zita raro, ruvara nezuva rekupedzisira, uye reberu rine zuva rekupedzisira rinoratidza zuva iroro parutivi paro. Zvinonamirwa nenzvimbo zviri muchikamu ichi chimwe chete.
help-card-dates-what-it-is-description: Kadhi rine mazuva mana asingamanikidzwe: Zvakagamuchirwa pakasvika basa, kutanga pakatanga basa, Nguva yekupedza pazuva rekupedzisira neKupera parakapedzwa. Chiratidzo chezuva rekupedzisira chine ruvara zvichienderana nekukurumidza uye chinoverenga mazuva asara, saka basa rakanonoka rinooneka pabhodhi.
help-card-dates-how-it-works-description: Dzvanya chiratidzo chekuwedzera parutivi pezuva, kana chiratidzo chezuva, sarudza zuva nenguva wochengetedza; zuva rekupedzisira risina nguva yakasarudzwa rinowana 17:00. Vhura hwindo rimwe chete zvakare kuti urichinje kana kuridzima. Kana makiyi ekukurumidza akabatidzwa, kudzvanya d pakadhi kunovhura zuva raro rekupedzisira. Kadhi rinoverengawo kuti zuva raro rekupedzisira rakachinjwa kangani.
help-card-members-what-it-is-description: Chikamu cheNhengo chinotaura kuti ndiani anobatanidzwa nekadhi: nhengo dzaro, vakapiwa basa, akarigadzira, akakumbira basa uye akaripa. Zvakakumbirwa na neZvakapihwa na zvinogona kuva nenhengo dzebhodhi uyewo chinyorwa chemashoko akasununguka, semuenzaniso zita rinobva pane imwe tracker.
help-card-members-how-it-works-descripti: Dzvanya chiratidzo chekuwedzera chakatenderera mumutsara kuti uvhure rondedzero yenhengo dzebhodhi wosarudza vanhu; vanoratidzwa semaavatar kana mavara ekutanga, uye kudzvanya avatar zvakare kunovabvisa. Pasi peZvakakumbirwa na neZvakapihwa na, chinongedzo cheWedzera chiri pasi pechiratidzo chinonyora mashoko akasununguka pachinzvimbo. Mitsara inoonekwa inosarudzwa muMarongero ebhodhi / Kadhi.
help-card-fields-what-it-is-description: Chikamu cheKadhi chine minda yebasa yekadhi pacharo, sekuvimba kwaro nemamwe mabasa, kuvharirwa, rudzi rwesevhisi, zvibodzwa zvekukosha, nhamba yaro yekuronga nemabhatani aro. Kadhi rakavhurwa rinoratidza minda yese yakasarudzwa nebhodhi kuratidzwa pamakadhi, isina chinhu kana iine, yakagadzirira kuzadzwa.
help-card-fields-how-it-works-descriptio: Zadza kana chinja munda pakarepo muchikamu ichi. Zvinoonekwa pano, muchikamu chipi uye nekurongeka kwakadii zvinosarudzwa kubhodhi rese muMarongero ebhodhi / Kadhi, muchikamu cheratidza pa kadhi: maka kana bvisa mucherechedzo pamutsara, kana kuudhonza kuti uchinje kurongeka. Kadhi diki rinotevera chikamu cheratidza pakadhi diki nenzira imwe chete.
help-card-time-what-it-is-description: Kutevera nguva kunonyora maawa akashandiswa pakadhi, nefungidziro isingamanikidzwe, mireza yeZvinobhadharisa neNguva yakawedzerwa uye rekodhi yezuva nezuva yekuti ndiani akashanda kwenguva yakareba sei. Huwandu hwese hunopa maonero enguva, uremu hwebasa nekubhadharisa ebhodhi, uye mawachi eNguva yeKuyerera nePomodoro ari pano anowedzera pahuri.
help-card-time-how-it-works-description: Dzvanya chiratidzo chenguva kana menyu yemitsetse mitatu parutivi peNguva yakashandiswa kuti uvhure Chinja nguva yakashandiswa, isa maawa (madhesimari anobvumirwa), fungidziro nemireza kana uchida, uye Chengetedza. Pasi peNguva nezuva, sarudza zuva, isa maawa nechinyorwa wodzvanya Nyora nguva; unogona kubvisa zvawakanyora kusvikira zvabvumirwa kana zvabhadharisiwa. Chiratidzo chinova tsvuku kana Nguva yakawedzerwa yamakwa.
help-card-custom-fields-what-it-is-descr: Minda yakagadzirwa iminda yebhodhi pacharo yekuwedzera pamakadhi aro, parutivi peiyo yakavakirwa mukati: shanduro, bhajeti, mutengi, bhokisi rekumaka kana sarudzo kubva murondedzero. Inotsanangurwa kamwe chete kubhodhi, uye kadhi rimwe nerimwe rinogona kuzotakura kukosha kwaro.
help-card-custom-fields-how-it-works-des: Pano unosarudza kuti ndeipi minda yakagadzirwa yebhodhi inoshandiswa nekadhi rino uye unozadza kukosha kwayo. Minda mitsva inogadzirwa muMarongero ebhodhi / Kadhi, muchikamu cheMinda yakagadzirwa, nekusarudza zita nerudzi seMashoko, Nhamba, Zuva, Rondedzero inoburuka, Bhokisi rekumaka kana Mari. Munda unogona kuratidzwa pakadhi diki zvakare, uye minda yenhamba inogona kubatanidzwa pamusoro perondedzero imwe neimwe.
help-card-planning-poker-what-it-is-desc: Poker yekuronga inobvumira chikwata kufungidzira kadhi pamwe chete. Munhu wese anosarudza kukosha kubva mudhiki asingaone zvakasarudzwa nevamwe, uye kana vhoti yapera WeKan inoratidza kuti ndiani akasarudza chii uye kukosha kwakakunda, saka fungidziro inobvumiranwa pane kufungidzirwa nemunhu mumwe.
help-card-planning-poker-how-it-works-de: Vhura menyu yemitsetse mitatu yechikamu, gadzirisa Planning Poker, kana uchida bvumira vashandisi vese vakapinda uye seta nguva yekupera, uye Chengetedza. Muvhoti wega wega anodzvanya kukosha kumwe; kudzvanya kumwe kunochinja vhoti. Mukuru webhodhi anodzvanya Pedza kuti aone mhedzisiro, onyora nhamba odzvanya Seta fungidziro. Tamba zvakare inobvisa mavhoti kuchikamu chitsva.
help-card-scrum-what-it-is-description: Zvirongwa zveScrum zvine nzvimbo yekadhi mukuronga kweScrum kwebhodhi: sprint yaro nema-sprint apfuura, chaburitswa, rudzi rwedambudziko, zvinodiwa kuti basa rigamuchirwe uye nhanho murondedzero yemabasa akamirira kuitwa. Kadhi rinogonawo kumakwa seNyaya kana Basa, izvo zvinoshandiswa nemaonero esprint nemabasa akamirira.
