help-card-scrum-how-it-works-description: Vhura Gadzirisa pasi peminda kuti uichinje uye Chengetedza; vanogona kuchinja kadhi chete ndivo vanogona kugadzirisa. Menyu yemitsetse mitatu mumusoro wechikamu inosarudza rudzi rwekadhi: hapana, Nyaya kana Basa. Ma-sprint pachawo anorongwa, anotangwa nekuvharwa mumaonero eScrum ebhodhi, uye kuti ndeipi yeminda iyi inoratidzwa zvinosetwa muMarongero ebhodhi / Kadhi.
help-card-description-what-it-is-descrip: Tsananguro ndiwo mashoko makuru ekadhi: ruzivo rwebasa, zvinyorwa, zvinongedzo kana zvinyorwa zvemusangano zvakaiswa. Inonyorwa muMarkdown, saka inogona kuva nemisoro, marondedzero, zvinongedzo, emoji nemifananidzo ichiramba iri mashoko akajeka ekugadzirisa.
help-card-description-how-it-works-descr: Dzvanya tsananguro kuti uigadzirise mubhokisi remashoko akajeka. Nyora chiratidzo cheat nekutanga kwezita kuti uwane mazano enhengo. Chengetedza, uye mashoko anoratidzwa akarongwa. Mafaira akarodhwa anogara muchikamu cheZvakabatanidzwa uye anogona kutaurwa mumashoko.
help-card-checklists-what-it-is-descript: Rondedzero yekuongorora irondedzero yezvinhu zviri pakadhi, chimwe nechimwe chichimakwa kana chapera, panhanho, zvinodiwa kuti basa rigamuchirwe kana basa remazuva ese. Kadhi rinogona kuva nemazhinji, uye kadhi diki rinogona kuratidza kuti zvinhu zvingani zvapera.
help-card-checklists-how-it-works-descri: Wedzera rondedzero yekuongorora nechiratidzo chayo chekuwedzera, wobva wawedzera zvinhu wozvimaka sezvazvinopera. Menyu yemitsetse mitatu yerondedzero imwe neimwe ine zviito zvayo: kugadzirisa zvinhu zvese panguva imwe semashoko, kubudisa kana kupinza, kuifambisa kana kuikopa, kumaka kana kubvisa mucherechedzo pazvinhu zvese, kuvanza zvinhu zvakamakwa, kuseta kudzorerwa kwega kunobvisa mucherechedzo pane zvese zuva nezuva, vhiki nevhiki kana mwedzi nemwedzi, kana kuidzima. Rondedzero yekuongorora inogonawo kuva nezuva rayo rekupedzisira.
help-card-subtasks-what-it-is-descriptio: Mabasa madiki anopatsanura kadhi hombe kuita makadhi madiki anogona kupihwa vanhu, kurongerwa nguva nekufambiswa ega, nepo kadhi rino revabereki richiaronga nekuverenga mangani apera. Basa diki ikadhi rakajairika, rinochengetwa pabhodhi rakasarudzwa remabasa madiki.
help-card-subtasks-how-it-works-descript: Dzvanya chiratidzo chekuwedzera, nyora musoro uye Chengetedza kuti ugadzire basa diki; maka Gara mireza dzekadhi ravabereki kuti ukope mareberu ekadhi rino pariri. Chiratidzo chechinongedzo chinowedzera kadhi riripo sebasa diki pachinzvimbo. Menyu yemitsetse mitatu yebasa diki rimwe nerimwe ine Zvione, Enda kubhodhi uye, kuvakuru vebhodhi, Dzima. Dzvanya musoro webasa diki kuti uuchinje.
help-card-attachments-what-it-is-descrip: Zvakabatanidzwa mafaira anochengetwa nekadhi: magwaro, mifananidzo, mavhidhiyo, marekodhi kana madura akamanikidzwa. Mufananidzo unogonawo kuva mufananidzo wechifukidziro unoratidzwa pakadhi diki.
help-card-attachments-how-it-works-descr: Dzvanya chiratidzo chekuwedzera kuti uwedzere mafaira kubva pakombiyuta yako, isa kana kudonhedza mufananidzo, batanidza rimwe kadhi, kana dhirowa mufananidzo mutsva. Muganho wehukuru nemhando dzemafaira dzinobvumirwa zvinoratidzwa pasi pesarudzo idzi. Dzvanya chakabatanidzwa kuti uchivhure muslideshow, uye shandisa mabhatani ari parutivi pacho kuti uchidhaunirodhe, uchichinje zita kana uchidzime; menyu yacho yemitsetse mitatu ine sarudzo dzemufananidzo wechifukidziro.
help-card-comments-what-it-is-descriptio: Mhinduro ihurukuro yekadhi: mibvunzo, mhinduro, zvigadziriso nezvisarudzo, zvichichengetwa pamwe nebasa razvinotaura. Mhinduro inogona kupindura yakatangira, uye mhinduro yacho inoratidzwa pasi payo setambo.
help-card-comments-how-it-works-descript: Nyora mumunda wemhinduro, uchishandisa Markdown uye uchidudza vanhu nechiratidzo cheat, woitumira. Dzvanya pindura parutivi pemhinduro kuti uipindure; bhena remu pindura ku rinoratidza zvauri kupindura, uye kurivhara kunoita mhinduro yakajairika. Unogona kugadzirisa kana kudzima mhinduro dzako, uye pamamwe mabhodhi munyori wemhinduro chete ndiye anogona kuichinja.
help-card-stickers-what-it-is-descriptio: Zvinonamirwa zviratidzo zvidiki zvinoiswa pakadhi, sechigunwe chakasimudzwa, chipukanana, wachi kana mukombe, kuti rimakwe nekukurumidza usingashandise reberu kana ruvara. Zvinoratidzwa pakadhi diki nepakadhi rakavhurwa.
help-card-stickers-how-it-works-descript: Dzvanya chinonamirwa musarudzo kuti uchiwedzere kukadhi; mucherechedzo unoratidza kuti chiri pakadhi, uye kuchidzvanya zvakare kunochibvisa. Mukadhi, muchinjikwa mudiki uri parutivi pechinonamirwa unochibvisa. Kuwedzera nekubvisa kunoda mvumo yekuchinja kadhi.
help-card-locations-what-it-is-descripti: Kadhi rinogona kuva nenzvimbo dzakawanda, nzvimbo dzinoitirwa basa, sehofisi yemutengi, saiti kana nzvimbo yechiitiko. Imwe neimwe ine zita, kero uye, kana zvichizivikanwa, makonati ane chinongedzo chevhura mu map.
help-card-locations-how-it-works-descrip: Zadza zita renzvimbo, kero, latitude nelongitude wodzvanya Chengetedza. Kuisa chinongedzo chemepu kunobvumira hwindo kuwana nzvimbo yacho pacharo, saka hapana anofanira kunyora makonati. Kudzvanya nzvimbo pakadhi kunoivhura zvakare kuti uichinje kana uidzime, uye muchinjikwa uri parutivi payo unoibvisa pakarepo.
help-card-dependencies-what-it-is-descri: Kuvimba nemamwe mabasa kunobatanidza kadhi rino nemamwe makadhi: rinoavharira, rinovharirwa nawo, rinoagadzirisa, rinoadzokorora kana rine hukama nawo. Kana kuvimba kwabatidzwa muMarongero enhengo, kunodhirowewa semitsetse yemiseve ine mavara pabhodhi rese, saka kurongeka kwebasa kunooneka nekukurumidza.
help-card-dependencies-how-it-works-desc: Sarudza rudzi rwehukama neruvara, wobva watsvaga wodzvanya kadhi rekubatanidza naro. Chinongedzo chinoratidzwa muKuvimba nemamwe mabasa kwekadhi uye semutsetse pabhodhi. Dzvanya mutsetse, kana shandisa Kuvimba nemamwe mabasa kwekadhi, kuti uchinje rudzi rwawo, ruvara kana chiratidzo, kana kuubvisa. Unogonawo kudhonza mubato wekubatanidza wekadhi diki uchiuisa pane rimwe kadhi.
help-card-action-items-what-it-is-descri: Zvinofanira kuitwa zvinoshandura mitsara yezvekuita iri muzvinyorwa zvemusangano zvakaiswa kuita makadhi. Mitsara yakadai seTODO: Bhuka nzvimbo, mutsara webasa usina kumakwa, kana mutsara unotanga nekududza munhu inowanikwa nemaumbirwo ayo, pasina AI.
help-card-action-items-how-it-works-desc: Hwindo rinonyora makadhi angagadzirwa, rimwe nerimwe riine mucherechedzo nenhengo inonongedzerwa nekududzwa. Bvisa mucherechedzo pane zvausingade wodzvanya Gadzira. Makadhi matsva anoenda murondedzero imwe chete nekadhi rino uye anodzokera kubatanidza naro. Kududzwa kunova nhengo chete kana munhu iyeye ari nhengo inoshanda yebhodhi.
help-card-history-what-it-is-description: Nhoroondo irondedzero yeshanduko yega yega yakaitwa pakadhi rino: ndiani akachinja chii, rini, uye kubva pakukosha kupi kuenda kupi. Chero shanduko inogona kusarudzwa nekudzorerwa, saka kukanganisa kunogona kugadziriswa kunyange gare gare.
help-card-history-how-it-works-descripti: Nyora muTsvaga kuti uderedze mitsara, kana dzvanya avatar yemunhu kuti uone shanduko dzake chete. Famba nemapeji nemiseve. Maka mutsara mumwe kana kupfuura wodzvanya Dzorera; mitsara yakawanda inodzorerwa kubva pane yekare seshanduko imwe, iyo inogonawo kudzoserwa. Ctrl+Z neCtrl+Y zvinodzoserawo nekuitazve shanduko yako yekupedzisira.
help-card-qr-code-what-it-is-description: Kodhi yeQR inoratidza chinongedzo chekadhi rino sekodhi yaunogona kuverenga, kuti uvhure kadhi pafoni kana tabhuleti usinganyore kero yaro. Haichinje chinhu pakadhi.
help-card-qr-code-how-it-works-descripti: Nongedzera kamera yefoni pakodhi wovhura chinongedzo; kero inoratidzwawo semashoko pasi payo. Kodhi inodhirowewa mubrowser rako uye hapana chinotumirwa kwese kwese. Ani nani anoiverenga anofanira kupinda uye kuva nemvumo yebhodhi. Chinongedzo chakareba zvakanyanya kukodhi yeQR chinoshumwa pachinzvimbo.
help-card-move-what-it-is-description: Fambisa kadhi rinofambisa kadhi kune imwe nzvimbo pabhodhi rino kana kune rimwe bhodhi. Rinoita zvinoitwa nekudhonza, uyewo pasingasvike kudhonza, serimwe bhodhi kana nzvimbo chaiyo murondedzero refu.
help-card-move-how-it-works-description: Sarudza bhodhi, mugwagwa nerondedzero, wobva wasarudza kadhi uye kana uchienda pamusoro kana pasi paro. Unogona kuchinja musoro, kunyora chikonzero chekufambisa chisingamanikidzwe, uye kumaka Siyai chinongedzo panzvimbo yekutanga kuti uchengete kadhi rakabatanidzwa paraive. Dzvanya Zvapera kana nzvimbo yekuenda yaiswa. Shift+M inovhurawo hwindo iri, uye nzvimbo yekuenda inorangarirwa pabhodhi rimwe nerimwe.
help-card-copy-what-it-is-description: Kopa kadhi rinogadzira kopi itsva yakazvimirira yekadhi pabhodhi rino kana pane rimwe, ine nhamba yayo nemakopi ayo emhinduro, marondedzero ekuongorora, zvakabatanidzwa nemabasa madiki.
help-card-copy-how-it-works-description: Gadzirisa musoro kana uchida; musoro usina chinhu haukopi chinhu. Sarudza bhodhi, mugwagwa nerondedzero, wobva wasarudza kadhi uye kana kopi ichienda pamusoro kana pasi paro, wodzvanya Zvapera. Kana kopi ikarambwa, chikonzero chinoratidzwa pano. Shift+C inovhurawo hwindo iri, uye nzvimbo yekuenda inorangarirwa pabhodhi rimwe nerimwe.
help-card-recurrence-what-it-is-descript: Kudzoreredzwa kwega kunoita kuti WeKan igadzire kopi itsva yekadhi rino murondedzero imwe chete nehurongwa, pabasa rinodzokororwa semushumo wevhiki kana invoice yemwedzi zvaizogadzirwa zvakare nemaoko.
help-card-recurrence-how-it-works-descri: Sarudza Zuva nezuva, Vhiki nevhiki kana Mwedzi nemwedzi, kana Zvakadzimwa kuti uzvimise; Zvakadzimwa ndizvo zvakajairwa. Sevha inobva yaita makopi yoga, pasina chimwe chinodiwa. Kuchengeta kadhi mudura kunorimisawo kugadzira mamwe makopi, kunyange nguva ichiri yakasetwa.
help-card-copy-many-what-it-is-descripti: Kopa muenzaniso kumakadhi akawanda inogadzira makopi akawanda ekadhi rino panguva imwe. Kadhi rinoshanda semuenzaniso: marondedzero aro ekuongorora, zvakabatanidzwa, mareberu nemimwe minda zvinoenda kukopi yega yega, uye musoro netsananguro chete ndizvo zvinosiyana.
help-card-copy-many-how-it-works-descrip: Mubhokisi remashoko, nyora chinhu chimwe pakadhi rimwe nerimwe chine musoro waro netsananguro, uchitevera muenzaniso wakatozadzwa. Sarudza bhodhi, mugwagwa, rondedzero nenzvimbo iri parutivi pekadhi, wodzvanya Zvapera. Kana mashoko asiri mumaumbirwo akakodzera, hapana chinogadzirwa uye kukanganisa kunoratidzwa pano.
help-card-color-what-it-is-description: Isa ruvara inopa kadhi ruvara rwaro rwekumashure kuti rionekwe zvakanyanya pabhodhi, semuenzaniso tsvuku pabasa rinokurumidzira kana ruvara rwemutengi. Mashoko ekadhi anoitwa kuti averengeke paruvara irworwo pachawo.
help-card-color-how-it-works-description: Dzvanya rumwe rwemavara ane mazita, ruvara rwakagadzirwa rwatoshandiswa pabhodhi rino, kana sarudza chero ruvara pasi peruvara rwakagadzirwa, wodzvanya Chengetedza. bvisa inobvisa ruvara. Ruvara runoratidzwa pakadhi diki nepakadhi rakavhurwa, kunze kwekunge rwadzimwa muMarongero ebhodhi / Kadhi.
help-card-drawing-what-it-is-description: Mufananidzo unokubvumira kudhirowa kana kunyora nemaoko pakadhi nemouse, munwe kana peni: chidhirowa, dhayagiramu, siginecha kana chinyorwa chakanyorwa nemaoko. Mufananidzo unoramba uchigadziriswa uye mufananidzo wawo unochengetwawo sechakabatanidzwa chekadhi.
help-card-drawing-how-it-works-descripti: Sarudza ruvara nehupamhi hwemutsetse wodhirowa. Dzosera zvawaita inodzokera nhanho, Chidzimisi chinobvisa mitsetse chinobata, uye bvisa inobvisa zvese. Chengetedza inochengeta mitsetse pakadhi uye inochengeta mufananidzo sechakabatanidzwa; mufananidzo mutsva unova mufananidzo wechifukidziro wekadhi. Mifananidzo yakachengetwa inonyorwa pano kuti ivhurwe nekugadziriswa zvakare, uye Dhaunirodha seSVG inochengeta mumwe sefaira.
help-card-more-what-it-is-description: Zvimwe zvinoratidza chinongedzo chekadhi, makadhi evabereki varo uye pariri kugadzirwa. Ndipo panoitwa kadhi basa diki rerimwe kadhi, uye ndipo panodzima mukuru webhodhi kadhi zvachose.
help-card-more-how-it-works-description: Kopa chinongedzo chekadhi inokopa kero yekadhi. Pasi peChinja mubereki wekadhi, sarudza bhodhi rekwakabva nekadhi revabereki, kana hapana kuti uriite kadhi repamusoro zvakare; Wedzera rimwe kadhi rine basa iri pasi paro rinowedzera vabereki, uye muchinjikwa uri parutivi pemumwe unomubvisa. Dzima, kuvakuru vebhodhi chete, inobvisa kadhi zvachose mushure mekusimbisa.
help-card-create-board-what-it-is-descri: Gadzira bhodhi (Kadhi) rinoshandura kadhi kuita chinongedzo chebhodhi idzva. Nderekadhi rakakura rikava purojekiti yaro: basa rinoenda kubhodhi raro, uye kadhi rinosara paraive senzira yekupinda mariri.
help-card-create-board-how-it-works-desc: Zita rebhodhi idzva rinozadzwa nemusoro wekadhi; richinje kana uchida wodzvanya Gadzira bhodhi (Kadhi). Bhodhi rinogadzirwa iwe uri mukuru waro, uye kadhi rinobva ravhura bhodhi iroro. Hapana chimwe chinochinja pakadhi. Kana zvikarambwa, chikonzero chinoratidzwa uye hapana chinochinja.
help-card-link-to-board-what-it-is-descr: Batanidza nebhodhi inoisa kadhi rakabatanidzwa nekadhi rino pane rimwe bhodhi riripo. Kadhi rinobva raratidzwa pamabhodhi ese ari maviri: rekutanga rinosara pariri, uye chinongedzo chinoratidza zviri mariri paunochiisa.
help-card-link-to-board-how-it-works-des: Sarudza bhodhi, mugwagwa nerondedzero, wobva wasarudza kadhi uye kana chinongedzo chichienda pamusoro kana pasi paro, wodzvanya Zvapera. Murondedzero isina chinhu chinongedzo chinoenda pasi. Kadhi rekutanga harichinjwi, uye mareberu haakopwi. Nzvimbo yekuenda inorangarirwa pabhodhi rimwe nerimwe.
help-card-actions-what-it-is-description: Menyu yemitsetse mitatu yekadhi, kadhi zviito, inounganidza zvese zvaunogona kuita nekadhi rese, pane nemumwe wemunda waro. Zvinoonekwa zvinoenderana nebasa rako pabhodhi.
help-card-actions-how-it-works-descripti: Fambisa uye kopa ine Fambisa kadhi, Kopa kadhi, Chengetedza semuenzaniso, Kopa muenzaniso kumakadhi akawanda, Kudzoreredzwa kwega nekufambisa kumusoro kana kuzasi kwerondedzero. Zvobva zvauya Tarisa neIsa nyeredzi, neChitarisiko chine Isa ruvara, Mufananidzo neGadzira makadhi kubva pazvinofanira kuitwa. Kugovana kune chinongedzo chekadhi, Batanidza nebhodhi, Kodhi yeQR neNhoroondo, wozotevera Buritsa nePinza. Dura rine kuchengeta kadhi mudura, Zvimwe neGadzira bhodhi (Kadhi).
help-admin-version-what-it-is-descriptio: Chikamu cheShanduro chinoratidza zviri kushandiswa neWeKan iyi: shanduro yeWeKan nekuiswa kwayakaitwa, hurongwa hwekushanda, Meteor, dhatabhesi neNode.js. Ndicho chikamu chekutanga chePeneri yevatariri / Marongero uye ruzivo rwekukopa mumushumo wekukanganisa paunokumbira rubatsiro.
help-admin-version-how-it-works-descript: Verenga tafura, yakarongwa muPlatform, OS, Meteor, Database neNode. Dzvanya Tarisa shanduro kuti uenzanise neshanduro itsva dzakaburitswa dzeWeKan, FerretDB, Meteor, Node neNPM; painenge ichishanda inoti iri kutakura, uye kana kutarisa kwakundikana unoona meseji imwe yekukundikana pachinzvimbo.
help-admin-appearance-what-it-is-descrip: Chitarisiko chinosarudza kuti WeKan iyi inoita sei uye zvinoratidzwa neMabhodhi ese: zvikamu zvakavanzwa semabhodhi eruzhinji kana zviitiko zvebhodhi, vanogona kugadzira mabhodhi, maumbirwo ezuva, upamhi hunovhurika ruzivo rwekadhi, kero dzezvinongedzo, kubatanidza kwega kwetracker yematambudziko yekunze, zita rechigadzirwa, mavara nemalogo.
help-admin-appearance-how-it-works-descr: Chinja minda yeboka rimwe wodzvanya Chengetedza yeboka iroro, inochengeta boka iroro chete. Mimucherechedzo pasi pemabhodhi ose: vanza zvinoreva kuti chinhu chacho chakavanzwa, kunze kwemabhodhi anogona kugadziriswa nemushandisi wese akapinda, ayo anomakwa kana zvichibvumirwa. chinja ruvara inochengetedza pasina bhatani reChengetedza uye ndiro boka chete rinoonekwa nemukuru wesangano pacharo.
help-admin-features-what-it-is-descripti: Zvinogoneka ndipo panobatidza kana kudzima mutariri wesaiti zvikamu zveWeKan zvisingamanikidzwe pasaiti yese: maonero ebhodhi, vabatsiri, zvishandiso zveKanban neScrum, minda yekadhi, Uremu hwebasa nekugona, Bhajeti nekubhadharisa, SQRL, ActivityPub, Mitemo yekungoverenga uye maAPI anoenderana asingamanikidzwe. Migwagwa nemarondedzero zvinogara zviripo.
help-admin-features-how-it-works-descrip: Bvisa mucherechedzo pane zvisingafanire kupihwa neWeKan iyi, kusanganisira minda yekadhi isingafanire kuratidzwa nebhodhi ripi neripi, wodzvanya Chengetedza. Chinhu chakabviswa mucherechedzo chinonyangarika pakuratidzwa kwevanhu vese uye sevha inochirambawo, asi data racho rinochengetwa. Unogona kuda kubvumidzwa kwezvinogoneka zvinowedzerwa negadziriso yeWeKan, uye kudoma vashandisi vekuedza vanoramba vachiona zvinogoneka zvakadzimwa.
help-admin-feature-profiles-what-it-is-d: Purofairi yezvinogoneka inopa vashandisi, zvikwata kana masangano akasarudzwa WeKan diki nekuvavanzira zvimwe zvinogoneka zvisingamanikidzwe, nepo vamwe vese vachiramba vachiona zvese. Inogona kuvanza zvinogoneka zvimwe chete zvinogona kudzimwa nechikamu cheZvinogoneka.
help-admin-feature-profiles-how-it-works: Dzvanya Wedzera purofairi, ipe zita, maka zvinogoneka zvainovanza uye nyora vashandisi vayo, zvikwata nemasangano, wodzvanya Chengetedza yechikamu. Mazita asina kuwirirana nemunhu anoshumwa mushure mekuchengetedza uye haachengetwi. Mapurofairi anoedzwa nekurongeka kwepeji, uye menyu yenhengo yemushandisi inomuudza kuti ndeipi purofairi inovanza zvinogoneka zvingani.
help-admin-security-what-it-is-descripti: chengetedzo ine zvichinjo zvesevha yese zvezvinogona kuitwa nemashoko akashongedzwa nezvinogona kupinzwa kana kubudiswa. Zvishandise kumisa zvinongedzo zvinodzvanywa, kuratidza mashoko ese akashongedzwa semashoko akajeka ekwakabva, kuvharira kupinza kana kubudisa, kuganhurira ukuru hwekupinza, kusiya maavatar, kana kutsiva zvitupa chaizvo zvevashandisi nemazita asingazivikanwe.
help-admin-security-how-it-works-descrip: Batidza chichinjo uye chinochengetwa pakarepo; ukuru hukuru hwekupinza hunochengetwa paunobuda mumunda, uye kukosha kusina chinhu kunoreva kuti hapana muganho. Chichinjo chega chega chakadzimwa sezvakajairwa uye chinoshandiswa nesevha, saka kupinza kana kubudisa kwakadzimwa kunorambwa kunyange mumwe munhu akakudana zvakananga.
help-admin-activities-what-it-is-descrip: Zvichinjo zvitatu zvesevha yese zvemasaiti anofanira kuganhurira kutevera zviitiko: kumisa kunyora kuti ndiani akaitei, kumisa kutumira zviziviso zvezviitiko, kana kumisa vashandisi kutarisa mabhodhi, marondedzero nemakadhi.
help-admin-activities-how-it-works-descr: Batidza chichinjo uye chinochengetwa pakarepo. Kana zviitiko zvadzimwa, hapana chitsva chinonyorwa uye zvakanyorwa kare hazvichaonekwi. Kana zviziviso zvadzimwa, hapana zviziviso zvemukati meapp, zvetsamba kana zvimwe zvinotumirwa. Kana kutarisa kwadzimwa, hapana anogona kuchinja nhanho yekutarisa. Bvisa mucherechedzo kuti uzvibatidze zvakare; zviitiko zvisina kunyorwa panguva iyoyo hazvidzoki.
help-admin-delete-what-it-is-description: Kudzima muWeKan kazhinji kunongomaka marondedzero, makadhi nezvakabatanidzwa sezvakadzimwa kuti zvigone kudzorerwa. Chikamu ichi chine chichinjo chimwe chete chinobvumira mutariri wesaiti kuparadza zvinhu izvozvo zvachose.
help-admin-delete-how-it-works-descripti: Maka Batidza kudzima zvachose kweMukuru Wepasi Rose; zvinochengetwa pakarepo uye hazvidzime chinhu zvoga. Zviratidzo zvekudzima zvinobva zvaonekwa panopihwa kudzima zvachose, serondedzero iri mumarara kana bhodhi rakachengetwa mudura reMabhodhi ese. Shanduko yega yega yemarongero nekuedza kwega kwega kwekudzima zvachose zvinonyorwa muKudzoreredza. Bvisa mucherechedzo kana wapedza.
help-admin-announcement-what-it-is-descr: Bhena resaiti yese rekuudza mushandisi wese akapinda chimwe chinhu panguva imwe, sekumbomira kwekugadzirisa, kero itsva kana shanduko yemitemo. Rakasiyana nechiziviso chebhodhi pacharo.
help-admin-announcement-how-it-works-des: Maka Chiziviso chiri kushanda muhurongwa hwese, nyora meseji wodzvanya Chengetedza. Bhena rinoonekwa kumusoro kweKumba, Mabhodhi ese nemabhodhi ayo vashandisi vari nhengo. Mushandisi anogona kurivhara, uye rinoramba rakavharwa kwaari kusvikira wachinja mashoko. Bvisa mucherechedzo pabhokisi kuti uribvise kuvanhu vese.
help-admin-accessibility-what-it-is-desc: Peji rekuwanikwa kwekushandisa ndipo panoudza WeKan iyi vashandisi vayo kuti inowanikwa sei kumunhu wese uye kuti vabate ani pamusoro pechipingamupinyi. Chikamu ichi chinobatidza peji iroro uye chinoseta musoro waro nezviri mariri.
help-admin-accessibility-how-it-works-de: Maka Peji rekuwanikwa rakabatidzwa, inochengetwa pakarepo, wobva wanyora musoro nezviri mukati wodzvanya Chengetedza. Zviri mukati zvinorongwa setsananguro yekadhi. Nhengo dzebhodhi dzinobva dzawana chinongedzo cheKuwanikwa kwekushandisa mudivi rekurudyi rebhodhi. Bvisa mucherechedzo kuti uvanze chinongedzo zvakare.
help-admin-translation-what-it-is-descri: Mashoko eshanduro akagadzirwa anotsiva mashoko eWeKan akavakirwa mukati pasaiti ino, nemutauro, semuenzaniso kushandisa izwi resangano rako pabhodhi kana kugadzirisa shoko shanduro yakagadziriswa isati yasvika.
help-admin-translation-how-it-works-desc: Dzvanya itsva, sarudza mutauro, isa kiyi yeshoko rekutsiva (kwete mutsara weChirungu) nemashoko ekuratidza pachinzvimbo, wobva woChengetedza. Mashoko eshanduro chete emutsara uripo ndiwo anogona kugadziriswa, uye mutsara unogona kudzimwa kubva mumenyu yawo. Zvinotsiva zvinoshanda pamashoko anogadzirwa nesevha, setsamba; mubrowser parizvino zvinoratidzwa kuvatariri vesaiti chete.
help-admin-pwa-what-it-is-description: Chikamu chePWA chinodzora zvinoverengwa nemabrowser nemafoni pamusoro peWeKan pachayo: zviratidzo zvekuwedzera zvemeta nelink papeji imwe neimwe, web manifest inoshandiswa kana WeKan yaiswa seapp, nefaira rezvinongedzo zveapp yeAndroid rinobvumira app yeAndroid kuvhura zvinongedzo zveWeKan.
help-admin-pwa-how-it-works-description: Maka chikamu chaunoda kugadzirisa, chinochengetwa pakarepo, isa zviratidzo zvako kana JSON wodzvanya Chengetedza. JSON isina kururama inorambwa uye hapana chinochengetwa. Zviratidzo zvemeta zvinowedzerwa sezvinhu zvemeta chete, saka maskripti, masitayera nezviratidzo zvinorodha peji zvakare zvinobviswa. Kana chichinjo chakadzimwa, WeKan inoshandisa zvayo zvakajairwa.
help-admin-global-webhooks-what-it-is-de: Mawebhook ehurongwa hwese anotumira meseji kune imwe kero, sehurukuro kana sevha yekuzviitira, pese panoitika chimwe chinhu pabhodhi ripi neripi reWeKan iyi. Anoshandisa fomu imwe chete neyemawebhook ebhodhi. Chikamu ichi chinonyorawo mahost emukati angasvikwa nemawebhook newebhook yekupinda nekunyoresa.
help-admin-global-webhooks-how-it-works-: Zadza fomu isina chinhu nezita, kero, token isingamanikidzwe nerudzi, rwenzira imwe kana mbiri, wodzvanya Gadzira. Pawebhook yakachengetwa unogona kuidzima, kusarudza zviitiko zvainotumira nekusvitsa kwainoita, wobva woChengetedza. Nyora mahost ari panetiweki yeWeKan pasi peNzvimbo dzemukati, imwe pamutsara, kuti mawebhook abvumirwe kuasvika.
help-admin-shared-labels-what-it-is-desc: Mareberu akagovaniswa anopa reberu zita rimwe neruvara rumwe pamabhodhi akawanda panguva imwe: pabhodhi rega rega, pamabhodhi esangano, kana pamabhodhi echikwata. Ashandise pamareberu akadai seZvinokurumidzira kana Mutengi anofanira kuita zvakafanana kwese kwese.
help-admin-shared-labels-how-it-works-de: Wedzera reberu mumutsara wekupedzisira rine zita, ruvara nekatalogi, wodzvanya Wedzera reberu rakagovaniswa; mutsara wega wega unochengetedza kana kudzima wega. Pamareberu ekadhi, nhengo dzebhodhi dzinoona mareberu akagovaniswa anogona kushandiswa nebhodhi radzo dzodzvanya rimwe kuti riwedzere. Kuchinja zita kana ruvara pano kunorichinja pabhodhi rega rega, uye kuridzima kunorisiya pamabhodhi iwayo sereberu ravo pachavo.
help-admin-email-what-it-is-description: Chikamu cheE-mail chinoseta kuti WeKan inotumira sei tsamba, kungave kuburikidza nemarongero etsamba esevha pachayo kana kuburikidza nemupi webasa akasetwa pano, uye chine marongero ane hukama: domeni yetsamba ipi inogona kukoka vanhu kana kuzvinyoresa kwakadzimwa, kana vashandisi vachigona kuchinja kero yavo, zvekuita netsamba dzadzoka, nemafomu etsamba dzekukoka nedzezviitiko.
help-admin-email-how-it-works-descriptio: Maka Batidza pasi pemarongero etsamba, sarudza SMTP kana mupi webasa akavakirwa mukati, zadza zita remushandisi, pasiwedhi nekero yemutumiri wodzvanya Chengetedza; pasiwedhi yakachengetwa inochengetwa kana munda wasiiwa usina chinhu. Tumira tsamba yekuedza kwauri kuti uone kuti zvinoshanda. Pasina mucherechedzo, marongero etsamba esevha pachayo anoramba achishandiswa. Minda yemafomu isina chinhu inochengeta tsamba dzakavakirwa mukati.
help-admin-notifications-what-it-is-desc: Zvakajairwa zvesaiti yese zvezviziviso: kana Tray yeziviso yemukati meapp netsamba zvakabatidzwa kana zvakadzimwa kuvanhu vese, uye kuti tsamba, tray nemawebhook anobuda zvinosvitsa sei sezvakajairwa. Marongero ebhodhi nemarongero enhengo yega yega anogona kuzvikunda munzvimbo yazvo.
help-admin-notifications-how-it-works-de: Sarudza Hongu kana Kwete paTray yeziviso nepaTsamba yemagetsi; sarudzo inochengetwa pakarepo. Vhura chanera kuti useta maumbirwo ayo, zvainoratidza, kuti zviziviso zvinobatanidzwa sei uye kuti zvinotumirwa rini, chimwe nechimwe chichichengetwa pakarepo. Vakuru vebhodhi nenhengo vanogona kusarudza yakajairwa kuti vadzokere pane zvawakaseta pano. Marongero etsamba yemagetsi kukadhi ari muchikamu chimwe chete ichi.
help-admin-domains-what-it-is-descriptio: Madomeni anonyora domeni yetsamba yega yega inoshandiswa nemaakaundi paWeKan iyi, nekuti imwe neimwe ine vashandisi vangani. Inzira inokurumidza yekuona kuti ndeapi masangano ari pasaiti ino uye kuona domeni isingatarisirwe usingaverenge rondedzero yese yevashandisi.
help-admin-domains-how-it-works-descript: Verenga tafura, mutsara mumwe padomeni imwe neimwe nenhamba yevashandisi vayo. Nyora chikamu chedomeni mubhokisi rekutsvaga wodzvanya Enter kuti uiwane, uye famba pakati pemapeji nemabhatani eyapfuura neinotevera. Hapana chinochengetwa; tafura inoverengwa patsva pese painoratidzwa.
help-admin-organizations-what-it-is-desc: Masangano anobatanidza vashandisi nekambani, dhipatimendi kana mutengi kuti mabhodhi nemabhodhi emafomu agovaniswe navo vese, nhengo dzawo dzichengetwe dzakaenderana nedhairekitori seLDAP, uye, nemultitenancy, sangano rinogona kuva nemadomeni aro, chiratidzo chebhizinesi nevakuru varo.
help-admin-organizations-how-it-works-de: Dzvanya itsva mumusoro wekoramu yekutanga kuti ugadzire rimwe, Gadzirisa kuti uchinje mutsara, nemenyu yemutsara kuti uudzime kana kugadza vakuru vesangano. Zvichinjo zvemutsara zvemafomu akagovaniswa, kuwedzera nhengo kumabhodhi nekuenderanisa nhengo kubva kumupi wekupinda zvinochengetwa pakarepo. Maka Wedzera nhengo dzebhodhi kubva muSangano rimwe chete kuti uganhurire vanogona kuwedzerwa kumabhodhi.
help-admin-teams-what-it-is-description: Zvikwata zvinobatanidza vashandisi vanoshanda pamwe chete kuti bhodhi kana mabhodhi emafomu agovaniswe nechikwata chese, nhengo dzichengetwe dzakaenderana nedhairekitori seLDAP, uye rondedzero yeVanhu igone kuderedzwa kuchikwata chimwe. Zvinoshanda semasangano pasina chikamu chemutengi.
help-admin-teams-how-it-works-descriptio: Dzvanya itsva mumusoro wekoramu yekutanga kuti ugadzire chikwata, Gadzirisa kuti uchichinje, kana menyu yemutsara kuti uchidzime. Zvichinjo zvemutsara zvinochengetwa pakarepo. Kuti uise vanhu muzvikwata, vamake muPeneri yevatariri / Vanhu / Vanhu wodzvanya Zvikwata. Maka Wedzera nhengo dzebhodhi kubva muChikwata chimwe chete kuti uganhurire vanogona kuwedzerwa kumabhodhi.
help-admin-people-what-it-is-description: Vanhu vanonyora akaundi yega yega paWeKan iyi netsamba yayo, kana iri mukuru, purofairi yezvinogoneka, kana ichishanda, nyika dzayakapinda kubva, kana yakakiyiwa, chiitiko chekupedzisira nezuva rayakagadzirwa. Ndipo paunogadzira, kugadzirisa, kudzima, kuvhura, kuzviita mumwe, kuvanza nekudzima maakaundi.
help-admin-people-how-it-works-descripti: Tsvaga nezita remushandisi, zita kana tsamba wodzvanya Enter, uye deredza neRatidza neChikwata. Dzvanya itsva kuti ugadzire mushandisi uye Gadzirisa kuti uchinje mumwe. Dzvanya chiratidzo chekushanda kuti udzime kana kubatidza, nechikiyi chitsvuku kana Vhura vese kuti uvhure. Menyu yemutsara ine kuzviita mumwe, kuvanza nekudzima; maka vanhu vakawanda wodzvanya Zvikwata kuti uchinje zvikwata zvavo.
help-admin-locked-users-what-it-is-descr: Kudzivirira kwekufungidzira mapasiwedhi kunokiya akaundi mushure mekukundikana kupinda kakawanda. Chikamu ichi chinoseta kuti kukundikana kungani kunoita kuti ikiyiwe, kuti kunotora nguva yakareba sei uye nguva iyo kukundikana kunoverengwa mukati mayo, zvakasiyana kumazita evashandisi aripo nekumazita evashandisi asipo.
help-admin-locked-users-how-it-works-des: Zadza kukundikana, nguva yekukiyiwa nenguva yekuverenga, mumasekonzi, kuvashandisi vanozivikanwa nevasingazivikanwe wodzvanya Chengetedza; kukosha kutsva kunoshanda pakarepo pasina kutangazve. Kuti uone nekusunungura maakaundi akakiyiwa, vhura Peneri yevatariri / Vanhu / Vanhu, sarudza Vashandisi vakakiyiwa chete wodzvanya chikiyi chitsvuku, kana Vhura vese.
help-admin-audit-log-what-it-is-descript: Rekodhi yekuongorora inzira yezvakaitwa nevatariri vesaiti, zvitsva kutanga: rini, ani, chiito chipi, kana chakabudirira, ruzivo rwacho nekero yachakabva. Inopindura kuti ndiani akachinja chimwe chinhu uye rini pamarongero evanhu, kupinda, kuchengetedza nemakopi ekuchengetedza.
help-admin-audit-log-how-it-works-descri: Verenga tafura yeNguva, Mutariri, Chiito, Ruzivo neIP; chiito chakarambwa chinomakwa nekukanganisa kwacho. Nyora mubhokisi rekutsvaga kuti uderedze mitsara nemutariri, chiito kana ruzivo, uye shandisa miseve iri pasi petafura kufamba pakati pemapeji.
help-admin-roles-what-it-is-description: Mabasa evashandisi anosarudza kuti ndeapi mabasa ebhodhi anogona kukoka vanhu kubhodhi, anokubvumira kugadzira mabasa akagadzirwa kubva pane zvinogona kuitwa nenhengo yebhodhi, uye anoratidza zvinogona kuitwa nebasa rega rega. Vatariri vesaiti vanogara vaine kodzero dzese.
help-admin-roles-how-it-works-descriptio: Pasi pebvumira koka ku bhodhi, maka mabasa anogona kukoka wodzvanya Chengetedza. Pasi peMabasa akagadzirwa, nyora zita, maka zvinogona kuitwa nebasa wodzvanya Wedzera basa; mutsara wega wega unochengetedza kana kudzima wega, uye vakuru vebhodhi vanogona kuzopa nhengo basa iroro. Tafura yeMamiriro emabasa inoratidza mhedzisiro yemimucherechedzo yako, kunyange usati wachengetedza.
help-admin-shared-templates-what-it-is-d: Matemplate anogoverwa anokubvumira kutarisa mabhodhi emafomu evashandisi anogona kugovaniswa nesangano, chikwata kana domeni yetsamba. Mimucherechedzo inosarudzawo kuti ndedzipi mhando dzemapoka dzingagovaniswa nebhodhi remuenzaniso kubva kuMabhodhi ese / Mafomu.
help-admin-shared-templates-how-it-works: Maka Masangano, Zvikwata kana Madomeni; mucherechedzo wega wega unochengetwa pakarepo pasaiti yese. Pasi pechikamu chega chega chakamakwa unoona boka rega rega, vashandisi varo nemabhodhi avo emafomu, uye kudzvanya bhodhi remuenzaniso kunorivhura. Kana mafomu eboka achisvika kunhengo dzaro zvinosetwa pasangano nechikwata chimwe nechimwe muzvikamu zvazvo.
help-admin-login-what-it-is-description: Pinda inosarudza zvinobvumirwa pakupinda, sekukanganwa pasiwedhi, kuzvinyoresa, kuchinja zita remushandisi, kudzima akaundi yako nesarudzo yenzira. Inokubvumirawo kutsiva marongero ekupinda esevha pasina kutangazve, sekupinda nepasiwedhi, nzira yakajairwa, kureba kwechikamu chekupinda, kubuda kwega, mitemo yepasiwedhi uye Kusimbiswa Kweminzvimbo Miviri kunomanikidzwa.
help-admin-login-how-it-works-descriptio: Maka kana bvisa mucherechedzo pamabhokisi ePinda: Bvumira; rimwe nerimwe rinochengetwa paunoridzvanya. Kana kuzvinyoresa kwakadzimwa, shandisa Koka vanhu kukoka kero kumabhodhi akasarudzwa. Mufomu yemarongero munda wega wega unotaura kukosha kuri kushanda; nyora kana sarudza kukosha wochengetedza, kana usiye pasina chinhu kana sarudza yakajairwa kuti udzokere kumarongero esevha. Nzira yega yega yekupinda ine chikamu chayo mumenyu yeVanhu.
help-admin-saml-what-it-is-description: Kupinda neSAML kunobvumira vanhu kupinda kuburikidza nemupi wezvitupa wesangano rako pachinzvimbo chepasiwedhi yeWeKan. Mupi anosimbisa kuti ndivanaani nemeseji yakasainwa uye WeKan inovapinza, ichigadzira akaundi pakupinda kwekutanga.
help-admin-saml-how-it-works-description: Isa kero yekupinda yemupi wezvitupa nechitupa chekusaina, zita remupi reWeKan iyi nedzimwe sarudzo dziri muchikamu chino, kana mumarongero esevha; kukosha kwakachengetwa pano kunokunda kwesevha. Kana zvabatidzwa, peji rekupinda rinoratidza bhatani rePinda neSAML rinoendesa mushandisi kumupi wezvitupa nekumudzosa.
help-admin-ldap-what-it-is-description: Kupinda neLDAP kunobvumira vanhu kupinda nezita remushandisi nepasiwedhi zvavatova nazvo mudhairekitori renyu, seActive Directory kana OpenLDAP. WeKan inotarisa pasiwedhi padhairekitori, inogadzira akaundi pakupinda kwekutanga uye inogona kuchengeta mazita, tsamba, kuva mukuru, masangano nezvikwata zvakaenderana nedhairekitori.
help-admin-ldap-how-it-works-description: Zadza kero yedhairekitori, port, kuvharidzira, base uye kuti vashandisi vanotsvagwa sei, wobva wachengetedza; kukosha kwakachengetwa kunokunda marongero esevha uye yakajairwa inodzosa kukosha kwesevha. Dzvanya Edza kubatana kwe-LDAP kuti uedze marongero ari kushanda, uye Enderanisa vashandisi veLDAP izvozvi kuti umhanyise kuenderanisa kwekumashure pakarepo. Sarudza LDAP senzira yakajairwa muchikamu chePinda.
help-admin-oauth2-what-it-is-description: Kupinda neOAuth2 neOpenID Connect kunobvumira vanhu kupinda neakaundi pane imwe sevhisi, seKeycloak, Authelia kana GitLab, pachinzvimbo chepasiwedhi yeWeKan. Kusiyana nevapi vekupinda vemasocial vakatarwa, unoinongedzera kune chero mupi nekumupa kero dzake.
help-admin-oauth2-how-it-works-descripti: Nyoresa WeKan seapplication pamupi, wobva waisa client id yayo, chakavanzika, kero yesevha, endpoints uye kuti minda yevashandisi vayo inoenderana sei neWeKan pano; kukosha kwakachengetwa pano kunokunda marongero esevha uye kunoshanda pakupinda kunotevera pasina kutangazve. Peji rekupinda rinobva raratidza bhatani rekupinda rine mashoko anosetwa muchikamu chePinda.
help-admin-cas-what-it-is-description: CAS ihurongwa hwekupinda kamwe chete: vanhu vanopinda kamwe chete pasevha yeCAS yesangano rako, uye WeKan inovimba netikiti rainodzosa, saka WeKan haimboona pasiwedhi.
help-admin-cas-how-it-works-description: Isa kero dzebase, dzekupinda nedzekusimbisa dzesevha yeCAS pano woibatidza; kukosha kwakachengetwa pano kunokunda marongero esevha. Sarudza CAS senzira yakajairwa muchikamu chePinda, kana rega vashandisi vaisarudze musarudzo yenzira. Kupinda kunoendesa browser kupeji rekupinda reCAS nekudzokera kuWeKan, wapinda.
help-admin-header-login-what-it-is-descr: Kupinda kuburikidza nemisoro kunobvumira proxy inovimbwa yakatoita kupinda kamwe chete kuudza WeKan kuti mushandisi ndiani, saka mushandisi anopinda pasina pasiwedhi uye akaundi inogadzirwa pakushanya kwekutanga.
help-admin-header-login-how-it-works-des: Marongero aya anoratidzwa pano ekungoverenga chete uye haagone kuchengetwa kubva muPeneri yevatariri, nekuti proxy inovimbwa inogona kupinda sechero munhu; anosetwa mumarongero esevha nekutangazve. Proxy inofanira kusimbisa mushandisi, kutumira misoro yechitupa nekubvisa misoro yakadaro inotumirwa nevatengi, uye kero dzeproxy dzakanyorwa chete ndidzo dzinovimbwa.
help-admin-oauth-providers-what-it-is-de: Aya mabhatani ekupinda emasocial akagadzirwa kare: Google, GitHub, Facebook, Twitter, Meteor Developer, Weibo neMeetup. Rimwe nerimwe rinoda chete app id nechakavanzika zvaunopihwa nemupi, uye zvinogona kushandiswa pamwe nekupinda kweOAuth2 kwakajairika.
help-admin-oauth-providers-how-it-works-: Gadzira app pasaiti yevagadziri yemupi nekero yekudzoka yeWeKan, wobva waisa id yayo nechakavanzika pano wobatidza mupi; kukosha kwakachengetwa pano kunokunda marongero esevha. Bhatani rekupinda remupi iyeye rinobva raonekwa papeji rekupinda.
help-admin-passwordless-what-it-is-descr: Kupinda pasina pasiwedhi kunobvumira mushandisi kupinda nekodhi yekamwe chete inotumirwa neWeKan kutsamba yake, pachinzvimbo chepasiwedhi. Kureruka kwevanhu vanokanganwa mapasiwedhi, kwete nhanho yechipiri yekusimbisa, uye kwakachengeteka sebhokisi retsamba remushandisi chete.
help-admin-passwordless-how-it-works-des: Ita shuwa kuti tsamba dzinobuda dzinoshanda, wobva wazvibatidza pano; kukosha kwakachengetwa pano kunokunda marongero esevha. Peji rekupinda rinobva rapa kutumira kodhi yekupinda netsamba: mushandisi anonyora kero yake, anogamuchira kodhi inoshanda kwenguva pfupi, anoiisa uye anopinda.
help-admin-backup-what-it-is-description: Kopi yekuchengetedza inotora dura reWeKan iyi ikozvino kana nehurongwa, nedata remashoko, zvakabatanidzwa nemaavatar sesarudzo dzakasiyana, uye inoidzorera. Mutariri wesaiti anochengeta saiti yese kana sangano rimwe; mukuru wesangano pacharo anochengeta mabhodhi aro chete. Kopi yekuchengetedza inoenderera inotumira shanduko yega yega kuti ugone kudzorera kune chero nguva.
help-admin-backup-how-it-works-descripti: Sarudza chikamu, maka zvekuisa wodzvanya Gadzira kopi yekuchengetedza izvozvi; kopi yakazara inoda zvese zvitatu nesaiti yese. Seta hurongwa hwezuva nezuva, vhiki nevhiki kana mwedzi nemwedzi uye Chengetedza. Dzvanya Rondedzero yemakopi wodzorera imwe, kungave kuwedzera data risipo chete kana kutsiva zvese. MuKopi yekuchengetedza inoenderera, seta folda yekuenda, zvirimo nenguva yekuchengeta, wobva wasarudza nzvimbo yekudzorera.
help-admin-attachments-what-it-is-descri: Zvikamu zveZvakabatanidzwa zvinosarudza kunochengetwa zvakabatanidzwa zvemakadhi nemaavatar, kukura kwazvingaita, nguva yazvinochengetwa uye kuti zvinofamba sei pakati pezvichengetero. Mafaira anogona kuchengetwa padhisiki resevha, mudhatabhesi kana muchengetero wegore seS3, MinIO, Azure, Google Cloud Storage kana WebDAV.
help-admin-attachments-how-it-works-desc: Sarudza chikamu kubva mumenyu yekuruboshwe. Seta chengetero rinoenda mafaira matsva, gadzirisa chengetero rimwe nerimwe nezvichinjo zvaro zvekuverenga nekunyora, uye fambisa zvakabatanidzwa kana maavatar kubva pane rimwe chengetero kuenda kune rimwe. Miganho inoseta ukuru hwekurodha nekudhaunirodha, Kuchengetedza kunodzima zvakabatanidzwa zvekare mushure memazuva akati, uye Kutamisa dhatabhesi kunofambisa data remashoko pakati peMongoDB neFerretDB.
help-admin-problems-summary-what-it-is-d: Peji rekutanga rePeneri yevatariri / Matambudziko uye kuongorora kwako kwezuva nezuva kwesevha yese. Rinokuudza zviri kushanda izvozvi, zvisina kunaka izvozvi, uye kuti mushumo wega wega waunganidza matambudziko matsva mangani, nemabhatani ekuagadzirisa kana kubvuma kuti waona.
help-admin-problems-summary-how-it-works: Mamiriro anonyora kutamisa nekugadzirisa kuri kuitika, zvinogona kunonotsa kupinda, wozotevera dambudziko rega rega nenhamba yaro nezvekuita, nebhatani reGadzirisa makadhi akaputsika, Dzorera kana Gadzirisa pazvinodiwa. Kugadzirisa kunodzima data kunokukumbira kudzvanya simbisa kutanga. Pasi peHutano hwedata, Tanga inomhanyisa kuongorora kwekumashure. Pasi peMatambudziko, maka mishumo yawaongorora wodzvanya Bvuma kuti waona kuti udzorere nhamba yayo itsva kuzero, kana bvisa kuti udzime mitsara yayo.
help-admin-problems-security-what-it-is-: Kuedza kwega kwega kwakarambwa kana kwakaonekwa nemurindi wekuchengetedza: kwaive chii, kwakaipa sei, ndiani akaedza, kubva kupi uye kangani. Kunoratidza kuti mumwe munhu akaedza, kwete chete kuti buri rakavharwa. Zvichinjo zvekuchengetedza pachazvo zviri muPeneri yevatariri / Marongero / chengetedzo.
help-admin-problems-security-how-it-work: Mitsara inonyorwa itsva kutanga, uye kuedza kwakadzokororwa mutsara mumwe une nhamba yeKuedza inokura, nepo Ruzivo ruchitaura zvakaonekwa nemurindi. Nyora zita, boka, kwakabva, zita remushandisi kana kero mubhokisi rekutsvaga kuti usefe paunenge uchinyora, uye dzvanya zita remushandisi kuti uvhure akaundi iyoyo. Bvuma kana bvisa mushumo paMatambudziko / Pfupiso.
help-admin-problems-impersonation-what-i: Nzira yekuongorora yevatariri vanoita sevamwe vashandisi. Kuzviita mumwe kunobvumira mutariri kuona WeKan sezvainoonekwa nemushandisi mumwe, semuenzaniso kubudisa bhodhi rakavanzika, uye mushumo uyu unoramba uchiratidza simba iroro gare gare.
help-admin-problems-impersonation-how-it: Mutsara unonyorwa kana mutariri akasarudza Zviite mumwe mushandisi muPeneri yevatariri / Vanhu, akagadzira token yekupinda yeumwe mushandisi kuburikidza neREST API, kana akabudisa bhodhi, kadhi kana chakabatanidzwa achizviita mumwe. Mutsara wega wega unoratidza zuva, mutariri, mushandisi akazviitwa, bhodhi nechikonzero, zvitsva kutanga. Dzvanya zita kuti uvhure mushandisi iyeye, uye tsvaga neEnter. Hapana chiri pano chinochinja kana kudzima mutsara.
help-admin-problems-password-length-what: Inoratidza kuti ndiani anopinda nepasiwedhi pfupi kupfuura kureba kwakaderera, kubva kupi, uye kana vakaichinja kubva ipapo. Unogona kuona vangabatwa usati wamanikidza kureba kwakaderera kwemapasiwedhi matsva.
help-admin-problems-password-length-how-: Seta Kureba kwepasiwedhi kwakaderera, maka Manikidza kureba kwakaderera kuti uramba mapasiwedhi matsva mapfupi, wodzvanya Chengetedza. Kupinda hakumborambwi, asi kana kumanikidza kwabatidzwa, akaundi ine pasiwedhi yekare pfupi inokumbirwa kutanga yaichinja. Tafura ine mutsara mumwe paakaundi imwe neimwe nekupinda kwekutanga nekwekupedzisira, kero, nhamba yekupinda uye kuti yakagadziriswa rini. Sefa nePasiwedhi pfupi zvikuru, Zvagadziriswa kuita pasiwedhi refu zvakakwana kana zvose. Maakaundi anopinda kuburikidza neLDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS kana Sandstorm haanyorwi.
help-admin-problems-performance-what-it-: Inotsanangura kuti WeKan inotakura sei makadhi ebhodhi, izvo zvinosarudza kuti bhodhi hombe rinodhura zvakadii kurivhura. Itsananguro chete, pasina chekudzvanya kana kuchengetedza.
help-admin-problems-performance-how-it-w: Kutakura kwemakadhi kunozviitira pabhodhi rimwe nerimwe: bhodhi rine makadhi anopfuura 500 rinotakura chete makadhi anoonekwa murondedzero imwe neimwe paunodzika, nenhamba dzinobva pasevha, uye bhodhi diki rinotakura makadhi ese. Mushandisi wesevha anogona kumanikidza kutakura zvese kana zvishoma nezvishoma, kana kuchinja nhamba yemakadhi, mumarongero esevha wozotangazve. Maonero eNhamba dzekuongorora ebhodhi anoratidza maitiro arinoshandisa.
help-admin-problems-speed-what-it-is-des: Inonyora zvikumbiro zvemapeji ewebhu neREST API zvakatora nguva yakareba kupindurwa, saka unogona kuona kuti ndeapi mapeji kana kudana kunonoka uye kangani.
help-admin-problems-speed-how-it-works-d: Chikumbiro chega chega kunze kwemafaira asingachinji chinoyerwa nguva, uye chinotora masekonzi maviri kana kupfuura sezvakajairwa chinonyorwa. Chikumbiro chimwe chete chinononoka chinochengetwa semutsara mumwe une nhamba nezuva zvinokwira, uye Ruzivo runoratidza nzira, path uye nguva yachakatora. Kutsvaga kunosefa paunenge uchinyora, uye Matambudziko / Pfupiso inozvibvuma kana kuzvibvisa. Muganho, kana kuuudzima, zvinosetwa mumarongero esevha. Nguva dzepanguva iyoyo dzekudana kwemethods nepublications dziri muZviyero pachinzvimbo.
help-admin-problems-tests-what-it-is-des: Kuzviongorora kwesevha iri kushanda kwakakundikana. Nguva pfupi mushure mekutanga, WeKan inotarisa kuti dhatabhesi rinopindura, kuti dhairekitori remafaira rinogona kunyorwa, kuti ndangariro ichine nzvimbo uye kuti dhisiki rine nzvimbo yakasununguka.
help-admin-problems-tests-how-it-works-d: Kuongorora kunoitwa kamwe chete, anenge masekonzi 15 mushure mekunge sevha yatanga, uye kukundikana chete ndiko kunogadzira mutsara: Kunobva kunodoma kuongorora uye Ruzivo runopa meseji yekukanganisa kwako. Hapana matambudziko matsva zvinoreva kuti hapana chakakundikana kubva pakabviswa mushumo. Chikamu ichi hachina bhatani rekuzviitazve, saka tangazve WeKan. Bvuma kana bvisa paMatambudziko / Pfupiso.
help-admin-problems-cpu-what-it-is-descr: Inotarisa mutoro weprocessor yemuchina wese, nekuti WeKan nedhatabhesi rayo pakombiyuta imwe chete zvinogona kushandisa CPU yakawanda zvekunonotsa zvimwe zvirongwa. Nguva dzeCPU yakakwira kwenguva yakareba dzinonyorwa pano, uye mabasa marefu anononoka muchina pawakabatikana.
help-admin-problems-cpu-how-it-works-des: Mutsara wepamusoro unoratidza Kushandiswa kweCPU kwazvino, nhamba yemacore, avhareji yemutoro, muganhu wepasi wazvino, avhareji nemuganhu wepamusoro, uye zviri kuitwa neWeKan, zvichirodhwa zvakare masekonzi mashanu ega ega. Tafura iri pasi inonyora nguva dzakapfuura dzekubatikana: mutsara wekutanga, mutsara mumwe chete pamusoro pekunonotsa, nemutsara wekupedzisira une nguva yakatorwa, pamusoro-soro uye kana kunonotsa kwakabatsira. Kutsvaga kunosefa paunenge uchinyora. Miganho, kana kudzima kutarisa, zviri mumarongero esevha.
help-admin-problems-ram-what-it-is-descr: Inotarisa kuti muchina wese unoshandisa ndangariro neswap zvakadii, uye inonyora pakatanga nguva yekushandiswa kwakawanda kwendangariro nepainopera. Kupera kwendangariro, kana kushandisa swap, kunononotsa kana kuputsa WeKan nezvimwe zvirongwa pamuchina mumwe chete.
help-admin-problems-ram-how-it-works-des: Mutsara uri kumusoro unoratidza kushandiswa kwendangariro kwazvino sepesenti uye semagigabyte akashandiswa neese, neswap kana muchina uine, zvichirodhwa zvakare masekonzi mashanu ega ega. Pasi payo, tafura ine mutsara mumwe wekutanga nemumwe wekupedzisira panguva imwe neimwe yendangariro yakawanda, zvitsva kutanga, mitsara 10 papeji, nebhokisi rekutsvaga. Bvuma kana bvisa paMatambudziko / Pfupiso. Miganho iri mumarongero esevha uye inoverengwa kana sevha yatanga.
help-admin-problems-disk-what-it-is-desc: Inotarisa nzvimbo yakasununguka pamadhisiki ane dhatabhesi, zvakabatanidzwa nezvakarodhwa. Dhisiki rakazara rinoita kuti kurodha kukundikane uye rinomisa dhatabhesi kunyora, saka izvi zvinopa yambiro kare izvozvo zvisati zvaitika.
help-admin-problems-disk-how-it-works-de: Mutsara mumwe unoshanda padhisiki rimwe nerimwe unoratidza pesenti yakashandiswa, magigabyte akasununguka neese, nzvimbo yaro nezvinochengetwa neWeKan imomo, zvichirodhwa zvakare masekonzi 30 ega ega, uye dhisiki riri munguva yakakwira rinoratidzwa zvakajeka. Tafura iri pasi ine mutsara wekutanga newekupedzisira panguva imwe neimwe yekushandiswa kwakawanda, uye kutsvaga kunosefa paunenge uchinyora. Bvuma kana bvisa paMatambudziko / Pfupiso. Mamwe madhisiki ekutarisa anogona kuwedzerwa mumarongero esevha.
help-admin-problems-instrumentation-what: Zviverengi zvepanguva iyoyo zvezviri kuitwa nesevha yeWeKan iyi: kubatana kungani kwakavhurika, uye kuti method nepublication imwe neimwe inodanwa kangani, inokundikana kangani uye inotora nguva yakareba sei. Zvinoratidza kuti ndechipi chikamu cheWeKan chakabatikana kana chiri kukundikana izvozvi pasina chishandiso chekutarisa chakasiyana.
help-admin-problems-instrumentation-how-: Mutsara wepamusoro unoratidza kubatana kunoshanda, kwakavhurwa nekwakavharwa uye pakatanga kuverenga. Mabhawa pachikamu chimwe nechimwe, seMakadhi, Mabhodhi, Pinda kana Zvakabatanidzwa, anoratidza kudana, avhareji yenguva nezvikanganiso; dzvanya chikamu kuti uratidze mitsara yacho chete, uye zvakare kuti uratidze zvese. Tafura inonyora kudana, zvakapedzwa, zvikanganiso, uye avhareji nenguva yepamusoro. Inorodhwa zvakare masekonzi mashanu ega ega, inoverenga chete chiitiko chesevha ichi, uye inotanga zvakare kubva pazero kana yatangazve.
help-admin-problems-broken-cards-what-it: Inonyora makadhi asingagone kuratidzwa nebhodhi ripi neripi, nekuti bhodhi, mugwagwa kana rondedzero yaari kuva yawo haipo. Inosanganisira mabhodhi ese ari pasevha, kunyange uri nhengo kana kwete.
help-admin-problems-broken-cards-how-it-: Mutsara wega wega unoratidza musoro wekadhi, id yaro, misoro yebhodhi, mugwagwa nerondedzero zvichiripo, rudzi rwaro uye parakagadzirwa; chitokisi chisina chinhu ndicho chikamu chisipo. Nyora chikamu chemusoro wodzvanya Enter kuti utsvage, uye famba nemapeji nemabhatani eyapfuura neinotevera. Chikamu ichi chinongonyora makadhi chete: agadzirise neGadzirisa makadhi akaputsika paMatambudziko / Pfupiso. Kuvhura bhodhi kunogadzirisawo makadhi aro.
help-admin-problems-files-what-it-is-des: Inonyora zvakabatanidzwa zvakachengetwa pasevha ino, nemabhatani anotarisa zvinotaurwa nedhatabhesi pamusoro pechakabatanidzwa chimwe nechimwe neavatar zvichienzaniswa nezviri muchengetero chaizvo. Kuongorora kunowana mafaira asipo, asina kutaurwa kana akamakwa zvisizvo nenhoroondo ingazvitsanangura.
help-admin-problems-files-how-it-works-d: Tafura inoratidza muenzaniso, zita refaira, ukuru, rudzi nema-id echakabatanidzwa, bhodhi nekadhi, nebhokisi rekutsvaga. Check files and history, Check file types and extensions kana Check missing and untracked files inotanga kuongorora; Cancel check inokumisa. Mushure mezvo, verenga nhamba, kufukidzwa nemuenzaniso wezvakawanikwa, kana shandisa Download status summary. Kuongorora hakumbochinji, kufambisa kana kudzima faira kana rekodhi.
help-admin-problems-rules-what-it-is-des: Inonyora mutemo wega wega wekuzviitira uri pasevha nebhodhi rawo, saka unogona kuona panzvimbo imwe zvinoitwa neWeKan yoga pamabhodhi ese, semuenzaniso paunenge uchitsvaga mutemo unofambisa makadhi zvisingatarisirwi.
help-admin-problems-rules-how-it-works-d: Tafura inoratidza musoro wemutemo, bhodhi rawo, rudzi rwechiito chawo nerudzi rwechiitiko chechinokonzera, mitsara 10 papeji, yakarongwa nebhodhi. Nyora chikamu chemusoro wemutemo wodzvanya Enter kuti utsvage, uye bvisa zviri mubhokisi wodzvanya Enter kuti uone zvese zvakare. Chikamu ichi ndechekungoverenga chete: kuti uchinje mutemo, vhura bhodhi rawo uugadzirise mumitemo yebhodhi iroro.
help-admin-problems-webhooks-what-it-is-: Tafura yewebhook yega yega iri pasevha, mawebhook ebhodhi rimwe nerimwe neehurongwa hwese: bhodhi rine imwe neimwe, akaiwedzera uye kwainotumira. Inobatsira usati wadzima mawebhook, mushure mechiitiko, kana kana data richienda kumwe kusina anorangarira kuzvigadzira.
help-admin-problems-webhooks-how-it-work: Mutsara mumwe pawebhook imwe neimwe, itsva kutanga, unoratidza bhodhi, muridzi, zita, kero, rudzi, kana yakabatidzwa kana yakadzimwa, zviitiko zvainotumira, kana token yakaiswa, uye payakawedzerwa. Sefa Mawebhook ose, Yakabatidzwa kana Yakadzimwa, uye tsvaga neEnter. Matoken nemapasiwedhi haambooratidzwi. Dzvanya musoro webhodhi kuti uvhure bhodhi uchinje webhook yaro ipapo, nepo mawebhook ehurongwa hwese ari muPeneri yevatariri / Marongero / Mawebhook ehurongwa hwese.
help-admin-problems-boards-what-it-is-de: Inonyora bhodhi rega rega riri pasevha nekuonekwa kwaro, nhengo, masangano nezvikwata. Inopindura kuti ndeapi mabhodhi aripo, ndiani anogona kuona rimwe nerimwe uye ndiani ari pariri, usingavhure bhodhi rega rega.
help-admin-problems-boards-how-it-works-: Mutsara wega wega unoratidza musoro, id, mvumo, kana bhodhi rakachengetwa, nhengo dziri kushanda, nemasangano nezvikwata zvarinogovaniswa nazvo. Nyora chikamu chemusoro wodzvanya Enter kuti utsvage, kana sarudza zvose, Zveruzhinji, Vashandisi vakapinda kana Zvakavanzika pasi peMvumo; zvese zviri zviviri zvinotanga zvakare kubva papeji rekutanga. Famba nemapeji nemabhatani eyapfuura neinotevera. Hapana chinogona kuchinjwa pano.
help-admin-problems-cards-what-it-is-des: Inonyora kadhi rega rega riri pasevha, pariri uye ndiani ari pariri, pamabhodhi ese kunyange uri nhengo kana kwete. Inopindura kuti kadhi riri kupi uye kuti nhengo dzaro nevakapiwa basa ndivanaani, usingavhure mabhodhi rimwe nerimwe.
help-admin-problems-cards-how-it-works-d: Mutsara wega wega unoratidza musoro wekadhi, bhodhi raro, mugwagwa nerondedzero, nemazita evashandisi venhengo dzaro nevakapiwa basa. Nyora chikamu chemusoro wodzvanya Enter kuti utsvage, izvo zvinotanga zvakare kubva papeji rekutanga, uye famba nemapeji nemabhatani eyapfuura neinotevera. Hapana chinogona kuchinjwa pano.
help-admin-problems-recovery-what-it-is-: Paunochengetedza dhatabhesi uye unopedzisa basa rakamira pakati. Panoratidza nhoroondo yekuongororwa kwedhatabhesi, makopi ekuchengetedza nekudzorera, uye panokubvumira kusarudza zvinoitika kutsamba dzakamira, zviziviso, tsamba dzemitemo, mabasa ekuenderanisa marondedzero nekupinzwa kwemabhodhi kwakavhiringidzwa.
help-admin-problems-recovery-how-it-work: Kubva kumusoro unoona mabhatani ekutarisa mafaira, wozotevera zvikamu zvakaita semutsetse wetsamba dzakamirira kutumirwa, zviziviso zvezviitiko zvakamirira, tsamba dzemitemo, mabasa ekuenderanisa marondedzero nekupinza kwakavhiringidzwa, chimwe nechimwe chine mabhatani akaita seMisa kwechinguva, Enderera mberi, Edza zvakare, Rasa kana Chengeta. Simbisa kana wakumbirwa, uye kana basa rakabatikana, dzvanya Rodha zvakare woedza zvakare. Tafura iri pasi inonyora chiitiko chega chega chekudzoreredza nesarudzo; ratidza zvose, Zvapera, Zvakundikana kana Zvakadzimwa uye tsvaga neEnter.
help-admin-problems-offices-what-it-is-d: Inoverenga kupinda kwakabudirira nemunhu nekero, saka unogona kuona kuti akaundi imwe neimwe inopinda kubva kupi uye kuti ndedzipi kero dzinogovaniswa nemaakaundi akawanda. Kero inogovaniswa ingave hofisi, VPN kana kubatana kwenetiweki kunogovaniswa; hazviratidze kuti maakaundi iwayo munhu mumwe chete.
help-admin-problems-offices-how-it-works: Vanhu vanonyorwa mumwe nemumwe, mumwe nemumwe aine mutsara pakero imwe neimwe: IPv4, IPv6, kupinda kwekutanga nekwekupedzisira, nhamba yekupinda, uye nzvimbo kana proxy iri pamberi peWeKan ichiipa. Nyora zita remushandisi, zita rizere, kero kana nzvimbo wodzvanya Enter kuti utsvage, uye famba nemapeji nemabhatani eyapfuura neinotevera. Hapana chinovharirwa nekuda kwemushumo uyu, saka kero inogovaniswa haimbovharira vanhu kunze.
help-admin-problems-api-what-it-is-descr: Inoratidza kuti ndeapi maendpoint eREST API anoshandiswa, nani uye kangani. Zvimwe zvikamu zvinotaura zvakaenda zvisizvo; ichi chinotaura zviri kukumbirwa sevha kuita. Pasevha isina kubatidzwa REST API, chinoramba chisina chinhu.
help-admin-problems-api-how-it-works-des: Mutsara wega wega iakaundi neendpoint, yakabatikana zvikuru kutanga: nhamba yekudana, payakatanga nepayakapedzisira kudanwa, nekero dzeIPv4 neIPv6 dzazvino nenzvimbo yadzo. Zita remushandisi risina chinhu rinoreva kudana kubva kumunhu asina akaundi, anozivikanwa nekero. Nyora endpoint, method, zita remushandisi kana kero kuti usefe paunenge uchinyora, uye famba nemitsara 10 panguva imwe.
help-admin-problems-database-what-it-is-: Inotsanangura zvakataurwa nedhatabhesi. Kukanganisa kunobva kuMongoDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB kana SAP HANA kazhinji kunonyorerwa vagadziri vayo, saka chikamu ichi chinodoma dhatabhesi, chinoisa dambudziko murudzi rwakadai sedhisiki, kupinda, syntax kana nguva yapera, uye chinowedzera tsananguro yakajeka nenhanho inotevera.
help-admin-problems-database-how-it-work: Mitsara inonyorwa itsva kutanga. Ruzivo runotaura zvinoreva dambudziko nezvekuita, wozotevera meseji yedhatabhesi pacharo, uye mamwe makoramu anoratidza dhatabhesi, rudzi, kuipa, chiito, ndiani uye kubva kupi kana zvichizivikanwa, uye kangani. Kutsvaga kunosefa paunenge uchinyora, kusanganisira mashoko edhatabhesi pacharo. Kana zvagadziriswa, bvuma kana bvisa paMatambudziko / Pfupiso.
help-admin-problems-integrity-what-it-is: Inoratidza kana sevha ino yakamira zvakanaka, chii chakaiputsa, uye kana kopi yekuchengetedza inoenderera yakakundikana, pamwe nemabhatani ekutarisa mafaira akafanana neeMushumo wemafaira. Tarisa pano mushure mekumira kusingatarisirwi.
help-admin-problems-integrity-how-it-wor: Mutsara unonyorwa pakutangazve pasina kumira zvakanaka, sekutangazve kunokurumidza kana sevha yadzoka mukati memaminitsi matatu kana sekuputsika kana yakamira kwenguva refu, pakukanganisa kusina kubatwa nemeseji yako, uye kana kopi yekuchengetedza inoenderera yakundikana. Mitsara itsva kutanga, 10 papeji, uye kutsvaga kunosefa paunenge uchinyora. Mabhatani ekutarisa mafaira ari kumusoro haachinje faira kana rekodhi. Bvuma kana bvisa paMatambudziko / Pfupiso.
help-admin-cloud-what-it-is-description: Peneri yeGore ipeji remushandisi wehosting rekutonga madomeni mazhinji eWeKan evatengi panzvimbo imwe: mazuva awo, madhatabhesi, ma-invoice, matikiti erubatsiro nehurukuro, marekodhi eDNS nenzira dzesevha yewebhu. Iripo chete kana marongero esevha achiibatidza padomeni yayo, uye vatariri vesaiti ikoko chete, Cloud Admins, ndivo vanoiona.
help-admin-cloud-how-it-works-descriptio: Wedzera madomeni evatengi nemazuva awo uye kana rimwe nerimwe riine WeKan yaro nedhatabhesi kana kugovana iyi, edza kubatana kwedhatabhesi, uye nyora ma-invoice. Domeni imwe neimwe inowana bhodhi rerubatsiro rematikiti nehurukuro. Tarisa nekugadzirisa marekodhi eDNS, isa nzira dzesevha yewebhu, uye nyora kero dzinobvumirwa kuti uganhurire panogona kupinda Cloud Admins. Vatengi vanopinda kuti vaone domeni yavo.
help-all-boards-what-it-is-description: Mabhodhi ese ipeji rinonyora mabhodhi ako. Menyu yekuruboshwe inosarudza mabhodhi anoratidzwa, seZvakaiswa nyeredzi, zvasara, Kumba, Mafomu, dura, nzvimbo yebasa kana sangano kana chikwata, uye bhawa remusoro rine kuronga, kutsvaga, kubudisa neKusarudza zvakawanda.
help-all-boards-how-it-works-description: Dzvanya chikamu mumenyu yekuruboshwe wobva wadzvanya bhodhi kuti urivhure. Shandisa ronga mabhodhi pakurongeka kwekudhonza kwako kana nemusoro, nemenyu yemaonero kuti uchinje pakati pemifananidzo yemabhodhi netafura. Batidza Kusarudza zvakawanda umake mabhodhi kuti uaise mudura, uakope, uabudise kana kuita rimwe bhodhi rako reKumba, kana dhonza bhodhi kudura.
help-workload-what-it-is-description: Uremu hwebasa nekugona zvinoratidza, vhiki nevhiki, kuti munhu wese ane basa rakawanda sei zvichienzaniswa nemaawa aanawo, pamabhodhi ese aunoshanda. Zvinoratidza ane basa rakawandisa, angagona kutora zvimwe, uye zvinodiwa nepurojekiti iri kuuya pasati padomwa munhu.
help-workload-how-it-works-description: Sarudza vhiki rekutanga, mavhiki mangani uye kana kuratidza maawa kana mapoinzi enyaya, wobva wadzvanya vhiki kuti uone makadhi aro. Mavhiki ane basa rakawanda kupfuura maawa matsvuku. Seta nguva yako yebasa, hunyanzvi nekusavapo, vakuru vebhodhi vanowedzera migove nenzvimbo dzemabasa, uye vatariri vanowedzera mazororo eruzhinji.
help-billing-what-it-is-description: Bhajeti nekubhadharisa ndipo panoronga vakuru vebhodhi nekubhadharisa basa rebhodhi: bhajeti raro, zvakadhura basa nezvarichadhura, mitengo yeawa, mari yakashandiswa, mari dzakatarwa, mitengo inofungidzirwa nema-invoice, zvichibva panguva yakateverwa pamakadhi.
help-billing-how-it-works-description: Sarudza mari nemitengo yeawa panhengo imwe neimwe nemutengo wakajairwa webhodhi, seta bhajeti, uye wedzera mari yakashandiswa nemari dzebasa. Nguva yakanyorwa pamakadhi inobva yaratidzwa seyakashandiswa neyakafungidzirwa zvichienzaniswa nebhajeti. Kana uchida, bvumidza nguva usati wanyora invoice. Zadza ruzivo rwemunyori weinvoice kamwe chete, wobva wagadzira ma-invoice enguva yakati, uadhaunirodhe, uamake seakatumirwa uye unyore kubhadhara, kana gadzira mutengo unofungidzirwa webasa richiri kuitwa.
